v: Te wach' yik heb' max k'anab'ajan tas syal heb' sk'ulan chukal, max b'at heb' t'a sb'e heb' manh wach'ok sb'eyb'al, max yak'och sb'a heb' t'a skal heb' b'uchumtak t'a Dios.
Palta t'a smasanil sk'ol heb' sk'anab'ajej sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová, sna'ub'tanhan heb' t'a k'uhal t'ak'wal.
Masanil tas sk'ulej heb', wach'nhej tz'aj yelk'ochi. Lajan yaj heb' icha junok te te' ay t'a sti' ha ha', syak' sat te' t'a stiempo'al, malaj b'ak'inh stakji'el xil te'.
Haxo pax heb' chuk sb'eyb'al jun, manh ichokta heb'. Lajan yaj heb' icha smatz'il ixim trigo tz'ik'jib'at yuj ik'.
Yuj chi' manhxo ol yal-laj skolan sb'a heb' chuk chi' ayik ol ch'olb'itaj heb' t'a yichanh heb' anima tojol sb'eyb'al.
Te xajan heb' anima tojol sb'eyb'al yuj Jehová. Haxo heb' anima ayb'at t'a chukal, wan sb'atkan heb' t'a syahelal.
¿Tas wal yuj tz'el wek'ek'ok yaw heb' ch'ok chonhab'il sk'echa'anh? ¿Tas wal yuj slajti'ej sb'a heb' t'a junok tas manh ol tzak'wan heb' sb'o'ani?
Ha heb' winh rey yet' heb' yajal t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', schichonoch sk'o'ol heb', junlajanxonhej syutej slajti'an sb'a heb' yoch ajk'olal t'a Jehová yet' t'a Winh Rey Sik'b'ilel yuj.
Slaj yalan heb' icha tik: Kik'ekel ko b'a t'a yol sk'ab' Dios yik manhxalaj yalan yik t'ayonh, xchi heb'.
Ha Jehová Yajal t'a satcha'anh tonhej stzetzaj wal heb' yuj, sb'uchji heb' yuj.
Skot yowal t'a heb', xib'taj heb' yuj. Yet' yowal sk'o'ol ol yalan t'a heb' icha tik:
Toxo ix wak'och yopisio Winh Rey t'a tzalan Sion, haton jun tzalan sik'b'ilel wu'uj, xcham Jehová chi'.
Haxo Winh Rey Sik'b'ilel chi' tz'alani: Swalkanel tastak ix sna Jehová. Ix yal t'ayin: Ha t'a jun k'u tik, tzin ch'oxeli to Wuninal ach.
k'an t'ayin, ol wak'an juntzanh niwak chonhab' yet' masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik t'ayach.
Ol ak' yajalil t'a yib'anh heb' yet' wal a poder. Ol a satel heb' icha tz'aj smak'jipoj junok lum chen t'a junok k'e'en k'okoch, xchi t'ayin, xchi Winh Uninab'il chi'.
Ha tikne'ik jun, ex sreyal, ex yajalil juntzanh chonhab', jelanokab' tzeyutej he pensar, scham wal he k'ayb'an tas swala'.
Hak'ekem he b'a t'a Jehová t'a tzalajk'olal, ayokab' yelk'och t'a yol he sat.
Emnakil tzeyutej pax he b'a t'ay t'a smasanil he k'o'ol, yik max kot yowal t'ayex. Tato ma'ay, ol ex satel yuj, yujto elanhchamel skot yowal. Te tzalajk'olal yik masanil heb' skol sb'a t'a Jehová.
Mamin Jehová, tzijtum heb' anima ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, tzijtum heb' smeltzajoch wajk'o'olok.
Tzijtum heb' tz'alani to manh ol in a kolo'.
Ha hachxo Mamin, in Kolumal ach, u'uj tzin tzalaji. Ha ach tzak' in tek'anil.
Ha tzin awaj t'ayach, tzin a tak'wej t'a jun tzalan b'aj syal sb'a heb' anima t'ayach.
Tzin ek' jichan, tzin wayb'ati, te wach' tz'aj yel in wayanh, yujto a ach tzin a tanhwej.
Manh ol in xiwlaj yuj jantak anima ak'um owal molanek'i, yuj heb' oyanek' t'a in patik wichanh tik.
Mamin Jehová, ochanh wet'ok. Ach in Diosal, kolinnhej. Ha ach ol a mak'poj sti' heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin. Manhxalaj jab'ok ol elk'och spoder heb' sk'ulan chukal chi'.
Mamin Jehová, a achton tzach kolwajnhej. Ak' a niwan wach'k'olal t'a kib'anh a onh a chonhab' onh tik.
Ach in Diosal, a ach tza b'o yaj in lolonel, tak'wej in ayik tzin awaj t'ayach. Ayik ay in och t'a syahelal ix in a kolani. Ok'okab' a k'o'ol t'ayin tikne'ik, ab' tas swal t'a in lesal tik.
Ex wetanima'il, ¿b'ak'inh ol eyaktejkan eyalan in pekal? ¿B'ak'inh ol eyaktejkan eyalan lolonel malaj yelk'ochi? ¿B'ak'inh ol eyaktejkan he sayan tas manh yelok?
Ab'ek, a Jehová ix sik'ankanel heb' anima ayoch spensar t'ay, yik wach' tz'och heb' yikok. Ayik tzin awaj t'ay, stak'wi t'ayin.
Xiwanhek t'a Dios, yik manhxo ol och he mul. Ayik jichan ex ek'i, a wal yik te numan, tze b'eyk'olan he b'a.
Hak'ek och Jehová yipok he k'o'ol, ak'ek he silab' t'ay icha wal t'a smojal.
Tzijtum heb' tz'alani: ¿Mach ol ch'oxan swach'il t'ayonh? xchi heb'. Mamin Jehová, ch'ox a wach'k'olal t'ayonh.
Ha ach ix ak'kot tzalajk'olal t'ayin, ek'to t'a yichanh stzalajk'olal heb' niwan tas syik' t'a smunlajel.
Malaj tas tzin na' ayik tzin ek' jichan, te junk'olal tzin wayi. Mamin Jehová, a ach ton ayach och wet'ok, yuj chi' malaj tas tzin ik'ani.
Mamin Jehová, cham wal ab'an tas swala'. Ochanh k'elan t'ayin ayik sja sik'son in k'o'ol.
Scham wal ab'ani a swalan in b'a t'ayach. In reyal ach, in Diosal ach, yuj chi' a t'ayach ol in lesalwok.
Mamin Jehová, t'a junjun k'inhib'alil tzin awaj t'ayach. Ha sk'inhib'i swalan in b'a t'ayach, tzin tanhwan a paktzitan t'ayin.
Wal yel Mamin, malaj a gana t'a chukal, max yal-laj yaj heb' chuk t'a a tz'ey.
Ha heb' syik'cha'anh sb'a, manh ol aj heb' t'a ichanh, max schalaj a k'o'ol heb' sk'ulan chukal.
Ol a satel heb' tz'esani. Tza chakankanel heb' ixtum anima yet' heb' milumcham anima.
Ha inxo ol in k'och t'a a kajnub' yuj a niwan wach'k'olal t'ayin. Ol wal wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a emnakil t'a a kajnub' iknhej yaji.
Mamin Jehová tojol ach toni, yuj chi' kuchb'ej in t'a a b'e'al, cheklitej a b'e'al t'a wichanh yujnhej heb' ajk'o'ol tzin maklani.
Malaj wal lolonel yel syal heb', anhej tas chuk sna heb'. Yuj tas syal heb' chi' sb'atkan heb' anima t'a chamel, syal wach' lolonel heb' t'a chab'satil.

Ach in Diosal, ak' wal kot yahelal t'a yib'anh heb'. Kotokab' t'a yib'anh heb' yuj juntzanh chukal sna heb' t'a yib'anh heb' yetanima'il. Yujto manh jantakok schukal heb', ik'kanel heb' t'a skal a chonhab', ina to spitej wal sb'a heb' t'ayach.

Haxo pax masanil heb' tzach ak'anoch yipok sk'o'ol jun, tzalajokab' sk'o'ol heb'. Elokab' yaw heb' t'a tzalajk'olal t'a masanil tiempo, yujto tza kolel heb'. Ha heb' tzach xajanani, tzalajokab' heb' u'uj.
Yujto a ach Jehová, tzak' a wach'k'olal t'a heb' wach' syutej sb'a. Tza kolanel heb' yet' a wach'k'olal.
Mamin Jehová, manh in a tumej yet' yowal a k'o'ol. Manh ak' in yahelal ayik skot owal t'ayin.
Mamin, ok'ok wal a k'o'ol t'ayin, yujto manhxalaj wip swab'i. Mamin, ak'xi b'ox in k'o'ol yujto a in niwanil tik sluklon yuj manh ipal.
Te somchajnak in k'o'ol. Ha hachxo Mamin Jehová, ¿b'ak'inh ol ach och wet'ok?
Mamin Jehová, ochanh wal k'elan t'ayin, kolinel yet' wal a niwan wach'k'olal.
¿Tom ay mach olto ach na'ankotok ayik toxo ix chami? Malaj junok mach ol b'itan t'ayach t'a skal heb' yetchamnakil chi'.
Ste el wip wok'i. Manh jantakok wok' t'a junjun ak'wal. Sch'ayxi'el in k'anh jolom yuj yal in sat.
Maxtzak yal-laj wilani, yujto ix mal in sat wok'i yujnhej heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin.
Elanhek t'a in tz'ey a ex to anhej chukal tze k'ulej. Toxo ix yab' Jehová in sik'sik'an wok'i.
Toxo ix yab' in tewi t'ay. Toxo ix scha in lesal.
Ha heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, ol kan heb' t'a k'ixwelal. Tonhej ol somchajkanel heb'. T'a junnhej mutz'satil ol kan heb' t'a k'ixwelk'olal.
Mamin Jehová, ach in Diosal, ha t'a yol a k'ab' wan in sayan in kolnab'il. Kolinel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' tzin pechan b'eyek'ok.
Tato ma'ay, ol in skotak jekchitejb'at heb' ayoch ajk'olal chi' t'ayin, icha syutej schib'ej nok' choj, yujto manhxalaj mach ol yal in skolani.
Ach Jehová in Diosal, ¿tokwal ix in k'ulej icha juntzanh tas syal heb' t'a in patik? ¿Tokwal ay in mul t'a jun chi'?
Malaj b'aj chuk ix wutej in k'o'ol t'a heb' wach' syutej sk'o'ol t'ayin. Malaj b'aj ix wixtej winh ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin wach'chom malaj in mul.
Tato ix wixtej winh, yak'okab' snib'ej winh in spechan b'eyek'ok. In yamchajokab' yuj winh, tzin stek'ub'tanhan winh masanto satel in b'inajnakil.
Mamin Jehová, k'e'anh linhan yet' yowal a k'o'ol. Elanhkot t'a yichanh yowal sk'o'ol heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin. B'o yaj t'ayin icha wal a gana t'a stojolal.
Ochokab' hoyan juntzanh nación t'a ichanh, tza ch'olb'itan yaj heb' masanto t'a satcha'anh b'aj ay a despacho.
Mamin Jehová, a achton ol a ch'olb'itej juntzanh nación. B'o yaj t'ayin icha wal in wach' b'eyb'al yet' in tojolal.
Ach Dios te tojol, tzil spensar yet' tas tzek' t'a sk'ol junjun anima. k'okb'ilxo Mamin, satokab'el heb' te chuk sb'eyb'al chi', tzak'anpax stek'anil heb' wach' sb'eyb'al.
Ha Dios in Kolumal yaji, haton ek'to t'a yib'anh smasanil, a skolan heb' wach' spensar.
Ha Dios Juez tojol toni, yuj chi' aykot yowal t'a heb' chuk t'a junjun k'u.
Tato max snalaj sb'a sk'o'ol heb', ha Dios ol yak'och ye yespada. Wach'xo yaj sjul-lab' b'aj ol sjul heb'.
Wanxo sk'e sk'ak'al yol sjul-lab' chi'. Wach'xo yaj syamk'ab' to ol och chamel yuj.
Ileknab' wal tas sna heb' chuk t'a heb' yetanima'il, anhej ixtoj anima syak' heb'.
Ichato sb'o jun olan heb' te jul yich yik syamchaj heb' yetanima'il heb', palta ha' heb' ol b'atkan t'a jun olan ix sb'o chi'.
Ha schukal heb' komonnhej sk'ulej, a ol kotkan t'a yib'anh heb'.
Swak' yuj diosal t'a Jehová yuj stojolal. Tzin b'itej Dios ek'to t'a yib'anh smasanil.
Mamin Jehová, Kajalil ach. Te b'inajnak ach, te niwan elk'och t'a sat lu'um tik. Icha pax chi' tz'aj yalchaj wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a satcha'anh.
Ha heb' unin yet' heb' tzato chuni tzak'lab'ej yik syalan ipalil heb', yik wach' tz'em numnaj heb' pit, heb' ajk'o'ol yajoch t'ayach.
Ha wal yik tzin k'e k'elan t'a satcha'anh b'ob'il u'uj, b'aj ay k'e'en uj yet' k'e'en k'anal a b'onak,
tzin na'an t'a yol wiko': ¿Tas wal jab'ok kelk'och a onh anima onh tik, yuj chi' tzonh a nakoti, tzonh a tanhwan yuj ko wach'ilok?
Ejminak ix onh utejkan janik' t'a yichanh heb' ángel ayik ix onh a b'o'ani, palta niwan kelk'och yuj kopisio ix ak'a'.
Ix ak' kopisio t'a yib'anh tas ix a b'o'o. Ix ak'anoch masanil tastak b'ob'il u'uj t'a yol ko k'ab'.
Ix ak'kanoch masanil makanhil nok' nok' t'a yol ko k'ab': Nok' kalnel, nok' wakax, nok' k'ultakil nok',
nok' much tzek' jenhenhok t'a satcha'anh, nok' chay ay t'a yol ha' mar yet' masanil nok' tzek' t'a yol ha ha' chi'.
Mamin Jehová, Kajalil ach. Te b'inajnak ach, te niwan elk'och t'a sat lu'um tik.
Mamin Jehová, t'a smasanil in k'o'ol tzin nib'ej swal wach' lolonel t'ayach, swalanel yab'ixal masanil tastak satub'tak ix a k'ulej.
Ach Dios, te ek' ach to t'a yib'anh smasanil, u'uj wal tzin awaj t'a niwan tzalajk'olal. In gana tzach in b'itej.
T'a wal ichanh ix b'atkan heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin elelal. Ix telwi heb', ix cham heb'.
Yajal ach t'a stojolal. k'ojan ach em t'a a despacho, ix a b'o'an yaj tas ix in k'an t'ayach.
Ix ak'an owal yet' juntzanh heb' ch'ok chonhab'il. Ix ak' telwok heb' sk'ulan chukal. Ix a suksat sb'i heb' yik wach' maxtzak nachajkot heb' t'a b'ak'inh.
Toxo ix cham heb' ajk'o'ol, ix satel schonhab' heb' t'a junelnhej. Ha ach ix a sateli, manhxalaj junok ix kani, yik wach' maxtzak nachajkoti.
Ha hachxo ach Jehová, toxonton rey ach t'a masanil tiempo. k'ojan ach em t'a a despacho yik tza ch'olb'itan heb' anima.
Ol a ch'olb'itej yol yib'anhk'inal tik t'a wach'il. Ol ach och yajalil t'a masanil chonhab' t'a stojolal.
Ach Jehová, tza kol heb' tz'ixtaji, tzak' yip heb' ayik ayoch heb' t'a niwak yahelal.
Mamin Jehová, yipk'olal aj yuj heb' ojtannak ach, yujto malaj b'aj tzaktejkan heb' ayik syalan sb'a heb' t'ayach.
B'itananhek t'a Jehová Kajal t'a Sion, alek yab' heb' chonhab' tastak ix sk'ulej.
Manh tonhejok tz'ilji'och heb' milumcham anima yuj Dios, max b'atkanlaj satk'olal syahelal heb' ayoch t'a ilk'olal yuj.
Mamin Jehová, ok'okab' a k'o'ol t'ayin, il in emta, te ya tzin ek' yuj heb' tzin chakaneli. Kolinel t'a chamel.
Ichato wal chi' b'i'an, ol walan wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a yichanh heb' anima t'a spuerta'il Jerusalén. Tzin tzalaji, yujto ix in a kolkaneli.
Ha juntzanh ch'ok chonhab'il chi', ix telwi'em heb' t'a yol jun olan ix sb'o'o. Ha yok heb' syamchaj yuj ch'anh ya'al ix yak'em chi'.
Ojtakab'il Jehová yujto tojol syutej spaktzitan tas sk'ulej anima. Munil syik'kot yahelal heb' sk'ulan chukal t'a yib'anh.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal yet' heb' sb'atkan Dios satk'olal yuj, ol b'atkan heb' t'a chamel.
Manh masanilok tiempo ol b'atkan heb' meb'a' satk'olal yuj Dios. Ol jawok sk'uhal ol elk'och tastak ayoch yipok sk'o'ol heb'.
Mamin Jehová, ch'oxel ipalil. Mokab' yik'cha'anh sb'a heb' anima t'ayach. Ik'kot juntzanh chonhab' t'a ichanh, tzak'an syahelal heb'.
Ak'och heb' t'a xiwk'olal. Ak' yojtakejel heb' to animanhej heb'.
Mamin Jehová, ¿tas yuj najat tzach elkani? ¿Tas yuj ichato tza k'ub'ejel a b'a ayik ay in och t'a syahelal?
Syik'cha'anh sb'a heb' sk'ulan chukal, tz'och heb' ajk'olal t'a heb' meb'a', palta munil a heb' ol kan t'a yol ch'anh ya'al ix sb'o'em chi'.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal, syik'cha'anh sb'a heb' yet' tas snib'ejochi. Syal wach' lolonel heb' t'a heb' snib'anoch smasanil tastak, haxo t'ayach Mamin, tonhej sb'uchwaj heb'.
Ha heb' chuk chi', max ach snalaj jab'ok heb' yuj yak'umtakil. Ha sna'an heb' to max il-laj tas wan sk'ulan heb' chi'.
Wach'nhej tz'elk'och masanil tas sk'ulej heb' chi'. Malaj yelk'och jab'ok a k'ayb'ub'al t'a heb'. Malaj tz'och heb' yajk'ol heb' chi' t'ay.
Sna'an heb' t'a yol yiko' to malaj b'ak'inh ol telwok heb'. Malaj b'ak'inh ol somchajel heb' yalannaji.
Anhej katab' lolonel syal heb', slaj yalan es heb' yet' tas syutej xib'tan heb' anima. Elanhchamel slolon heb' yet' yowal sk'o'ol yet' chukal.
T'a stitak chonhab' tz'em k'ojan heb' smaklan yila' mach tzek'ta. T'a elk'altak smilcham heb' malaj smul heb'. Aynhejoch sat heb' t'a heb' max uji skolan sb'a.

Icha nok' choj ayoch t'a yol snhak'e'en, icha chi' syutej sb'a heb'. Sk'ub'ejel sb'a heb', smaklan heb' ilb'ajk'o'ol heb'. Stanhwej wal heb' janik' wal ol yak' ganar heb'. Ayik syamchaj heb', tz'ik'jib'at heb' yuj heb'.
Tz'em wotz'an heb', sk'e juknaj heb' icha nok' choj chi'. Ha heb' max yal-laj skolan sb'a t'a yol sk'ab' heb', syamchaj heb' yuj heb'.
Ha sna'an heb' sk'ulan chukal chi' to sb'atkan satk'olal u'uj. Makan a sat yalan heb', max ujilaj ilan sna'an heb'.
Mamin Jehová, kotanh, ak' ip ak'an syahelal heb' sk'ulan chukal chi'. Mokab' sat a k'o'ol t'a heb' ayoch t'a kusk'olal.
¿Tas yuj tza cha ach spatikejel heb' sk'ulan chukal chi'? Ha sna'an heb' to manh ol a ch'olb'itejlaj yaj heb'.

Ha ach wal tzil schukal heb'. Ha ach ix ila', yuj chi' ol ak' syahelal heb' icha wal smojal, icha tas sk'ulej heb'. Ha t'ayach syal sb'a heb' max yal-laj skolan sb'a. Ha ach tzach kolwaj t'a heb' unin manhxalaj smam.
Mak' k'ichaj sk'ab' heb' sk'ulan chukal chi'. Ak' yowalil chukal sk'ulej heb' chi'. Tz'akanokab' tz'aj stupan smul heb' chi'.
Ach Jehová, Yajal ach t'a masanil tiempo. Ha heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, ol ik'el heb' t'a sat lum a lu'um.

Mamin Jehová, a ach ton wal tzab' slesal heb' anima emnakil, a ach ton wal tzak' yip heb'. Ha ach ton wal tzab' yalan sb'a heb' tz'ixtaji yet' heb' unin manhxalaj smam. Ha achton ol il tas ol ajkan heb' chuk chamelb'a yaji, yik wach' manhxo ol xib'tejlaj heb' emnakil heb'.
Ha Jehová swak'och yipok in k'o'ol, yuj chi' nab'anhej tzeyal t'ayin: Ixik, k'ub'ejel a b'a t'a kaltak te' icha syutej sb'a nok' much.
Ina wal heb' winh chuk, syak' lista sjul-lab' heb' winh yik sjulwaji, ijanxokan heb' winh yet' sjul-lab' chi'. T'a k'ub'eltak sjulji heb' anima wach' yuj heb' winh.
Tato a heb' yajal haxonhej chukal ay t'a spensar, ¿tasto wal ol yutok sb'a heb' wach' sb'eyb'al? xe chi t'ayin.
Palta ayek' Jehová t'a stemplo to anhej ay yiko'. Ha t'a satcha'anh, hata' ay sdespacho, scham wal sk'o'ol yilani, sch'olb'itan sb'eyb'al heb' anima.
Ha Jehová sch'olb'itan yaj heb' anima wach' yet' heb' chuk. Te yajb'ilel heb' anima komonnhej smak'waj yuj.

Ha ol ak'anemta k'ak' icha wal yax nhab' yet' azufre ayoch sk'ak'al t'a yib'anh heb' chuk. Ol yak'anemta jun niwan ik' yik stakji'el masanil tas yuj. Ha ol paktzitan t'a heb' anima, hato syala' tastak sk'ulej heb'.
Ha Jehová tojol toni, scham wal sk'o'ol yet' tojolal. Yuj chi', a heb' anima tojol sb'eyb'al, ol yil wal Dios heb'.
Mamin Jehová, kolonh, yujto manhxalaj heb' ay elk'och t'a sat, wan satel heb' tzach k'anab'ajan t'a skal heb' anima.
Syesej heb' t'ay junjun. T'a chab'satil slolon heb' t'ay junjun yik slaj yixtan sb'a heb'.
Mamin Jehová, satkanel juntzanh anima ayoch t'a chab'satil chi' yet' heb' syik'cha'anh sb'a.
Haton heb' tz'alani: Anhej tato syal ko loloni, k'okb'ilnhej chi'. Ha ko ti' tik ol onh kolanok. ¿Machto wal ol yal onh schekani? xchi heb'.
Haxo Jehová tz'alani: Tz'ixtaj wal heb' malaj tas syal yuj. Ha heb' meb'a' tz'el yaw heb' yuj sya'il. Yuj chi', yowalil ol in kolkanel heb' stanhwan in kolwal, xchi Jehová.
Ha tas yalnakkan Jehová te wach'nhej. Icha wal k'e'en plata sik'lab'il stz'a'i, manhxalaj jab'ok smikal, ukel snhusji t'a yol k'ak', icha chi' yaj tas yalnakkani.
Mamin Jehová, a ach ton wal tzonh a tanhwej. Toxonton tzonh a kolnhej t'a juntzanh anima tik.
Ayik scha'an yab' chukal heb' anima, masanil b'aj tz'ik'jicha'anh heb' chuk chi'.
Mamin Jehová, ¿b'ak'inh wal ol in a nakoti? ¿Tokwal ol in b'atkan satk'olal u'uj t'a masanil tiempo? ¿B'ak'inh wal ol a ch'ox a wach'k'olal t'ayin?
¿Jantakto tiempo ol in te kus t'a junjun k'u? ¿Jantakto tiempo ay in ek' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'o'ol?
Mamin Jehová in Diosal, kotanh k'elan t'ayin, tak'wanh t'ayin, ak' a wach'k'olal t'ayin, yik wach' manh ol in pet chamok,
yik manh ol yal winh ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin: Toxo ix wak' ganar, xchi talaj winh. Malaj in gana stzalaj sk'o'ol winh, tato tzin yak' ganar winh.
Ha a wach'k'olal ayoch yipok in k'o'ol, stzalajb'i in k'o'ol yuj a kolwal.
Mamin Jehová, tzach in b'itej yuj a wach'il t'ayin.
Ha heb' chuk spensar sna heb' to malaj Dios. Junlajanxonhej ix aj sjuanel spensar heb'. Yelxo wal te chuk sk'ulej heb'. Malaj mach sk'ulan wach'il.
Hato t'a satcha'anh k'elanemta Jehová t'a anima, yik syila' tato ay heb' syak'och spensar t'ay, yik syilpaxi tato na'an yuj heb'.
Ha juntzanh b'eyb'al chuk sb'eyb'alej heb' smasanil. Junlajanxonhej tz'aj sjuwib'at heb'. Malaj junok mach b'o'an wach' b'eyb'al. Toton malaj wal junok mach.
Icha wal to malaj spensar heb' sk'ulan chukal chi'. Ha heb' chi' satanel heb' yetchonhab', icha wal to swa'el heb' yaj heb', max yal-laj sb'a heb' t'a Jehová.
Ste ib'xi heb' yuj xiwelal, yujto ha Dios ayek' yet' heb' wach' sb'eyb'al.
Snib'ej heb' syixtejb'at tas nab'il yuj heb' emnakil, palta a Jehová skolan heb' emnakil chi'.
Komonok ha t'a tzalan Sion skot ko kolnab'il a onh israel onh tik. Ayik ol yak'anxi swach'k'olal Dios t'a kib'anh, ol tzalaj wal ko k'o'ol a onh yinhtil onh winhaj Jacob tik. Ol el lenaj ol kila'.
Mamin Jehová, ¿mach heb' syal skajnajek' t'a a kajnub'? ¿Mach pax heb' syal yaj et' t'a jun tzalan b'aj syak'em sb'a anima t'ayach?
Haton heb' wach' sb'eyb'al yet' heb' sb'o'an tojolal, heb' anhej lolonel yel syal t'a smasanil sk'o'ol.
Eb' max na'ank'e esal lolonel, max yixtejlaj yamigo, max yal-laj spekal heb' kajan t'a slak'anil.
Eb' spatikanel heb' patikab'ilel u'uj, palta stzalaj sk'o'ol heb' yet' heb' ay elk'och t'a sat. Eb' max k'exan tas syala', tz'elnhejk'och tas syal heb' chi', wach'chom skan heb' t'a yalanh yuj.

Eb' tz'ak'an stumin majanil, palta max sk'anlaj yune' stumin heb' chi'. Eb' max schonhlaj sb'a t'a es testigo'al t'a spatik heb' malaj smul. Ha heb' icha chi' sb'eyb'al, wal yel malaj b'ak'inh ol ak'jok ganar heb'.
Ach in Diosal, tanhwej in wal, anhej t'ayach tzin kol in b'a.
Mamin Jehová, swal t'ayach to Wajal ach. Masanil wach'il ay t'ayin, a t'ayach skoti.
Te wach' yik heb' tzach k'anab'ajan t'a skal heb' a chonhab'. In gana tzin aj t'a skal heb'.
Ol te k'ib'cha'anh syahelal heb' sb'atkan t'a spatik junok komon Dios. Max wak'ochlaj in b'a wak'an schik'il nok' silab' yet' heb' t'a skomon Dios chi'. Max wal-laj in b'a t'a sdiosal heb' chi'.
Mamin Jehová, anhej t'ayach swik' masanil wach'il. Ha achton tzak' masanil tas snib'ej in k'o'ol. T'a yol a k'ab' ayek' in k 'inal.
Ha wal b'aj ix echtejkan in makb'en, yelxo te wach'. Manhxo jantakok swach'il tas ix ak'kan chi' t'ayin.
Mamin Jehová, swal wach' lolonel t'ayach yujto a ach tzak' in razón, tza k'ayb'an pax in pensar t'ak'walil.
Masanil tiempo na'an achnhej wu'uj. Yujto ayachnhej ek' wet'ok, yuj chi' malaj tas tzin ik'ani.
Yuj chi' ste tzalaj in k'o'ol tzin b'itani. Malaj tas tzin na'a, yujto tzach wak'och yipok in k'o'ol.
Manh ol in aktejkanlaj t'a skal heb' chamnak, manh ol a cha k'ab'at in niwanil tik, a in k'anab'ajum in tik t'ayach.
Tzak' wojtakejel sb'e'al k 'inal, tzak'an tzalajb'ok in k'o'ol ayik ayinek' het'ok. Aynhej tzalajk'olal t'a a tz'ey t'a masanil k 'inal.
Mamin Jehová, ab' in lolonel te yel tik, kotanh k'elan t'ayin ayik swalan in b'a t'ayach. Ak'kot tz'eyan a chikin t'a in lesal tik, yujto manh in k'ajanok walan esal lolonel.
Ha ach ton tzala' to malaj in mul, ojtak wal to tojol in pensar.

Ojtak masanil tas tzin na'a, wach'chom t'ak'walil. Ix in a b'eyk'olej, palta malaj jab'ok chukal ix ilchaj u'uj t'ayin. Toxo ix in na' to malaj tas chuk ol wala'. Icha syal a lolonel, najat ix in elkan t'a sb'e'al heb' komonxonhej smak'an heb' yetanima'il.
Tek'tek' swutej in b'a in b'at t'a yol a b'e. Malaj b'aj ix in el b'esnaj t'ay.
Ach in Diosal, swal in b'a t'ayach, yujto tzab'nhej tas swala'. Mamin ak'kot tz'eyan a chikin t'ayin t'a tas swal tik.
Ha heb' sayanek' a kolwal, tza kol heb' t'a heb' yajk'o'ol, tzin nib'ej to tza ch'ox a wach'k'olal t'ayin, haton juntzanh satub'tak.
Ya'ilej in, icha syutej junok mach sya'ilan yol sat, icha chi' tzin utej. k'ub'ej in el icha wal syutej nok' kaxlanh smoyank'e yune'.
Kolinel t'a heb' chuk skot t'ayin. Kolin t'a heb' milumcham anima tz'och hoyan t'a in patik chi'.
Max ok'laj sk'ol heb' chuk chi' t'a heb' yetanima'il, te ak'umtaknhej slolon heb'.
Lak'an tzak'an heb' t'a in patik, ix oymaj heb' t'a in patik wichanh, toxonhej stanhwej heb' in yekan telwok t'a sat lu'um.
Lajan heb' icha junok nok' choj wotz'anemi, ayik tz'elta juknaj nok' syam schib'ej.
Mamin Jehová, ochanh wet'ok, mak sat heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin yik stelwi heb'. Ak'lab'ej k'e'en espada tzin a kolanel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' chuk chi'.

Mamin Jehová, kolinel yet' a poder t'a yol sk'ab' heb' anima anhej tastak ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik snib'ej syik'kani. Ak'kot syahelal heb', jun yahelal yiktaxon heb' yaji. Ochokab' lokan heb' yuninal heb' yet' yixchikin heb' yet'ok.
Ha inxo jun, yujto tojol in pensar, yuj chi' ol ach wila'. Ayik ol in pitzwokk'e wa'an, manhxalaj tas ol snib'ej in k'o'ol, yujto ol in tzalaj wal t'a ichanh.
Mamin Jehová, tzach in xajanej, a ach tzak' ipal t'ayin.

Mamin Jehová, ichato nhak'e'en aj t'ayin, ichato in cuartel aji, yujto in Kolumal ach. Ach in Diosal, a t'ayach skot wip, a t'ayach tzin kol in b'a, in Tanhwumal aji. In Kolumal ach, te ay a poder. U'uj max in yamchajlaj yuj heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin.
Smojton wal a b'itaji. Ayik swalan in b'a t'ayach, t'a wal elanhchamel tzin a kolkanel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'ol yajoch t'ayin.
Ha smay chamel ix oymaj t'a in patik. Manh jantakok yahelal ix jawi t'a wib'anh yik tzin sateli.
Ha chamel, ichato toxo ix spixoch slasu t'ayin, ichato ix sb'o in ya'alil b'aj ol in telwok.
Mamin Jehová, ix wal in b'a t'ayach ayik ayinek' t'a skal in somk'olal. Ach in Diosal, ix in k'an a kolwal. Ha t'a a templo ix ab' tas ix wala'. Ix k'och waw t'a a chikin.
Ichato chi' ix ek' jun niwan kixkab'. Yelk'olal ix ib'xi yib' lum niwak witz. Ix tzikub'tanhaj wal yuj yowal a k'o'ol ach in Diosal.
Ichato ix elta tab' t'a yol a nhi', haxo t'a yol a ti' ichato ix elta jun k'ak' te ow. Ichato ix elta tzipipok tzak'ak' t'a yol a ti' chi'.
Ix a jak satcha'anh, ix ach emuli. Ayoch niwak k'ik'al asun t'a yalanh ok ayik ach emul chi'.
Ay ach k'e t'a yib'anh jun querubín, ix ach b'at jenhenhok, ix ach b'at b'akhachok t'a yib'anh ik'.
k'ub'an ach el b'aj te k'ik'k 'inal. Ix a k'ub'ejel a b'a t'a skal k'ik'al asun b'ut'jinakel yuj ha ha'.
Ay k'ak' ix laj elta kopnaj t'a ichanh icha wal lheb'lon. Ix kot sakb'at t'a skal asun yet' tzak'ak'.
Mamin Jehová, ek' achto t'a yib'anh smasanil, ix el aw, icha wal sk'anh k'u t'a satcha'anh. Ix kot sakb'at yet' tzak'ak'.
Ix ak'anb'at a jul-lab' chi', haxo heb' ajk'o'ol ix saklemkanb'at heb' yuj. Ix a julanb'at jun k'ak' tzek' kopnaj t'a skal heb', ix pechchaj heb' yuj.
Mamin Jehová, yuj scha'anhil ix ach awaji, yuj pax jun ik' te ow ix ak'elta, ix cheklaj yich ha' mar. Yuj pax chi' ix cheklaj yich yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Ach in Diosal, masanto t'a satcha'anh ix ak'kot a kolwal t'ayin, ichato ix in ik'k'eta t'a yol jun ha ha' te jul yich.
Ix in a kolan t'a heb' ajk'o'ol te ay yip, malaj tzin och t'a heb', yelxo wal te tek'an heb' t'a wichanh.
Ix och b'ulnaj heb' t'ayin ayik ay in och t'a ilk'olal, a hachxo Jehová ix ach och wet'ok.
Ix in ik'anelta b'aj lot'an, ix in ak'ankanoch b'aj lewan. Ix in a kolo' yujto xajan in u'uj.
Mamin Jehová, ix ak' spak t'ayin, yujto tojol ix wutej in b'a. Ix ak' a wach'k'olal t'ayin, yujto malaj in mul,
yujto ix in k'anab'ajej a b'eyb'al. Ach in Diosal, maj in k'ulejlaj chukal yik swik'kanel in b'a t'ayach.
Masanil a k'ayb'ub'al, na'annhej wu'uj, malaj b'ak'inh sb'at a lolonel satk'olal wu'uj.
Wach'nhej in b'eyb'al t'a ichanh. Ix in ya'ilej in b'a yik max in b'at t'a chukal.
Yujnhejton chi' ix ak' spak t'ayin yujto tojol swutej in b'a, malaj pax in mul t'a yol a sat ach Jehová.
Mamin, a heb' tzach k'anab'ajani, ol elk'och syal a lolonel t'a heb'. Ha heb' wach' spensar, wach' pax tzutej a pensar t'a heb'.
Wach' tzutej a b'a t'a heb' wach' sb'eyb'al, palta tza ch'ox a jelanil a tenanek' spensar heb' ixtum anima.
Tza kol heb' emnakil, haxo heb' syik'cha'anh sb'a, tzik'emta heb'.
Mamin Jehová, a achton tzak' sakil k'inal t'ayin. Ach in Diosal, a achton tzik'kanel k'ik' k'inal t'ayin.
Yuj a kolwal ix in saklemejb'at heb' soldado, ix in k'axpajek' t'a yib'anh smuro'al juntzanh chonhab'.
Ach Jehová Dios, yelxo wal te wach' a b'eyb'al. Ha a lolonel ix ak'kani, smoj ton wal malaj ko chab'k'olal t'ay. Tza kolel masanil mach yipk'olal aj yuj.
Mamin Jehová, malaj junokxo Dios, a achnhej. ¿Tokwal ay junokxo kolwajum icha ach tik?
Ach Dios, a ach tzak'nhej wip. Ha ach tzin a kuchb'ej t'a jun b'e te wach'.
Icha wal sb'ey junok nok' k'ultakil chej, icha wal chi' tz'aj in b'ey u'uj. T'a sattak witz yek'i, tek'tek' waj u'uj.
Ha ach tzin a k'ayb'ej t'a owal, tzak'anpax wip yik tzin pakchitan junok jul-lab' nab'a bronce.
Mamin, a ach tzin a tanhwej, tzin a kolani. Ha a wach' k'ab' tzin yamank'e linhan. Yujnhej a wach'k'olal ix in ik'cha'anh.
Wach' ix utej in b'e a b'o'ani yik wach' max in el-laj nhernajok.
Ix in pech heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, ix yamchaj heb' wu'uj. Maj in ochlaj wa'an masanto ix cham heb' wu'uj.
Chok' ix wutejkan heb' yik wach' manhxo ol k'e wa'an heb'. Ix telwi heb' t'a skal wok.
Ha achton tzak' wip yik swak'an owal. Ha heb' schichon sk'ol t'ayin, tzak' yak'em sb'a heb' t'ayin.
Ha ach tza pechel heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin. Yuj chi' syal in satanel heb' malaj tzin och t'ay.
Sk'an kolwal heb', palta malaj mach skolan heb'. Stewi heb' t'ayach Jehová, palta max ach tak'wilaj t'a heb'.
Chok' tz'aj heb' wu'uj icha wal pokok tz'ik'chajk'e wa'an yuj ik'. Tzin tek'anem heb' icha wal stek'chajem lum sok'om t'a yoltak b'e.
Tzin a kolel t'a yowal heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, tzin ak'ankanoch yajalilok juntzanh niwak chonhab'. Ha heb' anima manh wojtakoklaj, a heb' tzin ak'an serwil.
Anhej syab'an wab'ixal heb', tzin sk'anab'ajan heb'. Ha heb' ch'ok chonhab'il chi', syak'och sb'a heb' t'a yol in k'ab'.
Tz'ib'xik'e heb' yuj xiwelal ayik tz'elta heb' t'a yol scuartel.
Ach Jehová pitzan ach. Ach in Kolumal, alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'ayach. Ach Dios in Kolumal, ik'jokab' cha'anh a b'i.
Ha ach tzak' yojtakejel heb' tzin ixtani to ayach och wet'ok. Tzik'ankot heb' ch'ok chonhab'il t'a yalanh in mandar.
Ha ach tzin a kolel t'a yowal sk'o'ol heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, haton heb' schichon sk'o'ol t'ayin. Mamin, tzin a kolanpax t'a heb' komonnhej smak'an anima.
Yuj chi' jun, swal wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a skal juntzanh niwak chonhab', tzin b'itan pax a b'i.
U'uj wal, swak' ganar niwak owal a in rey in tik, a in sik'b'il in el u'uj. T'a masanil tiempo tza ch'ox a wach'k'olal t'ayin a in David in tik yet' t'a heb' winhtilal icha ajnak halani.
Ha satcha'anh yet' masanil tas ay t'ay, a sch'oxanel sb'inajnakil Dios, sch'oxanel swach'il smunlajel.
Junjun k'u, junjun ak'wal sch'oxji'el sjelanil yuj tastak ay t'a satcha'anh.
Wach'chom malaj junok lolonel tz'ab'chaji, malaj pax junok jaj tz'ab'chaj yochi,
palta sb'eyb'at yab'ixal Dios t'a masanil sat lu'um tik, masanto b'aj slajwik'och masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ha t'a satcha'anh, hata' ay k'u yuj Dios.
Icha wal junok winh kelem hato wal snupnaji, stzalaji tz'elta t'a yol scuarto, icha chi' sjawi k'u. Ma icha junok winak te ay yip stzalaj sk'o'ol ayik sb'at t'a smunlajel.
Sk'e'ul yok k'u t'a yichcha'anh, sb'atxikan t'a b'aj tz'emxikani, malaj junok tas syal skolan sb'a t'a sk'ak'al.
Ha wal sk'ayb'ub'al Jehová malaj jab'ok spalta'il, tz'ak'ji kip yuj. Ha scheknab'il te yel, syak'an sjelanil heb' mantalaj spensar.
Ha tas syal Jehová, te wach'nhej yaji, stzalajb'i ko k'o'ol yuj. Ha sley Jehová, tojol toni, sjakwi ko pensar yuj.
Ha emnakilal t'a Jehová te wach'nhej, aynhejek' t'a junelnhej. Ha tas nab'il yuj Jehová te yel, tojol toni.
Yelxo wal te nib'ab'il t'a yichanh k'e'en oro te wach'. Yelxo wal te chi' t'a yichanh nok' yal chab' ayoch t'a yet'tal.
Kachnab'il pax yaj t'ayin a in a chekab' in tik. Tato tzin k'anab'ajej a lolonel chi', wach' ol in elk'och yuj.
¿Tom ay junok mach syal yilan sb'a t'a spalta'il? Mamin Jehová, ak' in niwank'olal yuj juntzanhxo in palta'il max wil in k'ulani.
Manh a cha wak'och in b'a t'a skal chukal. Manh a cha yak' yajalil chukal chi' t'ayin. Icha chi' max och in mul, malaj junok in chukal t'a yol a sat.
Mamin Jehová in Kolumal ach, in Tanhwumal ach, chab'ilokab' u'uj tas swala' yet' tas tzin na'a.
Mamin rey, yab'okab' Jehová ko Diosal a onh yinhtil onh winhaj Jacob a lesalwi. A'okab' tzach kolani ayik ayach och t'a ilk'olal.
Yak'okab'kot skolwal t'ayach masanto t'a stemplo t'a Sion.
Sna'okab'kot masanil ofrenda ix ak'a'. Scha'okab' sk'o'ol a silab' tza nhustz'a'ok.
A'okab' ol ak'an elk'och icha a gana yet' masanil tastak nab'il u'uj.
Ol el kaw yuj tzalajk'olal ayik ol ak'an ganar heb' ajk'o'ol. Ol kik'cha'anh ko bandera yuj kik'ancha'anh ko Diosal. A'okab' Jehová tz'ak'an masanil tas k'anb'il u'uj.
Kojtakxo tikne'ik to a Jehová ol kolan winh ko reyal sik'b'ilel yuj. Masanto t'a satcha'anh to anhej ay yiko', ol tak'wokkot t'ay. Yuj spoder Jehová chi' ol yak' ganar niwak owal winh ko reyal.
Ay heb' tz'ak'anoch scarruaje yik owal yipok sk'o'ol, ay pax juntzanhxo heb', a nok' schej heb' syak'och yipok sk'o'ol. Ha onhxo pax tik, a Jehová ko Diosal skak'och yipok ko k'o'ol.
Ha heb' chi' spax yip yok heb', stelwi heb', a onhxo pax tik jun, tek'tek' kaji, linhannhej onh k'e'i.
Mamin Jehová, kol winh ko reyal. Tak'wanh t'ayonh ayik tzach kawtani.
Mamin Jehová, a in rey in tik, tzin tzalaji, yujto syal u'uj smasanil. Yelxo wal tzin te tzalaji, yujto u'uj wal ix wak' ganar.
Ix a b'o tas snib'ej in k'o'ol, maj a tenek'laj tas ix in k'ana'.
Te niwan wach'il ix ak' t'ayin, ix ak'ank'e jun corona oro t'a in jolom.
Ix in k'an t'ayach to tzak' najatb'ok in k 'inal, a hachxo ix ak' t'ayin.
Te b'inajnak in yuj a kolwal. U'uj wal syal wu'uj, ay pax in tzikiki'al.
Manh jantakok a wach'k'olal ix ak' t'ayin t'a masanil tiempo. Ste tzalaj in k'o'ol t'a ichanh.
Mamin Jehová, ek'al ach t'a yib'anh masanil, yujto a a wach'k'olal ayoch yipok in k'o'ol, yuj chi' malaj b'ak'inh ol in ak'jok ganar.
Mamin rey, ol a yam masanil heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach, haton heb' malaj snib'ej tzach yila'.
Ayik ol a ch'oxan a b'a t'a skal heb', ol a satankanel heb', icha wal tz'aj junok tas slajwi'el yuj k'ak'. Ha Jehová ol satanel heb' yet' yowal sk'o'ol, haxo k'ak' ol ak'an lajwokel heb'.
Ha yuninal heb' ajk'o'ol chi' yet' heb' yinhtilal heb', ol a satkanel heb' t'a skal anima t'a sat lu'um tik.
Wach'chom ix snib'ej heb' ix ach yixtej, ix say wal modo heb' tas tz'aj ach yak'an ganar, palta maj yal-laj yuj heb',
yujto a ach tik ix a pechkanb'at heb' ayik ix och ijan a jul-lab' t'a heb'.
Mamin Jehová, ach ik'jokab'cha'anh yujto masanil syal u'uj. Ol ko b'itej ipalil.
Ach in Diosal, ach in Diosal, ¿tas wal yuj tzin aktejkani? ¿tas wal yuj max in a kolo' ayik tz'el waw t'a skal in yahelal?
Ach in Diosal, k'uhal t'ak'wal wawaj t'ayach, palta max ach tak'wilaj t'ayin, manhxa b'aj syal wik'an wip.
Ha hachxo pax jun, a achxonhejochi, tzach sb'itej heb' wetisraelal.
Ha heb' ko mam kicham, yak'nak ach och heb' yipok sk'o'ol, yalnak sb'a heb' t'ayach, yuj chi' a kolnakkanel heb'. Yak'annak ach och heb' t'a sk'o'ol, yuj chi' maj k'ixwokel-laj heb'.
Ha inxo jun, manhxo in anima'ok swab'i, icha wal junok nok' ha'ay waj swab'i. Tzheb'ajtak in yilanoch heb' wetanima'il, patikab'il in kaneli.
Ha heb' tzin hilani, sb'uchwaj heb' t'ayin, syet'tej in sat heb', syak'an ib'xok sjolom heb'.
Syalan heb': Ha jun winh tik, a Jehová ix yak'och winh yipok sk'o'ol yalani, yuj chi' koljokab'el winh yuj Jehová chi'. Tato stzalaj sk'ol Dios yet' winh, ak'jokab' el winh t'a libre yuj, xchi heb'.
Yel toni, a ach ix in ak' aljok. Ayik wanto in chuni t'a in nun, ix in a tanhwej.
Atax ix in alji ix in ochkan t'a yol a k'ab'. Atax ay in ek' t'a yol sk'o'ol in nun, in Diosal achtaxoni.
Yuj chi' jun, manh a b'esel a b'a t'ayin. Ay in och t'a niwak yahelal, malaj pax mach tz'och wet'ok.
Toxo ix oymaj heb' ajk'olal t'a in patik, icha wal juntzanh owal wakax t'a yol yik Basán, icha wal chi' heb'.
Toxonhej sjalali sjaj heb' icha wal junok nok' choj. Sjak sti' heb', sjawi juknaj heb' t'ayin.
Wan yelkan wip, icha wal tz'aj stob'b'at ha ha'. Toxo ix yaktej sb'a in b'akil, a wal in pixan, toxo ix ulaxb'at t'a yol in k'o'ol icha wal nok' chak'ib'.
Toxo ix takji yol in jaj, icha wal junok takinh lu'um. Toxo ix k'e lotzan wak' stakji, ix in ak'anem t'a skal pokok icha wal junok chamnak.
Jun wal nhilanh heb' chuk ix och b'uyan t'ayin icha wal nok' tz'i', ix yol in k'ab' heb' yet' wok.
Syal in b'isan masanil in b'akil. Yakb'an wan wab'an sya'il chi', haxo heb' chuk chi', k'elannhej och heb' t'ayin.
Ha in pichul, ix spukek' heb' t'a spatik. Haxo t'a in pichul jukan, ix yak' suerte heb'.
Ha hachxo Mamin Jehová, Wipumal aji. Manh ach najatb'okb'at t'ayin. Kolin, kotanh elanhchamel t'ayin.
Kolin, manh in a cha xikjokchamok, manh in a cha smilcham heb' anima icha nok' tz'i'.
Kolinel t'a sti' juntzanh heb' icha nok' choj chi', kolinel t'a sch'a'ak juntzanh icha wal nok' k'ultakil wakax chi'.
Ol walanel ab'ixal t'a heb' wetchonhab'. Ayik ol smolb'an sb'a heb', ol ach in b'itej t'a skal heb', ol walan icha tik:
Mach onh ay yelk'och Jehová t'a ko sat, kalek wach' lolonel t'ay. B'inajnakokab' ku'uj masanil onh yinhtilal onh winhaj Jacob. Masanil onh yinhtilal onh Israel, kak'ekem ko b'a t'ay.
Ha Jehová maj yaktejkanlaj heb' ayoch syahelal. Manh tonhejok ix yilochi, maj sk'ub'ejel-laj sb'a. Ayik ix sk'anan skolwal heb', ix sk'anab'ajej Jehová chi' yab'ani, xin cham t'a heb'.
Mamin Jehová, ol ach in b'itej t'a yichanh junok sniwan molchajelal heb' a chonhab' yet' t'a yichanh heb' tzach xajanani. Ol wak'elk'och in ti' ix wak' t'ayach.
Ol wa heb' meb'a', ol b'ut'jokkan sk'o'ol heb'. Ol och heb' ejmelal t'a Jehová, ol yal wach' lolonel heb' t'ay, pitzannhej heb' t'a masanil tiempo.
Masanil juntzanh ch'ok nacional yet' yinhtilal kajan t'a slajwub'k'och sat lu'um tik, ol nachajkot Jehová yuj heb', ol ja heb' t'ay, ol em kuman heb' t'a yichanh.
Yujto a Jehová ay yik masanil opisio, a Yajal yaj t'a masanil nación t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Masanil heb' b'eyum ol wa heb', ol yak'anem sb'a heb' ejmelal t'a Jehová. Masanil heb' chamelb'a yaji, ol em kuman heb' t'a yichanh yujto malaj mach syal skolan sb'a t'a chamel.
Ha heb' ichikinab'il t'a yik b'ak'inh, ol yak'em sb'a heb' t'a Jehová. Ol alchajel yab'ixal winh Yajal t'a heb' anima toto ol aljok.
Ha yab'ixal stojolal yet' swach'il tas sb'onak, ol alchaj t'a heb' toto ol aljok chi'.
Mamin Jehová Wilumal aji. Icha junok tanhwum kalnel aj t'ayin, yuj chi' malaj tas syak' palta t'ayin.
Ichato a b'aj yax anh ank'ultak tzak' wik' wip. Ichato ha t'a ha ha' malali sb'eyi, hata' tzin ik'b'ati.
Tzak'an wip t'a junjun k'u, tzin ik'anb'at t'a yoltak b'e wach', icha yaj alannakkani.

Mamin, wach'chom tzin ek' t'a ch'olkixtak b'aj te k'ik'k 'inal, max in xiwlaj yuj junok tas ay smay, yujto ayach ek' wet'ok. Icha junok winh tanhwum kalnel yet'nak te' sk'okoch yet' pax jun te' ay sch'okal, icha chi' tzutej in a tanhwani, yuj chi' max in xiwlaj.
Tza b'o in wa'el t'a yichanh heb' wajk'o'ol. Tzak'k'e aceite t'a in jolom, tzak'an b'ut'jok in waso masanto tz'el malnaj t'a sti'.
Ha a wach'k'olal yet' b'aj tzin a xajanej aynhejek' wet'ok yakb'an pitzan in. Mamin Jehová, ol in aj kajan b'aj ayach t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha Jehová ay yik lum lum tik. Ha ay pax yik masanil tastak ay t'a sat lu'um.
Yujto a ix b'o'anem yich lum lum tik t'a yich ha' mar yet' t'a yich ha' niwak ha'.
¿Mach heb' syal sk'ek'och t'a jun tzalan to yik Jehová? ¿Mach heb' syal yajek' b'aj syal sb'a heb' anima t'a Jehová chi'?
Haton heb' tik syal sk'ek'ochi: Eb' malaj chukal sk'ulej, heb' te wach' spensar, heb' max yak'em sb'a t'a juntzanh komon Dios, heb' max skomon ak'ej sti' yuj yak'an musansatil junokxo anima.
Ha Jehová Dios Skolumal heb', a tz'ak'an wach'ilal t'a heb'. Syak'anpax spak t'a heb' icha smojal yuj swach'il heb' chi'.
Icha chi' sb'eyb'al heb' snib'ej yoch t'a yichanh Dios Kajalil a onh yinhtilal onh kan Jacob.
Ex aj Jerusalén, jakek jun sniwan puerta'il he chonhab' aytaxon t'a peka'. Jakek te' sik'lab'il yik wach' tze cha wal jun Rey t'a tzalajk'olal, haton jun Te B'inajnak.
¿Mach jun Rey Te B'inajnak chi'? Haton Jehová, te ay yip, te ay spoder. Ha Jehová syak'nhej ganar owal.
Ex aj Jerusalén, jakek jun sniwan puerta'il he chonhab' aytaxon t'a peka'. Jakek te' sik'lab'il yik wach' tze cha wal jun Rey t'a tzalajk'olal, haton jun Te B'inajnak.
¿Mach jun Rey Te B'inajnak chi'? Ha Jehová Yajal t'a smasanil, haton Rey Te B'inajnak.
Mamin Jehová, tik wal swal in b'a t'ayach.
Ach in Diosal, a achnhej tzach wak'och yipok in k'o'ol. Manh in aktejkan t'a skal niwak k'ixwelal. Manh in a cha yak' ganar heb' ajk'o'ol yajoch t'ayin yik max tzalaj heb' in stzetzani.
Wojtak wal to a masanil heb' tzach ak'anoch yipok sk'o'ol, manh ol k'ixwokel-laj heb'. Ha heb' schichon sk'ol t'ayach t'a nab'anhej, k'ixwokab'el heb'.
Mamin Jehová, ch'ox a b'e t'ayin. T'a juntzanh a b'e chi' tzin ik' b'eyok.
k'ayb'ej in t'a a lolonel te yel, yik wach' tzin b'ey t'a wach'il, yujto in Diosal ach, in Kolumal ach. Ha achnhej tzach wak'och yipok in k'o'ol t'a masanil tiempo.
Mamin Jehová, nakot a chamk'olal yet' a wach'k'olal, jun toxonton ix ak' kila'.
Haxo pax juntzanh in mul jun, manhxo a nakoti. Manhxo'okab' a nakot in chukal t'a yiktax ix wak'an kelemal. Mamin, tzin a nakot yet' a niwan chamk'olal yet' a wach'k'olal.
Mamin Jehová, wach' ach toni, tojol ach toni. Yuj chi' tza tojolb'itej sb'eyb'al heb' sk'ulan chukal.
Tza ch'oxan pax heb' emnakil t'a sb'e'al tojolal, haton b'eyb'al tza nib'ej.
Yuj a wach'k'olal, yujto tza k'anab'ajej pax tas tzala', yuj chi' tza kuchb'ej heb' sk'anab'ajan a cheknab'il icha syal a trato.
Mamin Jehová, te niwan in chukal. Ak' in niwank'olal icha wal ix utej halani.
Ha mach tzach k'anab'ajani, tza k'ayb'ej heb'. T'a jun b'e wach' tzik'b'at heb'.
Toxonton tzik'cha'anh heb'. Ha heb' yuninal heb' ol ikankan lum lum tik.
Ha heb' ay elk'och t'a sat, haton heb' ay xiwk'olal t'ayach, tzak' razón t'a heb', tzak'an pax elk'och a trato t'a heb'.
Mamin Jehová, anhej t'ayach ayoch in pensar. Ha ach ol in a kolel t'a ch'anh ya'al.
Mamin, ilinkoti, ok'ok wal a k'o'ol t'ayin. Ina to in ch'okojil, te ay in och t'a ilk'olal.
Ix te niwanb'i wilk'olal tik, kolinel t'a in somk'olal.
Ilinkot t'a in kusk'olal yet' t'a in yahelal, tzak'ankan niwank'olal in chukal.
Il tonab'i, manh jantakok heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, ste chichonoch sk'ol heb' t'ayin.
Tanhwej in, manh in a cha chamok, manh in a chab'at t'a niwak k'ixwelal, yujto a t'ayach tzin kol in b'a.
Komonok tzin a kolo', yujto wach' in b'eyb'al, malaj in mul. Ha ach ayachoch yipok in k'o'ol.
Ach in Diosal, kolonhkanel a onh israel onh tik t'a ko kusk'olal yuj masanil syahelal.
Mamin Jehová, ch'oxkaneli to malaj in mul, yujto anhej tas wach' ayoch t'a in pensar in k'ulani. Mamin, ayach och yipok in k'o'ol, malaj in chab'k'olal t'ayach.
Mamin, ilin, b'eytzitej in pensar yet' tas tzin nib'ej.
Yujto max b'atkanlaj a wach'k'olal satk'olal wu'uj, tzach in k'anab'ajejnhej.
Manh junnhejoklaj tzin ek' yet' heb' ixtum anima. Malaj b'aj junnhej tzin ek' yet' heb' chab' sat.
Tzin yajkanel smolchajelal heb' chuk chi'. Wal yel malaj b'aj wach' wak'an yet' heb' tz'ixtanb'at wach' b'eyb'al.
Tzin b'ikel in k'ab' yuj in ch'oxaneli to malaj in chukal. Ichato chi' b'i'an tzin ek' oyoyok t'a spatik yichanh altar,
swalan wach' lolonel t'a b'ital, swalanel masanil tas satub'tak tza b'o'o.
Mamin Jehová, tzin xajanej a templo b'aj kajan ach ek'i. Hata' tz'alchajel sniwanil elk'ochi.
Manh ik'el in k 'inal yet' heb' sk'ulan chukal. Manh in a satel yet' heb' milum anima,
yujto anhej chukal snib'ej heb' sk'ulej, b'ekan sk'ol heb' scha'an k'e'en tumin yik smontaji.
Ha inxo jun, tzin nib'ej tzin b'eynhej t'a in wach'ilal, yuj chi' kolinel Mamin, ok'ok wal a k'o'ol t'ayin,
yik tek'annhej waj t'a b'eyb'al wach'. Mamin Jehová, ol wal wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a skal heb' molanek' t'a ichanh.
Ha Jehová tz'ak'an sakil k'inal t'ayin, in Kolumal paxi. ¿Machto wal b'aj syal in xiwi? Ha tzin kolani, yuj chi' malaj b'aj tzin xiwi.
Ha heb' chuk smol sb'a t'a in patik yik tzin satanel heb' yalani, palta a heb' ayoch ajk'olal chi' t'ayin, ol lajwokel heb'.
Wach'chom junok b'ulan soldado tz'och hoyan t'a in patik wichanh, wal yel, manh ol in xiwlaj. Wach'chom sk'e wa'an heb' yak' owal wet'ok, hanheja' wak'anoch Dios yipok in k'o'ol.
Junnhej wal tas tzin k'an t'a Jehová, haton jun tik tzin nib'ej: To tzin ek' t'a stemplo Dios yakb'an pitzan in yik swil sniwanil yelk'och Dios chi', swak'anpaxem in b'a t'ay.
Ayik ol jawok yahelal t'a wib'anh, a ol in k'ub'anelok. Ha t'a skajnub', hata' ol in sk'ub'ejeli. Ol in yik'k'e t'a yib'anh junok k'e'en yik tzin kolchajkaneli.
Ichaton wal chi' ol aj in skolankanel t'a heb' ajk'o'ol oyanoch t'a in patik wichanh. T'a skal aw yet' tzalajk'olal ol wak' in silab' t'a Jehová t'a yol stemplo. Ol wal wach' lolonel t'a b'ital t'ay.
Mamin, a t'ayach tzin awaji, cha ab' t'ayin. Ok'ok wal a k'o'ol t'ayin, tak'wanh t'ayin.
Mamin Jehová, a in pensar ix halan t'ayin to tzin nitzkot in b'a t'a a tz'ey. Yuj chi' swak' wip in nitzanoch in b'a t'a a tz'ey chi'.
Manh a k'ub'ejel a b'a t'ayin. Manh in a chek meltzaj yet' yowal a k'o'ol. Ha achtaxon tzin a kolo'. Ach in Diosal in Kolumal ach, manh in aktejkan in ch'okoj.
Mamin Jehová, wach'chom tzin yaktejkan heb' in mam in nun, palta a ach ol in a tanhwej.
Mamin, ch'ox a b'e t'ayin, ik' in b'at t'a yol b'e tojol, yuj heb' ajk'o'ol snib'an in yak'an telwok.
Manh in ak'kanoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin. Sk'e wa'an heb' t'a in patik, syesan in mulok heb'. Snib'ej heb' tzin yak' chamok.
Mamin Jehová, swak'och t'a in k'o'ol to ol a ch'ox a wach'k'olal t'ayin yakb'an pitzan hinto, tato ma'ay, toxom ix pax wip na'ik.
Ex wetchonhab', ak'ekoch Jehová yipok he k'o'ol. Tek'tek' tzeyutej he b'a, manh eyak' chab'ax he k'o'ol. Wal yel, ak'eknhejoch Jehová yipok he k'o'ol.
Mamin Jehová, anhej t'ayach swal in b'a, icha nhak'e'en aj t'ayin, manh ach b'at mikan t'ayin. Tato max ach kolwaj t'ayin, haton wal in b'at t'a skal heb' chamnak chi' b'i'an.
Mamin, snib'ej in k'o'ol tzab'i ayik swalan in b'a t'ayach. Swik'k'e in kab' t'a yol a templo, tzin k'anan a kolwal.
Manh ak' in yahelal icha tzutej heb' sk'ulan chukal, haton heb' stz'akan yal wach' lolonel t'a heb' yetanima'il, palta anhej chukal sna heb' t'a spatik heb' anima chi'.
Ak' spak t'a heb', icha syal tastak sk'ulej heb', icha syal tas chukal sk'ulej heb', ichato chi' b'i'an, tzak'anoch syahelal heb'.
Malaj yelk'och juntzanh tastak ix a b'o t'a yol sat heb'. Ha heb' chi' ol a satkanel heb', manhxo ol ik'chajk'e wa'an heb'.
Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová, yujto ix yab' tas ix wal t'a skal in yahelal.

Ha Jehová Wipumal, ha' tzin kolan icha junok k'e'en k'e'en tz'och wenhulok. Ha swak'och yipok in k'o'ol, tz'ochnhej wet'ok, yuj chi' manh jantakok stzalaj in k'o'ol. Tzin b'itani, swak'an pax yuj diosal t'ay.
Ha Jehová ayoch yipumalok heb' schonhab', skolwajpax t'ayin, to sreyal in heb', sik'b'il in el yuj.
Mamin Jehová, kolkanel a chonhab', ak'kot a wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh heb' iktaxoni. Tanhwej heb' t'a masanil tiempo.
Ex aj satcha'anh, alek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová. Alek wach' lolonel t'ay to syal yuj smasanil, te b'inajnak.
Alek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová icha t'a smojal. Hak'ekem he b'a t'ay t'a stemplo te wach' yilji.
Ha Jehová Dios te niwan yelk'ochi, tz'ab'chaj sjaj t'a yib'anh ha' mar. Ha tz'ak'an k'anh k'u, a tz'ak'an mandar t'a yib'anh ha' owal mar chi'.
Ha sjaj Jehová tz'ab'chaji, manh jantakok spoder. Yuj sjaj chi' scheklaji to te niwan yelk'ochi.
Yuj yaw Jehová sjekchajkanb'at te' k'ute'. Yuj Jehová spojkan juntzanh te' niwak k'ute' t'a Líbano.
Ha juntzanh lum niwak witz yik Líbano yet' lum yik Sirión, tz'ib'xi lum yuj Jehová. Sk'e b'akhnaj lum witz chi', icha sk'e chennaj junok nok' kelem wakax.
Ha yaw Jehová, a tz'ak'ankot kopnaj lheb'lon.
Ha yaw Jehová tz'ak'an ib'xok lum tzinan lu'um. A' tz'ak'an ib'xok lum tzinan lu'um yik Cades.
Ha yuj yaw Jehová tz'el jekeljok sk'ab'tak te' ji, haxonhej yib' te' skan t'a sat lum witz. Haxo t'a stemplo tz'alchaj wach' lolonel t'ay yuj heb' anima smasanil.
Ha Jehová ak'annak yajalil t'a jun ha' owal ha' mukwajum. Yajal yaj t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha tz'ak'an yip heb' schonhab'. Yuj swach'il sk'o'ol Jehová, syak' junk'olal t'ayonh a onh schonhab' onh tik.
Mamin Jehová, tzach in b'itej yet' in wach' lolonel, yujto ix in a sik'k'e wa'an t'a skal in niwan yahelal, maj in a cha b'uchjok yuj heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin.
Mamin, in Diosal ach, ix in k'an a kolwal, ix ak'an b'oxok in k'o'ol.
Mamin, a ach ton ix in a kolel t'a chamel. Ix ak' in k 'inal, maj in a chab'atlaj t'a skal heb' chamnak.
B'itananhek t'a Jehová, mach ex to schonhab' ex, b'itejek yujto anhej Te Niwan Yelk'ochi.
Yujto junnhej rato ay yowal sk'o'ol, haxo swach'k'olal aynhejek' t'a masanil tiempo. Wach'chom tzonh ok' t'ak'walil, haxo yik sk'inhib'i sja ko tzalajk'olal.
Ayik te wach' waji, ix in na' icha tik: Malaj b'ak'inh ol in telwok yuj junok tas, xin chi.
Mamin Jehová, yuj wal swach'il a k'o'ol, ix in ak'kanoch b'aj malaj tas tzin ik'ani. Palta ayik ix ik'anel a b'a t'ayin, ix somchajkanel in k'o'ol.
Mamin, ix ach wawtej, ix walan in b'a t'ayach:

¿Tasto a ganar t'ayin, k'inalok tato tzin chami, tzin mukchaji? Manhxo ol yal-laj ach sb'itan heb' toxo ix och pokokal. Manh ol yal pax laj yalan wach' lolonel heb' t'ayach yuj swach'il tas ix a b'o'o, xin chi.
Mamin Jehová, ab' wal tas swala', ok'ok wal a k'o'ol t'ayin. Mamin, ochannhej wet'ok.
Ix ak'an k'exmaj in yahelal t'a tzalajk'olal. Ix ik'anel in kusk'olal, ix ak'ankanoch k'apak pichul yik k'inh in pichulok.
Yuj wal chi' jun, ach Jehová in Diosal, max yal-laj wem numan. Tzin b'itan t'ayach t'a aloj wach' lolonel yet' ak'oj yuj diosal t'ayach t'a masanil tiempo.
Mamin Jehová, anhej t'ayach tzin kol in b'a. Malajokab' b'ak'inh tzin a cha somchajeli. Kolinel yuj a tojolal.
Ak'kot tz'eyan a chikin t'ayin, tzin a kolan t'a elanhchamel. Ochanh in nhak'e'enok b'aj ol in kol in b'a.
Yujto in nhak'e'en ach, in cuartel ach, yuj chi' ochanh wenhulok. Ik' in b'eyok yik manh ol ach alchaj chukal.
Kolin t'a jun ya'al ix em t'a wichanh, yujto in Kolumal ach.
Mamin Jehová, ach in Diosal, swak'kanoch in b'a t'a yol a k'ab'. Ha ach tzin a kolkaneli, to tz'elk'och syal a lolonel.
Tzin chakel heb' anima syak'em sb'a t'a juntzanh komon Dios malaj yelk'ochi. Ha inxo Mamin Jehová, tzach wak'och yipok in k'o'ol.
Tzin tzalaj wal yuj a wach'k'olal. Ha ach ix ik'el in kusk'olal, ojtak pax in yahelal.
Maj in ak'kanoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' wajk'o'ol. Te lewan b'aj ix in kan u'uj.
Mamin Jehová, ok'okab' wal a k'o'ol t'ayin, yujto ay in och t'a ilk'olal. Ix te chakb'i in sat wok'i, manhxalaj yip in pixan yet' in niwanil.
Ha in k 'inal slajwi'em t'a skal in yahelal. Ha wab'ilal slajwi'el yuj in k'akwi. Ha kusk'olal tz'ik'anel wip, k'ununi yel yip in niwanil tik swab'i.
Tzetzab'il in yuj heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, b'uchb'il in yuj heb' kajan t'a in lak'anil. Yajb'il in kanel yuj heb' ojtannak in. Ha heb' tzin ilan t'a yoltak b'e, tz'el heb' t'ayin.
Junelnhej ix in b'atkan satk'olal yuj heb'. Icha wal to manhxo in anima'ok swab'i, icha wal junok lum xalu pojnak, icha chi' waji.
Swab' sajson heb' wetchonhab' t'a in patik. Yalxonhej b'ajti'il, ay xiwk'olal sja t'ayin. Junlajanxonhej sna'an heb' t'a in patik. Nanon yek' sk'o'ol heb' tas syutej in yak'anchamok.
Ha inxo jun Mamin Jehová, a achnhej ayachoch yipok in k'o'ol. Toxonton swala': Ha ach wal tik, in Diosal ach, xin chi.
Yol wal a k'ab' ay in k 'inal. Kolinel t'a heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, haton heb' tzak'anoch wu'uj.
Il in wal och a in a chekab' in tik yuj swach'il a k'o'ol, tzin a kolanel yuj a wach'k'olal.
Mamin, wan walan in b'a t'ayach. Manh in ak'b'at t'a niwak k'ixwelal. Ha heb' chuk tzak'kanb'at t'a niwak k'ixwelal chi', tzak'ankanb'at heb' b'aj tzinan, b'aj ay heb' chamnak.
Ha heb' sna'ank'e lolonel, numk'ajokab' heb', yujto syal lolonel heb' ya t'a heb' anima wach'. Spatikejel heb' wach' spensar heb', sb'uchwaj heb' t'a heb' wach' chi'.
Yel ton wal niwan a wach'k'olal tzak' t'a heb' tzach ik'ancha'anh. T'a yichanh heb' anima tzak' a wach'ilal t'a heb' tzach ak'anoch yipok sk'o'ol.
Ha t'a a tz'ey tza k'ub'ejel heb' t'a chukal sna heb' puch winak. Ha b'aj ay ach tza kolel heb' t'a schukal lolonel heb' ajk'olal yajoch t'a heb'.
Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'ayach Mamin Jehová, yujto satub'tak tas ix a b'o t'ayin yuj a wach'k'olal, ayik oyanoch heb' ajk'o'ol t'a in patik wichanh.
Ha wal yik manhxo anima'ok in k'o'ol, ix in na' to ix in ik'kanel t'a ichanh, haxo wal yik ix in k'anan a kolwal, ix ab' in tewi.
Xajanejek Jehová, masanil ex yikexxo yujto ha' stanhwan heb' sk'anab'ajani, palta tz'akan syutej yak'an yahelal t'a yib'anh heb' syik'cha'anh sb'a.
Tek'b'ejek he b'a mach ex tzeyak'och Jehová yipok he k'o'ol.
Te wach' yik heb' tz'ak'chaj lajwok smul, sukchaj sat schukal heb'.
Te wach' yik heb' syal Jehová to manhxalaj smul heb' t'a yichanh, haton heb' maxtzak k'ub'anel smul t'a heb' yetanima'il.
Ayik manto walk'etalaj in mul, yelxo wal ijan ix lajwi'el in niwanil ix wab'i, yujto ix in te k'akwi.
Ach in Diosal, k'uhal t'ak'wal yelk'olal ix ak'och in yahelal. Icha wal anh takinh ank'ultak stakji'el yuj waresma, ichinta ix wab'i.
Ichato chi' ix walank'eta in mul chi' t'ayach, malaj tas ix in k'ub'ejeli. Ix el wal t'a in k'o'ol walan in b'a t'ayach. Ha hachxo Mamin Jehová ix in ak' niwank'olal.
Yuj wal chi' jun, yalokab' sb'a heb' tzach k'anab'ajani yakb'an tzato yala'. Wach'chom sja yahelal icha ha' eluma', palta max yamchajlaj heb' yuj.
Ha ach ay ach och wenhulok, a ach ol in a kolel t'a yahelal. Tzach in b'itej yujto ix in a koleli.
Ix yal Jehová t'ayin: Ol ach in k'ayb'ej t'a tas ol a k'ulej. Ol in ch'ox t'ayach b'ajtil ol ach b'atok, ol ach in tanhwej.

Manh utej a b'a icha nok' chej ma icha junok nok' mula, a juntzanh nok' chi' max nachajel-laj yuj nok'. Yowalil syamchajoch wa'an nok' yet' k'e'en freno. Tato manh ichokta tz'utaj nok', max sk'anab'ajejlaj nok', xchi Jehová t'ayin.
Ha heb' chuk sb'eyb'al, manh jantakok yahelal ol kot t'a yib'anh heb'. Haxo heb' ayoch Dios yipok sk'o'ol, a swach'k'olal Dios chi' ol moyank'e heb'.
Hak'ek tzalajb'ok he k'o'ol t'a Jehová ex anima wach' he pensar. B'itananhek t'a tzalajk'olal he masanil ex ayex och t'a stojolal.
Ex anima wach' he pensar, b'itejek Jehová t'a tzalajk'olal. Yujto a heb' anima tojol sb'eyb'al, smojton wal sb'itan heb' t'a Jehová chi'.
Alek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová yet' te' arpa. B'itananhek t'ay yet' salterio lajunhe' sch'anhal.
B'itananhek t'a Jehová yet' ak' b'it. Wach' tzeyutej he b'itan t'ay t'a tzalajk'olal.
Yujto a slolonel Jehová yel toni. Ha tas sb'o'o, a sch'oxaneli to syak'elk'och tas syala'.
Ha Jehová, a tojolal yet' wach' b'eyb'al snib'ej. Sch'oxel sb'a swach'k'olal t'a masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Tonhej ix yal Jehová, ix b'o satcha'anh yet' masanil tastak ay t'ay.
A' ix molb'ankan ha ha'. Ha ha' mar tonhej malanek' ha' t'a yet'tal yuj.
Ayokab' yelk'och Jehová t'a masanil tastak ay t'a sat lu'um tik. E masanil kajan ex t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ayokab' he xiwk'olal t'a Jehová.
Yujto ha' ix halani, ix b'o smasanil. A' ix halani, wach' ix ajkan masanil tas.
Ha Jehová smak'an lajwok spensar juntzanh ch'ok nacional.
Haxo tas sna'a, aynhej ek' t'a masanil tiempo.
Tzalajk'olal yik junok nación to a Jehová ayoch sDiosalok, to sik'b'ilel yuj yik tz'och yikok.
Ha t'a satcha'anh k'elanemta Jehová, syilanemta masanil anima.
Ha b'aj kajanek' Jehová syilkot masanil heb' kajan t'a sat lu'um tik.
A' ixb'o'an spensar heb' smasanil. Hanheja' pax smaklan yila' tas sk'ulej heb'.
Manh yujok to te niwan sb'isul soldado ol kolchajel junok yajal. Manh yujok to te ay yip junok soldado, ol kolchajok.
Ha nok' chej, malaj yopisio nok' skolan heb' anima. Wach'chom te ay yip nok', palta max yal-laj skolwaj nok'.
Ha Jehová k'elanoch t'a heb' ay xiwk'olal t'ay, haton heb' ayoch swach'k'olal yipok sk'o'ol.
Skoljikanel heb' yuj t'a chamel, tz'ak'ji wa heb' yuj t'a stiempo'al wejel.
Ha onh tik, a Jehová skak'och yipok ko k'o'ol. A' tzonh kolani, tzonh stanhwan paxi.
Yuj chi' stzalajb'i ko k'o'ol yuj. Skak'anoch yipok ko k'o'ol, yujto Axonhejochi.
Mamin Jehová, ayokab'och a wach'k'olal t'ayonh, yujto tzach kak'och yipok ko k'o'ol.
Swik'cha'anh Jehová t'a masanil tiempo, swalnhej wach' lolonel t'ay.
Ha t'ay stzalaj in k'o'ol. Ab'ek ex anima emnakil, tzalajanhek.
Alekel yab'ixal sb'inajnakil Jehová wet'ok, junnhej skutej kik'anek cha'anh.
Ix in awaj t'a Jehová, ix tak'wi t'ayin, ix yik'kanel masanil in xiwk'olal.
Ha heb' tz'ak'anoch Jehová yipok sk'o'ol, stzetzon sat heb' yuj tzalajk'olal, malaj b'aj sk'ixwi heb'.
Ix wal in b'a t'a Jehová, wach'chom te malaj welk'ochi, haxo ix ab'ani, ix in skolanel t'a masanil wilk'olal.
Ha heb' ay yelk'och Jehová t'a sat, a yángel tzoymaj t'a spatik yichanh heb', haxo skolchaj heb' chi' yuj.
Ak'lejek heyila', ol heyilani to te ay swach'k'olal Jehová. Te wach' yik heb' skol sb'a t'a Jehová chi'.
Mach ex yikex Jehová, ayokab' yelk'och t'a he sat. Malaj tas ol yak' palta t'a heb' ay yelk'och Dios t'ay.
Ha nok' choj, tz'el yip nok' yuj wejel, haxo pax heb' syak'em sb'a t'a Jehová, malaj b'ak'inh ol yak' palta junok tas wach' t'a heb'.
Ex unin, kotanhek, ab'ek tas swala', ol ex in k'ayb'ej yik tzeyak'och he pensar t'a Jehová.
Tato syal he k'ol snajatb'i he k 'inal, he gana pax tzalajk'olal tzek' junjun k'u eyu'uj,
manhxo eyal chukal lolonel, manhxo eyesej.
Ik'ekel he b'a t'a chukal, manhxo eyak' owal, haxo wach'il tze k'ulej, tze b'eyb'alan junk'olal.
Ha Jehová stanhwan heb' anima wach' sb'eyb'al, smaklan wal yab'i ayik syalan sb'a heb' t'ay.
Ha Jehová, aykot yowal sk'ol t'a heb' sk'ulan chukal yik satel heb', yik manhxa mach ol na'an heb'.
Syab' Jehová ayik syalan sb'a heb' anima wach' spensar t'ay, skolchajkanel heb' t'a masanil yilk'olal.
Ha Jehová ayek' t'a stz'ey heb' anima manhxo anima'ok yet'nak syab'i, skolankanel heb' somchajel sk'o'ol yuj kuselal.
Ha heb' anima wach' spensar, wach'chom tzijtum tas tz'ik'an heb', haxo Jehová skolanel heb' t'a masanil juntzanh syahelal chi'.
A' stanhwan heb', malaj junok sb'akil heb' ol k'ichajok.
Haxo pax heb' sk'ulan chukal jun, a yuj schukal heb' chi' ol chamok. Ha heb' schichon sk'ol t'a heb' wach' sb'eyb'al, ol kotkan t'a yib'anh heb'.
Haxo Jehová ol kolan heb' schekab'. Ha heb' skol sb'a t'ay, manh ol kotkanlaj t'a yib'anh heb'.
Mamin Jehová, telaj a b'a yet' heb' stelaj sb'a wet'ok, ak' owal yet' heb' tz'ak'an owal wet'ok.
Ik'elta a yamk'ab' yik owal, tzul in a kolani.
Ik'elta a lanza tza makan sat heb' tzin pechan b'eyek'ok. Al t'ayin to in Kolumal ach.
Ha heb' snib'ej in chami, somchajokab'b'at heb' yuj k'ixwelal. Ha heb' snib'ej ay tas skot t'a wib'anh, meltzajokab'b'at heb' t'a spatik.
Ichokab' smatz'il ixim trigo syik'b'at ik', ichokab' ta tz'aj heb'. Pechjokab'b'at heb' yuj ángel.
K'ik'olinakokab'i, nhereriokab' sb'e heb', haxo ángel spechan heb'.
Wach'chom malaj in mul, palta ix yak'em in ya'alil heb'. Malaj in mul, palta ix sjoy jun olan heb' yik wach' tzin b'at t'a yo'ol sna'an heb'.
Yuj chi', mokab' na'anok yuj heb' ayik sjawi niwak yahelal t'a yib'anh heb'. Kanokab' heb' t'a sya'alil ix yak'em chi'. B'atokab'kan heb' t'a yol jun olan ix sb'o chi'.
Ichato chi' ol wak'an tzalajb'ok in k'ol t'ayach Jehová. Ol el lenaj ol wil yuj a kolwal.

T'a smasanil in k'o'ol ol wal icha tik: Mamin Jehová, ¿machto wal junok icha ach tik? Ha heb' meb'a' yet' heb' ayoch t'a tzapan majanil, tza kolel heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' te ay yip, to syik'ek' heb' tastak ay t'a heb', xin chama.
Skot heb' testigo esum, haxo tas manh wojtakok sk'anb'ej heb' t'ayin.
Ha in wach'k'olal chuk ix yutej heb' spaktzitan t'ayin, ix in stzuntzej kus heb'.
Ha inxo, ayik ya'ay heb', ix wak'och pichul yik kusk'olal, maxtzak in walaj yuj kusk'olal, ya swab'i. Max waktejkanlaj in lesalwi t'a in pixan yuj heb'.
Kusnak in k'o'ol ix in b'eyek'i, icha wal to a yuj junok wamigo, ma wuk'tak, ma icha in nun tzin kus yuj.
Ayik ix in telwi, ix k'e umnaj heb' smasanil in stzetzani. Ichato ch'ok anima'il in t'a heb', ichato manh in yojtakok heb'. Max yaktejkanlaj heb' in ste b'ajani.
Te ya ix in ek' yuj heb', ix in sb'uch heb', ix kot k'elan heb' t'ayin yet' schichonk'olal.
Mamin Jehová, ¿tom tonhej ol ach och k'elan yuj jun tik? Kolinel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' icha nok' choj, tz'el yaw, skot t'ayin.
Ol walel yab'ixal a wach'k'olal t'a yichanh heb' tzijtumal anima molanek'i. Ol wal wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a yichanh heb' a chonhab'.
Mokab' tzalaj sk'o'ol heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin. Mokab' reprepan sat heb' schichon sk'ol t'ayin, wach'chom malaj in mul t'a heb'.
Malaj snib'ej heb' t'a junk'olal. Snib'ej heb' snak'e esal lolonel t'a spatik heb' munil ayek'i.
Te cha'anh tz'el yaw heb' t'ayin, syalan heb': Ix kil tas ix a k'ulej chi', toxo ix kila', xchi heb'.
Mamin, ix il wal. Ak' yowalil t'a heb', manh ach najatb'okb'ati, manh ach el t'a in tz'ey.
Mamin ach Wajal, in Diosal ach, kotanh, kolin, b'o yaj tas swal tik. Ochanh wet'ok.
Ach Jehová in Diosal ach, b'o yaj t'ayin hato syal a tojolal, in gana to max in tzetzaj yuj heb'.
Mokab' yal heb' t'ayin icha tik: Ix elk'och icha ko gana. Junelnhej ix kixtejkanb'at winh, mokab' xchiok heb'.
Ha heb' stzalaj yuj in yahelal, k'ixwokab'kan heb', somchajokab'el sk'o'ol heb'. K'ixwokab'el heb' niwak winak syutej sb'a t'a wichanh.

Haxo heb' snib'ej to wach' tzin elk'ochi, tzalajokab' sk'o'ol heb'. Elokab' yaw heb' yuj tzalajk'olal. Yalokab' heb' t'a masanil tiempo: Ha Jehová, te niwan ton yelk'ochi, stzalaj wal yuj swach'il jun schekab' tik, xchiokab' heb'.
Mamin, ol walel a tojolal, ol walnhej wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal, anhej chukal chi' ayoch t'a spensar heb' sk'ulani. Malaj jab'ok yelk'och Dios t'a sat heb'.
Yujto syaloch sb'a heb' wach'il, manh ojtakab'ilok smul heb' chi' sna'ani. Max snalaj heb' yaktejkan schukal chi'.
Anhej chukal lolonel syal heb', na'umk'e lolonel heb'. Syaktejkan wach' pensaril heb', max sb'olaj wach'il heb'.
Ayik waynak heb' t'a sat sch'at, toxonhej snanonek' sk'o'ol heb' sk'ulan chukal. Manh wach'ok sb'eyb'al heb', max yal-laj sk'ol heb' syik'el sb'a t'a chukal.
Ha hachxo Mamin Jehová, te niwanxo pax a wach'k'olal, masanto t'a satcha'anh sk'ek'ochi, tzak'nhejelk'och tas tzala'.
Ek'al a wach'ilal t'a yichanh lum niwak witz. Ha a tojolal, ek'al t'a sjulal yich ha' niwak mar. Mamin Jehová, ilb'il heb' anima yet' masanil nok' nok' u'uj.
Ach Dios, satub'takxonhej a wach'k'olal, yuj chi' sko kol ko b'a t'ayach, icha nok' yunetak kaxlanh tz'och t'a yalanh snun.
Tzonh b'ut'ji yuj jun niwan wa'el tzak' t'ayonh. Ha ha ha' manhxo jantakok swach'il yuk'ji tzak' kuk'ej.
Yujto a t'ayach skot ko k 'inal icha yaj sjaj ha ha'. Yujnhej a sakil k'inal ay ko k 'inal.
Ha onh kojtak hachxo, ayokab' a wach'k'olal t'ayonh. Ha onh wach' ko pensar, kolonhkaneli.
Manh a cha yak' chukal heb' syik'cha'anh sb'a t'ayin. Manh a cha in spech b'eyek' heb' sk'ulan chukal.
Ileknab' b'ajtil ix telwi heb' sk'ulan chukal. Ix telwi heb', manhxa b'ak'inh ol k'ex wa'an heb'.
Mokab' somchajel ko k'o'ol yuj heb' sk'ulan chukal. Mokab' ko nib'ejoch sb'eyumal heb'.
Yujto elanhchamel ol satel heb', icha stakji anh ak sjochchajeli, ma icha stakji'el anh ank'ultak.
Kak'ekoch Jehová yipok ko k'o'ol, ko b'o'ek tas wach'. Konh kaneknhej kajan t'a lum lum tik, ol onh ak'jok wa t'a ak'ank'olal.
Kak'ek tzalajb'ok ko k'o'ol t'a Jehová, a ol ak'an tas sko nib'ej.
Skab'enejoch ko b'a t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová, skak'anoch yipok ko k'o'ol, a ol kolwaj ket'ok.
Haxo ol ak'an cheklaj swach'il ko b'eyb'al icha wal tz'aj scheklaj yok k'u t'a chimk'uhalil.
Numan skutejek ko b'a t'a yichanh Jehová. Niwan skutejek ko k'o'ol ko tanhwan skolwaj ket'ok. Manh kak'ek somchajel ko k'o'ol yuj heb' te wach' tz'elk'och yuj chukal sk'ulej.
Ko satekel kowal, kak'ek tup ko k'ak'alk'olal. Mokab' te chichon ko k'o'ol, ta ma'ay, chuknhej tas ol onh ajelk'ochok.
T'a wal yel ol satel heb' sk'ulan chukal, a onhxo pax skak'och Jehová yipok ko k'o'ol jun, ol ko cha ko makb'en yik b'aj ol onh kajnaj t'a lum lum tik.
Ayik jaye' k'uhal tik, manhxalaj heb' sk'ulan chukal chi'. Wach'chom ol ko sayek' heb', palta manhxo ol ilchajlaj heb' ku'uj.
Haxo heb' anima emnakil, ol aj heb' t'a sat lum lum tik, ol yak'an wal snib'ej heb' yajek' t'a junk'olal.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal, nanon yek' sk'o'ol heb' yak'an chukal chi' t'a anima wach' sb'eyb'al. Juch'uch'i sk'uxan ye heb' t'a heb' yuj chichonk'olal.
Haxo Jehová tonhej stzewaj yuj heb', yujto yojtak to lak'anxo sja yahelal t'a yib'anh heb'.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal, syik'elta yespada heb', sb'o'an sjul-lab' heb' yik wach' slajwi'el heb' emnakil anima meb'a', to smilcham heb' wach' sb'eyb'al heb' yalani.
Ha k'e'en yespada heb' chuk chi', hanheja' k'e'en ol ek' t'a spixan heb'. Haxo sjul-lab' heb' chi', ol kanhchajkanb'at te'.
Yelxo wal te wach' jab'ok tas ay t'a heb' anima wach' spensar, t'a yichanh sb'eyumal jantak heb' sk'ulan chukal.
Ol satel sb'eyumal heb' anima chuk chi' yuj Jehová, haxo heb' anima wach' spensar, ol koljok heb' yuj.
Ha Jehová stanhwan heb' malaj spalta'il, haxo tas ay t'a heb', malaj b'ak'inh ol satelok.
Ayik te chuk tiempo yujto te ay wejel, manh ol ek'laj heb' k'exab', aynhej tas ol swa heb'.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal, ol satel heb' icha wal stakji anh xumak ay t'a kaltak te'. Ha heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'a Jehová, ol satkanel heb' icha wal satem te' tab'.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal, tz'och heb' majan, maxtzak yak' meltzaj smajan heb' chi'. Haxo heb' anima wach' spensar, ay yok'elk'olal heb', elb'ennhej yel yuj heb'.
Ha heb' scha'an swach'k'olal Jehová, a heb' ol kajan lum lum, haxo pax heb' chuk katab'il yuj, ol ik'chajel heb' t'a sat lu'um.
Ha Jehová skuchb'an b'ey heb' anima wach' spensar ayik wan sb'ey heb' t'a tojolal.
Wach'chom stelwi heb', palta max ek'laj tiempo sk'exwan heb', yujto yamb'il sk'ab' heb' yuj Jehová.

Atax t'a in kelemal masanto yik icham winak inxo tik, malaj b'aj ix wil yaktajkan junok anima wach' spensar yuj Jehová yik tzek' t'a syahelal. Malaj pax b'aj ix wil yuninal heb' wach' sb'eyb'al chi' sk'anan wa sb'a t'a titak pat.
Tz'ok'nhej sk'o'ol heb' wach' pensar chi' t'a heb' yetanima'il, aynhej tas syak' heb' majanil. Haxo yuninal heb' chi', syik'kot yaxilal heb' t'a skal heb' yetanima'il.
Yuj chi', kaktejekkan chukal, sko k'ulan wach'il, ichato wal chi' wach' ol onh aj t'a masanil tiempo.
Yujto stzalaj Jehová yet' tojolal, malaj b'ak'inh syaktejkan heb' sk'anab'ajan t'ay. T'a masanil tiempo skolchajel heb'. Haxo yinhtilal heb' sk'ulan chukal, satji'el heb' yuj Jehová chi'.
Ha heb' anima wach' spensar chi' ol ik'ankan lum lum tik, ol kajnajek' heb' t'a lum t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha heb' wach' sb'eyb'al, slolon heb' t'a jelanil, wach'nhej tas syal heb'.
Ha sk'ayb'ub'al Dios yet'nak heb', yuj chi' malaj b'aj ol em heb' t'a chukal.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal, aynhejoch sat heb' t'a heb' anima wach' sb'eyb'al, snib'ej heb' smilcham heb'.
Palta manh ol ak'chajkanlaj heb' wach' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' chuk chi' yuj Jehová. Manh ol stak'laj Dios skotkan t'a yib'anh heb' wach' t'a yichanh ley.
Kak'ekoch Jehová t'a ko k'o'ol, sko k'anab'ajanek. A' ol onh ik'ancha'anh. Ol yak' lum lum tik t'ayonh. Ol kil wal satel heb' sk'ulan chukal.
Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal, ix wil wal yixtan heb' yetanima'il heb', ix yik'chanh sb'a heb', niwakil syutej sb'a heb' icha junok te te' manh jantakok sk'ab', te yax xi'il.
Palta ix satel heb', manhxalaj mach ix kani. Ix in say heb', palta majxo ilchajlaj heb' wu'uj.
Scham wal kilan heb' wach' spensar max k'ulanlaj chukal chi', te wach'nhej ol elk'och heb' yujto a junk'olal sayek' heb'.
Haxo heb' pit, ol satjokel heb'. Ol satjokpaxel yinhtilal heb' b'ak'inh.
Ha Jehová skolanel heb' anima wach' spensar. A' ayoch yenhulok heb' ayik sja yahelal.
A' ol kolanel heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' sk'ulan chukal, yujto ha' ayoch yipok sk'o'ol heb'.
Mamin Jehová, manh ak' in yahelal yuj yowal a k'o'ol. Manh ak' in yahelal yakb'an aykot a k'ak'alk'olal.
Toxo ix och tzolan a jul-lab' t'ayin, ix ak'och in yahelal.
Ha yuj yowal a k'o'ol chi', masanil in niwanil tik te ya' ay swab'i, yujnhej to ix och in mul t'ayach.
Ha in chukal ichato k'ojank'e t'a wib'anh icha ikatz, maxtzak techajlaj wu'uj.
Yujnhej in pital, wanxo sk'e sjab' wechen yujto wan sk'ab'ati.
nhojan in emi tzin b'eyi. Junelnhej lachan waji. Maxtzak och wa'an jab'ok in kusk'olal.
Wan in cham yuj k'ixwelal swab'i. Masanil in niwanil te ya ay swab'i.
Ix te b'uychaj in niwanil tik, manhxalaj jab'ok yip. Tzin k'akwi yuj wilk'olal.
Mamin Wajalil, ojtak masanil tas tzin nib'ej. Ayik sik'son sja in k'o'ol, ichanh yaj jun tik.
Toxonhej ste tinhtinhan in pixan yab'an sya'il. Numumi yel wip, maxtzak yal-laj wilani.
Ha heb' anima wach' wak'an yet'ok yet' heb' junnhej tzin ek' yet'ok, najat sb'esel sb'a heb' t'ayin. Ha heb' kajan t'a in lak'anil, najat sb'esel sb'a heb' t'ayin yuj in yahelal.

Ha heb' snib'ej in smilanchamok, wan yak'anem in ya'alil heb'. Ha heb' snib'an yak' chukal t'ayin, anhej chukal syal heb' t'a in patik. Max ochlaj wa'an heb' sna'ub'tanhan tas ol in yutok t'a elk'altak.
Ha inxo pax jun, ichato makan in chikin, max wab'laj tas syal heb', ichato max ujilaj in loloni, malaj tas tz'elta t'a in ti'.
Lajan in icha junok mach max yab'laj, max yal-laj yalan sb'a.
Mamin Jehová in Diosal, a achnhej tzach wak'och yipok in k'o'ol, a ach ol in a tak'wej.
Ha jun tik tzin k'an t'ayach: Mokab' in stzetzej heb' ajk'ol chi'. Mokab' b'itan heb' yuj tzalajk'olal tato tzin ak'ji ganar.
Palta ijanxo wal tzin ak'ji ganar swab'i. Max och wa'an jab'ok in yahelal tik.
Ol walk'eta in mul. Manhxo in anima'ok swab' yuj in chukal.
Ha heb' ajk'ol snib'ej in chami, toxo ix te k'ib' sb'isul heb'. Manhxo jantakok ix te aj heb' tzin chakani, wach'chom malaj in mul t'a heb'.
Chuknhej syutej sb'a heb' t'ayin yuj in wach'k'olal t'a heb'. Yujnhej to tzin b'eyb'alej wach'il, tz'och heb' ajk'olal t'ayin.
Mamin Jehová, manh in aktejkani. Ach in Diosal, manh a b'esel a b'a t'ayin.
Ach Wajalil, ach in Kolumal, kotanh t'a elanhchamel tzin a kolani.
Ix wak' pensar to ol in ya'ilej in b'eyb'al, yik max och in mul yuj tas swala'. Tzin yamoch wa'an in ti' yakb'an ayek' heb' anima chuk spensar t'a wichanh.
Ix in em numnajok, majxo walpaxlaj wach' lolonel. Palta haxo in yahelal ix te niwtaji.
Wanxo stz'a in pixan ix wab'i. Yakb'an wan in te na'ub'tanhani, ix wach' och pitz'an t'a in pixan. Yuj chi' cha'anh ix in awaji, ix walani:
Mamin Jehová, ak' wal wojtakejeli to chamel b'a waji, to jayenhej ab'il in k 'inal. In gana snachajel wu'uj to elanhchamel tzek'b'at in k 'inal.
Kennhej in k 'inal ix ak'a'. Manh niwanoklaj in k 'inal t'a ichanh. Ha onh anima onh tik, icha wal kik'an jab'ok kik', icha chi' ko k 'inal.
Icha wewen kaj ko masanil. Nab'anhej sko mak' k'unb'ok ko b'a. ¿Tokwal skak' ko gana yet' ko b'eyumal sko molb'ejk'e b'ulan? Manh kojtakok mach ol ik'ankanb'atok.
Mamin Wajal, haxo tikne'ik, ¿tas wach' swak'och yipok in k'o'ol? Ha ach ton ayach och yipok in k'o'ol.
Kolinel t'a masanil in chukal. Manh in a cha b'uchjok yuj heb' chuk spensar.
Icha wal heb' max ujilaj sloloni, icha chi' ix wutej in b'a. Manhxalaj tas ix elta t'a in ti', yujto a ach tik ix ak'och juntzanh tik t'ayin.
Ik'el in yahelal ix ak'ochi. Wanxo in lajwi'el swab' yuj b'aj ix in a mak'a'.

Ha ach tzak'och ko yahelal a onh anima onh tik. Tzak'anoch ko tz'u'umal yuj ko mul. Ha ach tzak' lajwok tas nib'ab'il ku'uj, ichato tz'ijaxb'ati. Ko masanil, icha wal kik'an kik', icha chi' yek' ko k 'inal.

Mamin Jehová, ab' in lesal tik, kotanh k'elan t'ayin ayik swalan in b'a t'ayach. Manh ak' sat a k'o'ol t'a yal in sat tik. Mamin, a t'ayach, ek'elb'anhej wek' t'a sat lu'um tik icha heb' in mam wicham.
Mamin, manh ak'kot a k'ak'alk'olal t'ayin, yik wach' tzin tzalaj junok rato, yakb'an manto el-laj in k'o'ol.
Ix in tanhwejnhej skolwal Jehová, haxo ix ab'ani ayik ix in tewi t'ay.
Ix in yik'k'eta t'a jun olan te ay smay. Ix in skol b'aj sitz'atak. Ix in yak'ank'e t'a yib'anh jun k'e'en k'e'en yik tzin tek'b'ej in b'a.
Ix yak' wal jun b'it ak'to t'ayin, b'it yik aloj wach' lolonel t'a ko Diosal. Komonok sat sk'ol jantak heb' tz'ilan jun tik, yik syak'och Jehová heb' yipok sk'o'ol.
Te wach' yik heb' tz'ak'anoch Jehová yipok sk'o'ol, max yak'och spensar heb' t'a heb' syik'cha'anh sb'a, haton heb' tz'och tzak'an t'a spatik juntzanh komon Dios.

Mamin Jehová in Diosal, manh jantakok juntzanh tas satub'tak ix a b'o'o yet' jantak a wach'k'olal ix ak' t'ayonh. Malaj junok mach syal slajb'an sb'a het'ok. In gana swalel masanil a wach'k'olal chi', palta max in tzak'wanlaj, yujto manhxo b'ischajb'enok.
Max a nib'ejlaj nok' nok' yet' ixim trigo silab'il. Malaj nok' nok' tza k'ana' yik snhusji silab'il t'ayach, ma silab' yik stupkanel ko mul. Palta ix a jak in chikin yik tzin cha wab' tas tzala'.
Yuj chi' ix wala': Tik tzin ja'i, xin chi. Ha tas tz'ib'ab'ilkan t'a a lolonel, a wab'ixal syala'.
Ach in Diosal, snib'ej in k'o'ol tzin k'ulej icha a gana. Ayoch a k'ayb'ub'al t'a in pensar.
Mamin Jehová, ix walkanel yab'ixal a tojolal t'a skal heb' a chonhab'. Ojtak wal to malaj b'aj ix waktejkan walaneli.

Malaj b'aj max walel a tojolal. Ix walel yab'ixal to tz'elnhejk'och tas tzala', tzak'anpax kolnab'il. Malaj b'aj ix in k'ub'ejel t'a yichanh heb' a chonhab' molanek'i, to te niwan a wach'k'olal, yelnhej pax tzala'.
Mamin Jehová, ayokab'nhej ok'elk'olal t'ayin. Ilinnhej yet' a wach'k'olal icha ix aj halani.

Yujto te ay tas sjawi t'a wib'anh, maxtzak b'ischajlaj wu'uj. In yamchajelta yuj in chukal. Ichato maxtzak yal-laj wilani. Ek'b'al in chukal chi' t'a yichanh sb'isul xil in jolom. Wanxo somchajel in k'o'ol.
Mamin, kotanh wal k'elan t'ayin, kotanh, kolineli. Kotanh elanhchamel, tzach och wet'ok.
Ha heb' snib'ej in smilanchamok, jawokab' k'ixwelal yet' somk'olal t'a yib'anh heb'. B'atokab' heb' elelal t'a skal niwak k'ixwelal, yujto snib'ej heb' yak'an chukal t'ayin.
Ha heb' tzin b'uchani, kanokab' heb' t'a manh pensaril yuj somk'olal.
Haxo masanil heb' ayoch spensar t'ayach, tzalajokab' heb' t'ayach. Te niwan elk'och ach Jehová, xchiokab' heb' snib'an a kolwal.
Ha inxo jun, ob'iltak in, ay in och t'a ilk'olal. Mamin, mokab' in b'atkan satk'olal u'uj. Ha ach tzach ochtaxon wet'ok yik tzin a kolani. Ach Jehová in Diosal, manh ik'ek' tiempo in a kolani.
Wach' yik heb' skolwaj t'a heb' meb'a', a Jehová ol kolanel heb' t'a skal syahelal.
A' ol tanhwan heb', ol ak'jok sk'inal heb' yet' stzalajk'olal yuj t'a sat lu'um tik. Manh ol ak'jok ochlaj heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'o'ol yuj.
Ol ak'jok yip heb' t'a skal syahelal yuj Jehová, ol b'oxok sk'o'ol heb'.
Ha in ix wala': Mamin Jehová, ok'ok a k'o'ol t'ayin. Anhtej in, yel toni ay in mul t'ayach, xin chi.
Ha heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, syal chuk heb' t'ayin: Komonok spet chami yik manhxo ol nachajkotok, xchi heb'.
Sja heb' yak' in paxyal, palta manhok t'a swach'il sk'ol heb' tzul in yila'. Masanil tas syilb'at heb' t'ayin, sik'kan heb' t'a spensar, haxo t'a yoltak b'e syal in pekal heb'.
Ha heb' tzin chakaneli, smolb'ej sb'a heb', syalan in pekal heb'. Chuk tas sna heb' t'a in patik.
Syalan heb': Ha syahelal jun tik, manhxa yanhal. Toxo ix b'atkan t'a sat sch'at, manhxo ol b'oxlaj sk'o'ol, xchi heb'.
Ha jun wamigo junnhej tzin wa yet'ok, yip in k'o'ol walani, ha' ix och ajk'olal t'ayin.
Ha hachxo Mamin Jehová, ok'ok wal a k'o'ol t'ayin. Ik' in k'e wa'an yik ol wak'anek' in pak t'a heb'.
Tato manh ol tzalaj sk'o'ol heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, ichato chi' ol nachajel wu'uj to tzach tzalaj wet'ok.
Ha inxo pax jun, malaj in mul t'a ichanh, yuj chi' ix in a ketz yet' a k'ab'. Ayinnhejokab' ek' t'a ichanh t'a masanil tiempo.
Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, tikne'ik yet' t'a masanil tiempo. Ujokab'i.
Ach in Diosal, tzach in nib'ej wal icha junok nok' k'ultakil chej tzek' sayoj ha' yuj takinhti'al.
Ach Dios pitzan, a wal in pensar tzach nib'anochi, ¿b'ak'inh ol in k'och t'a ichanh junelxo?
k'uhal t'ak'wal wok'i. Haxonhej wok'el tik ayoch in wa'elok, yakb'an sb'uchwaj heb' anima t'ayin sk'anb'ejnhej heb': ¿B'ajtil ay jun a Diosal chi? xchi heb'.

Ayik tzin na'an juntzanh tik, ste och pitz'an t'a in k'o'ol. Tzin na'ankoti ayik ay in ek' t'a skal heb' anima, yik tzin kuchb'an heb', yik tzonh b'at t'a a templo. Manhxo jantakok yel yaw heb' yuj tzalajk'olal yet' ak'oj yuj diosal. Niwan k'inh ton wal jun chi'.
¿Tas wal yuj schab'axk'e in k'o'ol? ¿Tas yuj somchaj in pensar? Ach in Diosal, ayach och yipok in k'o'ol, olto wal wach' lolonel t'ayach, in Kolumal, in Diosal aji.
Ach in Diosal te kusk'olal waj tikne'ik, yuj chi', manh jantakok ach in na'ankot t'a yol yik ha' Jordán yet' t'a yol yik switzal Hermón yet' switzal Mizar.
Icha sk'anh yem ponholjok ha ha' t'a niwak pajaw, icha wal chi' juntzanh niwak kusk'olal tzek' t'a wib'anh u'uj.
Ach Jehová, ha t'a k'uhalil tza ch'oxnhej a wach'k'olal t'ayin, haxo t'ak'walil, max in och wa'an ach in b'itani, max in och pax wa'an in lesalwi t'ayach, yujto a ach tzak' in k 'inal.
Swalan icha tik t'ayach: Ach in Kolumal, ¿tas yuj tzin b'atkan satk'olal u'uj? Yuj chi' kusnak in k'o'ol ayik tzin b'eyek'i, yujto tzin yixtej wal heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, xin chi.
Swab' wal sya'il, icha wal to smak'jipoj in b'akil b'aj tzin yixtej heb' ajk'o'ol chi'. Junjun rato sb'uchwaj heb' t'ayin sk'anb'an heb': ¿B'ajtil ay jun a Diosal chi'? xchi heb'.
¿Tas wal yuj schab'axk'e in k'o'ol? ¿Tas yuj somchaj in pensar? Ach in Diosal, ayach och yipok in k'o'ol, olto wal wach' lolonel t'ayach, in Kolumal, in Diosal aji.
Ach in Diosal, ch'oxeli to malaj in mul. Ochanh walumalok t'a juntzanh anima malaj elk'och t'a yol sat tik. Kolinel t'a heb' na'umk'e lolonel yet' t'a heb' chuk sb'eyb'al.
Ach in Diosal, in Kolumal ach, ¿tas wal yuj najat tzin ik'kanel t'a ichanh? ¿Tas wal yuj kusnak in k'o'ol tzin b'eyek'i, tzin yixtan heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin?
Ch'ox a sakil k'inal t'ayin yet' a lolonel te yel, yik wach' ol in sch'ox t'a sb'e'al jun tzalan yik ejmelal b'aj kajan ach ek'i.
Ach in Diosal, ol in k'och t'a altar, hata' ol ach in b'itejnhej yet' te' arpa, yujto a ach tzak' in tzalajk'olal.
¿Tas wal yuj schab'axk'e in k'o'ol? ¿Tas yuj somchaj in pensar? Ach in Diosal ayach och yipok in k'o'ol, olto wal wach' lolonel t'ayach, in Kolumal, in Diosal aji.
Ach ko Diosal, ix kab' a poder yujto a heb' ko mam kicham ix halan t'ayonh tas utejnak heb' t'a peka'.
Yet' a poder ix a pechel juntzanh heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, ix a satankanel heb' t'a juntzanh niwak chonhab' chi', haxo heb' ko mam kicham chi' ix ak' kajnaj t'a tik.

Manhok yet' yip heb', manhok pax k'e'en yespada heb' ix yak'lab'ej ayik ix yik'an jun lu'um tik heb'. Maj yik'laj jun lu'um tik heb' t'a ak'oj owalil, palta yuj a poder, yuj ipalil yet' yuj a wach'k'olal ix yak' ganar jun owal chi' heb', yujto xajan heb' u'uj.
Ach ko Diosal, ko Reyal ach, a ach alnak, yuj chi' kak'nak ganar a onh yinhtilal onh kan winhaj Jacob tik.
Ha ach ton tzach och ket'ok, yuj chi' skak' ganar heb' ajk'o'ol chi'. Yuj ipalil skan heb' ajk'o'ol chi' t'a yalanh ku'uj.
Manhoklaj yamk'ab' yik owal skak'och yipok ko k'o'ol, manhokpaxlaj yuj k'e'en kespada ol kak' ganar owal.
Ha heb' kajk'o'ol schichonoch sk'o'ol t'ayonh, tzonh a kol t'a yol sk'ab' heb', k'ixwelal tz'ajkan heb' u'uj.
Anhej t'ayach ol kak'nhej tzalajb'ok ko k'o'ol, a achnhej ol ach ko b'itej.
Palta a tikne'ik Mamin, ix onh a patikejeli, ix onh ak'anoch t'a k'ixwelal, maxtzak yal-laj a k'o'ol tzach b'at yet' heb' ko soldado.
Ha ach ix onh aktejkani, yuj chi' ix onh el lemnaj t'a heb' kajk'o'ol. Ha heb' schichon sk'o'ol t'ayonh, ix yik'b'at heb' tastak ay t'ayonh.
Ix onh ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb', icha junok nok' kalnel tz'ik'jib'at b'aj smiljichamok. Ix onh a saklemejkanb'at t'a skal juntzanh nación.
Te yechel ix onh a chonhkanel a onh a chonhab' onh tik. Malaj jab'ok tas ix ak' ganar yuj b'aj ix onh a chonhel chi'.
Ix onh ak'an b'uchjok yuj heb' anima kajan t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a ko lak'anil. Tzonh stzuntzan heb', malaj kelk'och t'a heb'.
Ix onh ak'an b'uchjok yuj heb' ch'ok chonhab'il. Anhej wal yik tzonh yilan heb', tzonh ste tzetzan heb'.
Junjun k'u, toxonhej tzonh te em nhojan yuj k'ixwelal.
Tzonh stzuntzan heb' kajk'o'ol snib'ej onh yixtani. Malaj kelk'och t'a heb'.
Haton juntzanh tik skot t'a kib'anh, wach'chom maj ach b'atkan satk'olal ku'uj. Ina to sko k'anab'ajejnhej a trato ak'nak t'ayonh.
Max ko nalaj ach ko patikejeli. Malaj a k'ayb'ub'al ix kaktejkani.
Wach'chom icha chi', palta ichato tzonh aktejkan t'a skal nok' nok' ay smay, ichato onh a makchejem b'aj te k'ik'k 'inal.
Ach ko Diosal, k'inalok ach b'atkan satk'olal ku'uj, haxo t'a komon Dios ix kak'em ko b'a,
ix am ila', yujto malaj junok tas k'ub'eltak manh ojtakok.
Palta u'uj junjun rato ijan onh smilancham heb' ajk'ol chi', icha nok' kalnel tz'ik'jib'at b'aj schami, icha chi' tzonh yutej heb'.
Mamin, ¿tas yuj ichato waynak ach b'ati? Ilonhkoti, manh onh a patikejkanel t'a junelnhej.
¿Tas yuj tzach b'at mikan t'ayonh? ¿Tas wal yuj tzonh b'atkan satk'olal u'uj t'a skal ko niwan yahelal tik?
Toxo wan yel kip, maxtzak yal-laj ko loloni, toxonhej tzonh ek' telton t'a sat lu'um.
Pil ip. Kotanh. Kolonh eli yujto te xajan onh u'uj.
Ay wal ek' wach' lolonel t'a in pensar. Ol in b'itan t'a winh rey yet' juntzanh in lolonel chi'. Ha in ti' lajan icha stz'ib'lab' junok mach te jelan stz'ib'ani.
Ach rey, a achnhej wach' ilji t'a yichanh masanil heb' winh winak. Te wach'nhej tas tzala', te jelan a loloni yujto syak'nhej swach'k'olal Dios t'a ib'anh.
Ak'och jachan k'e'en espada t'a a nanhal, ach winak te ak'um owal, te b'inajnak ach, te ay wal elk'ochi.
Ixik t'a yib'anh nok' a chej yet' a poder yik tzak'an ganar owal, yik sb'oji yaj lolonel t'a stojolal t'a heb' emnakil. Niwan tastak satub'tak ol a k'ulej yet' ipalil.
Ach ko reyal, a jul-lab' te jay snhi' ol b'at ch'apnaj t'a snhi' sk'o'ol heb' ajk'o'ol. Yuj chi' ol telwok heb' anima yik juntzanh chonhab' t'a skal ok.
Ach ko Diosal, yajal ach t'a smasanil tiempo. Yajal ach, wach'nhej tz'aj a ch'olb'itan tastak.
Ha wal tojolal scha a k'o'ol, max schalaj a k'o'ol chukal. Yuj chi' ix ach sik'el Dios, haton a Diosal. Ix yak' niwan tzalajk'olal t'ayach t'a yichanh juntzanhxo heb' ay yopisio het'ok.
Tz'el sjab' sperfume'al mirra, áloes yet' te' canela ayoch t'a a pichul. Ha son ay sch'anhal ol ak'an tzalaj a k'o'ol t'a a pat marfilnhej ayoch yelwanub'ok.
Ay heb' ix yisil heb' winh rey t'a skal heb' awtab'il u'uj. Ha t'a a tz'ey t'a a wach', hata' ayek' ix reina. Ha k'e'en oro yelxo wal wach' ayoch t'a spichul ix.
Ach yisil rey, maklej wal ab'i, scham wal ab'an tas ol wal t'ayach. Manhxo a na heb' a k'ab' ok yet' heb' etchonhab',
yujto a winh rey chi' snib'an swach'il ilji, haton winh ajalil. Hak'em a b'a t'a winh.
Ol yak' silab' heb' aj Tiro t'ayach. Ha heb' niwak b'eyum, ol snib'ej heb' yoch amigo'ok.
Tik sja ix ix wan yoch yetb'eyumok winh rey, wach'nhej yilji ix, yisil pax ix junokxo winh rey. Oro ayoch yelwanub'ok spichul ix.
Wach'nhej yaj sb'o ix yet' spichul, tz'ik'jib'at ix t'a winh rey. Tzak'anoch heb' ix kob'estak yuk'lewok ix, haton heb' ix yamiga ix.
Stzalaj heb' ix sb'at heb' ix, masanto sk'och heb' ix t'a spat winh rey chi'.
