Yelxo wal te xajan chonhab' Sion yuj Jehová t'a yichanh juntzanhxo ko chonhab' a onh yinhtilal onh winhaj Jacob.
Manh jantakok lolonel wach' tz'alji t'a schonhab' Dios.

Syal Jehová icha tik: Ajun heb' aj Egipto yet' heb' aj Babilonia ayoch t'a skal heb' chonhab' syak'em sb'a t'ayin. Icha heb' aljinak t'a Sion, icha chi' ol aj heb' filisteo, heb' aj Tiro yet' heb' aj Etiopía t'a wichanh, xchi.
Ol alchaj t'a chonhab' Sion icha tik: Ha jun anima tik yet' junxo chi', ha t'a Sion ix alji heb', xchama. Ha Dios Ek'to t'a yib'anh smasanil ol ak'an stek'anil jun chonhab' tik.
Ayik ol tz'ib'aj sb'i heb' anima ay t'a junjun chonhab' t'a ch'anh u'um yuj Jehová, ol stz'ib'ejem icha tik: T'a Sion ix alji jun tik.
Ha heb' kajan t'a Sion ol b'itan heb', ol k'e chennaj heb' yuj tzalajk'olal, ol yalan heb': Ha t'a Sion tik skot masanil swach'k'olal Dios t'ayonh, xcham heb'.
Ach Jehová, in Diosal ach, in Kolumal aji. k'uhal t'ak'wal in k'anan a kolwal t'a wib'anh.
Cha in lesal, ak'kot a chikin t'a tas tzin k'an tik.
Manhxo jantakok tas sja t'a wib'anh, ichato ayinxo och t'a yol sk'ab' chamel, swab'i.
Ichato ayinxo och sb'isulok heb' chamnak, manhxalaj wip swab'i.

Ichato ix in aktajkanb'at t'a skal heb' chamnak swab'i. Icha heb' chamnak t'a owal, to mukb'ilxo heb' tikne'ik, icha wal chi' waj swab'i. Icha heb' ix b'atkan satk'olal u'uj, manhxalaj a kolwal t'a heb', icha chi' waj swab'i.
Ichato t'a yich jun olan b'aj smukchaj heb' chamnak, b'aj te k'ik'k 'inal ix in ak'kanem swab'i.
Ix smol sb'a yowal a k'ol t'a wib'anh. B'elb'on sjawi juntzanh yahelal t'a wib'anh u'uj.
Ix ik'kanel heb' wamigo t'ayin, yajb'entak ix in utejkan t'a heb'. Lajan in icha junok presowum max yal-laj yeli.
Maxtzak yal-laj wilan yuj b'aj tzin te ok'i. Mamin Jehová, junjun k'u swal in b'a t'ayach, tzin mojb'an in k'ab' t'ayach.
¿Tokwal tzato a ch'ox a poder t'a skal heb' chamnak? ¿Tokwal syal wach' lolonel heb' chamnak chi' t'ayach?
Ha b'aj mukan heb' chamnak chi', maxtzak b'inajlaj a wach'k'olal. Maxtzak alji paxi to a ach tik tzak'elk'och tas tzala'.
¿Tokwal ay mach t'a skal b'aj ay sk'ik'alk'inalil chamel ol ilankot a tojolal yet' tas satub'tak tza k'ulej? Ha t'a skal heb' chamnak chi' sb'atkan satk'olal smasanil.
Ha inxo pax Mamin Jehová, a t'ayach swal in b'a. Ha t'a k'inhib'alil tzin lesalwi t'ayach.
Mamin Jehová, ¿tas wal yuj tzin a patikejeli? ¿Tas wal yuj tza k'ub'ejel a b'a t'ayin?
Yiktax in kelemal masanto tikne'ik, yikxo max in chami, yujto aynhejoch in yahelal u'uj, yuj chi' maxtzak techajlaj wu'uj.
Ha yowal a k'ol tzek' t'a wib'anh, wanxo wak'ji ganar yuj.
Icha wal yowal ha' eluma' yajoch hoyan yowal a k'ol t'ayin t'a junelnhej.
Ix ik'kanel heb' wamigo yet' heb' wetanima'il t'a in tz'ey. Ha tikne'ik anhej k'ik' k'inal oyanoch t'a in patik.
Mamin Jehová, ol walnhej t'a in b'it to toxonton ay a wach'k'olal. T'a masanil tiempo ol waleli to yel tzak'elk'och tas tzala'.
Ha yab'ixal a wach'k'olal ay t'a masanil tiempo ol waleli. Ol walanpaxeli to max k'exmaj tas tzala', icha yaj juntzanh tas ay t'a satcha'anh.
Alnak: Ay jun in trato yet' winhaj David in chekab' ix in sik'eli, ix wak'kan in ti' t'a winh, ix walan t'a winh icha tik:
Ha heb' inhtilal, ol wak'nhejkanoch heb' reyal a k'exulok t'a masanil tiempo, xin chi.
Mamin Jehová, masanil heb' molanek' t'a satcha'anh, ol sb'itej heb' tas satub'tak tza k'ulej. Ol yalpaxel heb' to tzak'elk'och tas tzala'.
Mamin Jehová, malaj junokxo mach t'a satcha'anh syal slajb'an sb'a het'ok. Malaj junok heb' lajan het'ok.
Te niwan elk'och t'a skal heb' ángel. Te ay a poder t'a yichanh heb' oyanoch t'a a patik ichanh.
Mamin Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil, ¿mach wal junokxo lajan het'ok? Masanil tas syalnhej u'uj. Tzak'elk'och masanil tas tzala'.
Yol a k'ab' ayek' ha' mar ayik ste owaj ha'. Ha hachxo tzak'och wa'an ha' ayik ste k'anh ha'.
Ha nok' nok' ay smay t'a yol ha' mar, ix ach k'e tek'tek' t'a yib'anh nok', ix a tek'ancham nok'. Ix a saklemej heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach yuj a poder.
Ha satcha'anh yet' sat lum tik, ik toni. Ha ach a b'onak yol yib'anhk'inal tik yet' masanil tastak ay t'ay.
Ha norte masanto sk'och t'a sur, a ach ix a b'o'o. Ha lum witzal Tabor yet' lum witzal Hermón, sb'itan lum t'ayach.
Ha a k'ab' te ay yip. Ha a wach' k'ab', masanil syal yuj.
Ha a despacho te tek'an yaj yuj a wach'il yet' a tojolal. Ha t'a masanil scheklajel a wach'k'olal, tzak'an elk'och tas tzala'.
Mamin Jehová, te wach' yik heb' anima tzach b'itani. Tzalajk'olalnhej yik heb' yuj a wach'k'olal.
Ha wal t'ayach syak' tzalajb'ok sk'ol heb'. Yuj a tojolal tz'ik'jicha'anh heb'.
T'a wal yel, te niwan ipalil tzak' t'ayonh. Yuj a wach'k'olal syalnhej ku'uj.
Mamin Jehová, ko Kolumal aji. Ach ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, ko Reyal ach.

Ha t'a peka', ix ach lolon t'a wayichal, ix halan t'a heb' a chekab' tzach k'anab'ajan icha tik: Ix in och yet' jun soldado te tek'an, haton jun mach sik'b'ilel wuj t'a skal in chonhab', ix wak'an yopisio.
Ix ilchaj winhaj David in chekab' wu'uj, a yet' waceite yik sik'wal ix in ch'oxo' to reyxo yaj winh.
Manh ol in och wa'an in kolwaj t'a winh, yujto a in poder ol ak'an yip winh.
Ha heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'a winh, manh ol yal-laj yoch sk'ab' heb' t'a winh. Ha heb' sk'ulan chukal, manh ol tzak'wanlaj heb' t'a winh.
Ol in tek'kanem heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'a winh. Ol in milancham heb' schichonoch sk'ol t'a winh.
Ayinnhej ek' yet' winh yujto xajan winh wu'uj. Ol wak' elk'och tas swala'. Wu'ujnhej ol yalnhej yuj winh.
Ol wak' niwanb'ok smakb'en winh. Ol scha'el yich t'a ha' mar Mediterráneo masanto sk'och t'a ha' niwan Éufrates.
Ol yalan winh t'ayin: In Mam ach, in Diosal ach, a t'ayach tzin kol in b'a, xcham winh.
Ha inxo ol wak' sniwanil yelk'och winh, icha junok b'ab'el unin. Yelxo wal ek'alto sniwanil ol aj yelk'och winh t'a yichanh masanil heb' rey.
Ol in xajanej winh t'a junelnhej. Ha in trato yet' winh, manh ol k'exmajlaj.
Ha heb' yinhtilal winh ol ak'an reyal sk'exulok, ol b'eynhejb'atok yakb'an ayto ek' satcha'anh tik.
Palta tato ol yaktejkan in k'ayb'ub'al heb' yinhtilal winh chi', tato manh ol sk'anab'ajej heb' tas swala',
tato manh ol sb'eyb'alej in b'eyb'al heb', tato manh ol sk'anab'ajej in lolonel heb' swak' sk'ulej,
ol wak'och syahelal heb' yet' te' jixk'ab'te' yuj spital. Ol in mak' heb' yet' nok' tz'um yuj schukal.
Haxo pax winhaj David jun, manh ol waktejkan in xajanan winh, ol wak'nhejelk'och in ti' ix wak' t'a winh.
Manh ol ek'b'atlaj in trato yet' winh. Ol wak'nhejelk'och tas ix walkan t'a winh.
T'a junelnhej ix wak'kan in ti' t'a winhaj David chi', a in ix wak' testigo'al in b'a to manh ol in k'exa'.
Ha heb' yinhtilal winh ol ak'an reyal sk'exulok t'a wichanh t'a masanil tiempo icha yaj yok k'u tik.
Tek'annhej ol ajek' heb' yak'an yajalil, icha yaj k'e'en uj t'a satcha'anh, xa chi.
Haxo tikne'ik Mamin, ix a chakkanel winh rey a sik'nakkanelta, ix a patikejkanel winh. Ix kot owal t'a winh.
Maj ak'elk'och a trato t'a winh a chekab' chi'. Ix a yumkanel scorona winh t'a sat lu'um.
Man jantakok ix aj yolanil masanil smuro'al schonhab' winh. Ix ak' juwokem schonhab' winh.
Ha heb' anima tzek' ta', masanil tas ay t'a chonhab' chi', syelk'ejb'at heb'. Ha heb' ay t'a slak'anil winh, sb'uchwaj heb' t'a winh.
Ha ach ix ak' sk'ulej heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'a winh, syik'ancha'anh sk'ab' heb' yuj tzalajk'olal.
Ix ik'el ye k'e'en yespada winh. Maj ach ochlaj yet' winh ayik ix och owal.
Ix ak' lajwok sb'inajnakil winh. Ix a yumankanem sdespacho winh t'a sat lu'um.
Ix pet ichamax winh u'uj, niwan ix aj ak'an k'ixwelal winh.
Mamin Jehová, ¿b'ak'inh ol aktej a k'ub'anel a b'a? ¿Ichanhej am tik ol ajkot yowal a k'ol icha junok owal k'ak'?
Mamin, nakoti to a ko k 'inal tzapan toni. Ha onh anima onh tik, tzapan ix utejkan ko k 'inal.
Malaj junok anima to malaj b'ak'inh ol chamok. Malaj mach syal skolan sb'a t'a yol sk'ab' chamel.
Mamin, ¿b'ajtil ay a wach'k'olal a ch'oxnak t'a peka', haton ak'annak a ti' t'a winhaj David, to ol ak' elk'och tas ix ala'?
Mamin, nakoti to manh jantakok onh stzuntzan heb' anima a onh a chekab' onh tik. Pitz'anoch tas tzonh yutej heb' chi' t'a in pixan.
Mamin Jehová, a heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach tik, t'a junjun rato sb'uchwaj heb' t'a winh a chekab' sik'b'ilel u'uj.
Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová t'a masanil tiempo. Ujokab'i.
Mamin, yiktax yichb'anel, a ach tzonh a koltaxoni.
Yiktax manto a b'olaj juntzanh witz yet' yol yib'anhk'inal tik, masanto t'a slajwub', Dios ach taxoni.
Ha ach tzonh ak' meltzajxi'och pokokal, ayik tzalani: Ex anima, meltzajanhekxi'och pokokal, xa chi.
Ha jun mil ab'il, icha yaj junok k'uhal yaj t'a yol a sat. Icha yaj jaye'ok hora t'ak'walil icha chi' yaj t'ayach.
Elanhchamel tzik' b'ey ko k 'inal. Icha wal yek'b'at junok wayich, icha wal chi' kaj a onh tik.
Lajan onh icha anh ank'ultak sk'e'uli. Skot xumakil anh t'a k'inhib'alil, haxo yik tz'emkan k'u, stakji'eli, schamxikanem anh.
Yel toni, a yowal a k'o'ol tzonh ak'an lajwokeli. Manhxo anima'ok tzonh ajkan yuj.
Ha ko mul yet' ko chukal, wach'chom te k'ub'eltak yaji, palta chekel yaj t'a ichanh.
Yel ton wal, a yuj yowal a k'ol satel ko k 'inal. Elanhchamel tzek'b'at ko k 'inal chi', ichanhej sja sik'son ko k'o'ol.
Anhej 70 ab'il ko k 'inal. Haxo heb' tek'an jun, sk'och heb' t'a 80 ab'il. Palta te yaxo yek' k'u ak'wal yuj heb'. Elanhchamel tzek'b'at ko k 'inal, tzonh sateli.
¿Mach wal ojtannak spoder yowal a k'o'ol? ¿Mach ay xiwk'olal t'ayach icha smojal yowal a k'o'ol chi'?
Ak' kojtakejeli to tzapan ko k 'inal, yik wach' snachajel ku'uj, yik tzonh b'ey t'a jelanil.
Mamin Jehová, ochannhej ket'ok. ¿Jantakto wal tiempo ol ko tanhwej yik tzonh a kolani? Ok'ok wal a k'ol t'ayonh a onh a chekab' onh tik.
Ak' tzalajb'ok ko k'o'ol t'a junjun k'inhib'alil yuj a wach'k'olal, yik tzonh b'itan t'a tzalajk'olal yakb'an pitzan onhto.
Sko nib'ej tzijtum ab'ilal ko tzalajk'olal tzak'a', icha wal sb'isul yab'ilal ko yahelal.
Elokab' t'a a k'o'ol to a onh a chekab' onh tik yet' heb' kinhtilal, to skil tas satub'tak tza k'ulej yet' a poder.
Mamin ach ko Diosal, ayokab' a wach'k'olal t'a kib'anh. Ak' najtilb'ok ko munlajel, cheklajokab' t'a junelnhej. Yel ton Mamin, cheklajokab' ko munlajel chi' t'a junelnhej.
Ha ex mach ex tzeyak'och Dios Ek'to t'a Yib'anh Smasanil yipok he k'o'ol, tanhwab'il ex yuj, haton Dios Masanil syal yuj.
Ol eyal icha tik: Ach Jehová, a t'ayach wach' ko kolan ko b'a, a ach tzach och kenhulok, ko Diosal ach, yip ko k'ol aji, xe chama.
Anhejton Dios chi' ol onh kolanel t'a ya'al k'ub'eltak yajemi yet' t'a ilya et'jinak chamel.
Ol onh moyjokk'e yuj, ichato ay sk'axil, malaj tas ol onh ik'anok. Yujto syak'elk'och sti', ha' ol onh kolanok, icha tz'aj skolchaj junok anima yuj smaklab' jul-lab'.
Manh ol onh xiwlaj t'a junok tas ay smay tzek' t'ak'walil. Manh ol onh xiwpaxlaj t'a jul-lab' sjulchaj t'a k'uhalil.
Manh ol onh xiwlaj t'a ilya sja t'a skal k'ik' k'inal. Manh ol onh xiwpaxlaj t'a tas tz'ak'an lajwokel anima t'a k'uhalil.
Mil anima ol cham t'a ko k'exanh. Lajunhe' mil t'a ko wach', a onhxo jun, malaj tas ol onh ik'anok.
Anhej to ol kila' tas spak ol scha heb' sk'ulan chukal.
Yujto ix ko kol ko b'a t'a Jehová Ek'to t'a Yib'anh Smasanil, ha' ix kak'och yipok ko k'o'ol,
yuj chi' manh ol schakot chukal t'a kib'anh, manh ol k'ochlaj ilya t'a ko pat.
Ol yal t'a heb' yángel to tzonh stanhwej heb' yalnhej b'aj tzonh b'ati.
Ol onh ketzchajk'e yuj heb', yik wach' manh ol ko tenoch kok t'a k'e'en k'e'en.
Ol yal ko b'eyek' t'a skal nok' choj, ma t'a skal nok' chan. Wach'chom te ow nok' chan chi', ma te niwak nok' choj chi', palta malaj tas ol onh ik'anok.
Yalnakkan Jehová t'ayonh: Ol ex in kolo' yujto tzin he xajanej. Ichato ol in och eyenhulok, yujto tzin eyal he Yajalok.
Ayik ol in eyawtani, ol in tak'wok t'ayex. Ha in ol in kajnaj heyet'ok, ol ex in kolanel t'a syahelal, ol ex wik'ancha'anh.
Niwan he k 'inal ol wak'a'. Ol wak' eyil in kolwal, xchi Dios.
Mamin Jehová, manh jantakok swach'il kak'an yuj diosal t'ayach yet' ko b'itan t'ayach yik tzach kik'ancha'anh yujto ek'achto t'a yib'anh smasanil.
Manh jantakok swach'il kalanel jantak a wach'k'olal t'a junjun k'inhib'alil yet' kalanpaxel t'a junjun t'ak'walil to tz'elnhejk'och tas tzala'.
Manh jantakok swach'il ach ko b'itan yet' masanil juntzanh chinhb'il yet' pax te' arpa to wach' yoch sjaj.
Mamin Jehová, a ach ix in ak'och t'a tzalajk'olal yuj tas b'ob'il u'uj. Tzin b'itan t'a tzalajk'olal yuj tas ix a k'ulej chi'.
Mamin Jehová, te satub'tak tas ix a k'ulej. Malaj junokxo stzak'wan spensar t'ayach.
Ha heb' malaj spensar, max nachajel-laj juntzanh tik yuj heb':
Wach'chom tz'och heb' ixtum anima b'eyumal, ma sk'echa'anh heb' chukal anima icha tz'aj sk'ib' anh ank'ultak, palta junnhej rato syak' snib'ej heb', slajwi chi' satixkanel heb' t'a junelnhej.
Ha hachxo Mamin Jehová, masanil tiempo te niwan elk'ochtaxoni.
Yel ton Mamin, ol ak' satjokel heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach. Masanil heb' sk'ulan chukal, ol ak' saklemkanb'at heb'.
Wan ak'an wip icha yip junok nok' kaltakte'al toro. Tzin te tzalaji yujto xajan in u'uj.
Yowalil ol wil yak'ji ganar heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin. Ol wab'anpax sk'akwi heb' sk'ulan chukal chi'.
Ha heb' anima wach' spensar, ol k'echa'anh heb' icha xumakil te' palma. Ol k'ib'cha'anh heb' icha wal te' k'ute' t'a Líbano,
yujto aynhejek' heb' t'a yamak'il stemplo Jehová. Ol k'echa'anh heb' yujto ayek' heb' t'a slak'anil ko Diosal.
Wach'chom icham animaxo heb', palta lajanto wal heb' icha junok te te' tzato satani, tek'anto wal yip heb'.
Ol sch'oxanel heb' to a Jehová ko Kolumal, tojol toni, malaj jab'ok chukal t'ay.
Mamin Jehová, Rey ach toni. Niwan chekel a b'inajnakil yet' a poder. Tzatz ix utej em k'ojan yol yib'anhk'inal tik, yuj chi' max ib'xilaj.
Mamin Jehová, atax t'a yichb'anel Yajal achtaxoni. Toxonton ayach ek'i.
Mamin Jehová, ha ha' mar tz'ib'xi ha', sk'epax chulnaj ha'.
Ha hachxo pax Mamin Jehová, Yajal ach t'a satcha'anh, ek'al ach t'a juntzanh ha ha' chi'. Ek'to a poder t'a ha' mar chi'.
Mamin Jehová, a a cheknab'il aynhej ek' t'a junelnhej. Ha a kajnub' niwan yelk'ochi yujto iknhej yaj t'a masanil tiempo.
Mamin Jehová, ch'oxel a b'a to Dios ach, to tza paktzitej tas malaj swach'il.
Ach Sjuezal yol yib'anhk'inal tik, kotanh, paktzitej t'a smojal t'a heb' syik'cha'anh sb'a.
Mamin Jehová, ¿jantakto wal tiempo ol tzalajnhej heb' sk'ulan chukal?
Masanil heb' chuk chi', ak'umtak syutej sb'a heb', syik'cha'anh sb'a heb' yet' schukal chi'.
Ay, Mamin Jehová, syixtejb'at a chonhab' heb'. Manhxa tas syal heb' a chonhab' chi' yuj heb'.
Smiljicham heb' ix chamnakxo yetb'eyum yuj heb'. Smilpaxcham heb' ch'ok chonhab'il heb' yet' pax heb' unin manhxalaj smam.
Syalan heb' icha tik: Max yil-laj Jehová sDiosal winhaj Jacob tas sko k'ulej tik. Manh yojtakokpaxlaj, xchi heb'.
Ex anima te pit, ex malaj jab'ok he pensar, ab'ek, ¿b'ak'inh ol nachajel eyu'uj?
Ha Dios ixb'o'an ko chikin, ¿tokwal max yab'i tas tz'alchaji? A' ixb'o'an yol ko sat, ¿tokwal max yila' tas tze k'ulej chi'?
A' tz'ak'an syahelal juntzanh niwak nación, ¿tom manh ol yak' eyahelal? A' tz'ak'an sjelanil ko pensar a onh anima onh tik, ¿tokwal manh yojtakok tas tze k'ulej chi'?
Ha Jehová yojtak to malaj yelk'och tas sko na' a onh anima onh tik.
Mamin Jehová, te wach' yik mach tzak' skachnab'il. Tzak'an pax a k'ayb'ub'al t'ay,
yik wach' malaj tas sna'a ayik sjawi yahelal, yakb'an stanhwej sb'oji olan b'aj tz'emkan heb' sk'ulan chukal.
Mamin Jehová, manh ol onh a patikejkanel-laj a onh a chonhab' onh tik. Manh ol onh aktejkanlaj ko ch'okoj.
Yuj chi', a heb' yajal, a tojolal ol sb'eyb'alej heb'. Haxo heb' anima wach' spensar, ol yak'och heb' yajal chi' heb' yipok sk'o'ol.
Mamin ¿mach tzin kolan t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ixtum anima yet' heb' sk'ulan tas malaj swach'il?
Mamin Jehová, tato manhok ach tzin a kolo', ayin xom ek' b'aj numan yaj heb' chamnak.
Mamin Jehová, ayik ix in na'ani to wanxo in telwi, haxo wal a wach'k'olal ix in yamanoch wa'an.
Ayik manh jantakok tas tzin na'a, tzak' in tzalajk'olal, tza niwanan in k'o'ol.
Mamin, malaj a gana to wach' ak'an yet' heb' juez chuk syutej yilan yopisio, to manh icha'ok yalan a ley syutej heb' sb'o'an yaj junok tas.
Ha heb' malaj smul syixtej heb'. Syak'anoch chamel heb' t'a yib'anh heb' wach' sb'eyb'al.
Ha onhxo Mamin Jehová, a ach ayach och ko kolnab'ilok. Ach ko Diosal, icha kenhul aji.
Ha ach ol a paktzitej schukal heb' chuk. Ol satel heb' yuj smul. Ach ko Diosal, ol ak'kan lajwokel heb'.
Kotanhek, konh b'itanek t'a Jehová t'a tzalajk'olal. Konh b'itanek t'a ko Kolumal.
Ochokonhek t'a yichanh t'a ak'oj yuj diosal. Konh b'itanek t'ay, yujto te niwan yelk'ochi.
Yujto a Jehová te niwan yelk'ochi. Haton Rey yaj t'a yib'anh smasanil heb' Dios.
T'a yol sk'ab' ay juntzanh xab' olan t'a yich lum lum tik. A' ay yik juntzanh witz te cha'anh yajk'e'i.
A' ay yik ha' mar, ha' b'ojinak ha'. A' b'o'annakpax lum lum tik.
Kotanhek, kak'ekem ko b'a t'a Jehová, konh emek kuman t'a yichanh. A' t'ay tzonh emek kuman yujto ha' ix onh b'o'ani.
Haton ko Diosal, a onhxo tik, schonhab' onh. Icha skalnel kaji, yuj chi' tanhwab'il onh yuj. Syal Dios icha tik: Tato tzeyab' tas swal tikne'ik,
manh he pitej he b'a icha yutejnak sb'a heb' he mam eyicham t'a Meriba. Manh eyutej he b'a icha yutejnak pax sb'a heb' t'a Masah t'a takinh lu'um.
Haton ta' yak'nak in prowal heb' he mam eyicham chi', wach'chom yilnak heb' juntzanh tas satub'tak in b'onak.
40 ab'il te ow wutejnak in b'a t'a heb', walannak icha tik: Ha juntzanh anima tik, ch'oknhej b'aj ayoch spensar heb', max nachajel-laj yuj heb' tas tzin nib'ej sb'eyb'alej heb', xin chi.
Yuj chi' yet' wal yowal in k'o'ol, wak'nak in ti' to max ochlaj heb' t'a lum lum b'aj ijan wak'nak yik' yip heb', xchi Dios.
A'okab' junok ak' b'it sko b'itej t'a Jehová. Konh b'itanek t'ay ko masanil kajan onh t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Konh b'itanek t'a Jehová, kalek wach' lolonel t'ay. Junjun k'u skalanek el ko kolnab'il syak'a'.
Kalekel yab'ixal sb'inajnakil yet' tas satub'tak ix sk'ulej. Kalekel t'a smasanil chonhab' yet' t'a junjun nación.
Yujto niwan yelk'och Jehová, smoj tz'alchaj wach' lolonel t'ay. Yelxo wal te ay smay t'a yichanh masanil heb' Dios.
Haxo pax sdiosal juntzanhxo ch'ok chonhab'il jun, malaj yalani yujto yechelnhej yaji. Palta haxo pax Jehová, ha' b'o'annak satcha'anh.
Te niwan yelk'ochi, te ay pax spoder. Scheklaj spoder yet' swach'il yilji t'a skajnub'.
Ex anima t'a juntzanh chonhab', alek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová yujto te niwan yelk'ochi, te ay pax spoder.
Alek wach' lolonel t'ay icha wal smojal. Ochanhek yet' he silab' t'a yamak'il stemplo.
Hak'ekem he b'a t'a Jehová t'a skajnub' wach' yilji. E masanil ex anima, ayokab' he xiwk'olal t'a yichanh.
Alek t'a juntzanhxo nación to a Jehová Rey toni. Tzatz ix yutej em k'ojan yol yib'anhk'inal tik, yuj chi' max ib'xilaj. Junlajannhej syutej sch'olb'itan juntzanh chonhab'.
Tzalajokab' satcha'anh yet' lum lum tik. Elokab' yaw ha' mar yet' masanil tas ay t'a yol ha'.
Ayokab' tzalajk'olal t'a skal lum jakb'en yet' masanil tastak ay t'ay. Elokab' yaw masanil te' niwak te' t'a tzalajk'olal,
yujto wan sjawi Jehová. Tik wal sjawi. Ol ul yak'an Yajalil t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ol sch'olb'itan t'a wach'il yet' t'a stojolal.
Tzalajokab' masanil lum lum tik yet' masanil chonhab' t'a stitak ha' mar, yujto a Jehová Rey toni.
Oyanoch k'ik'al asun t'a spatik yichanh. Te tek'an yaj yopisio yujto tojol syutej sch'olb'itani.
Wan sb'at jun k'ak' t'a yichanh, ol tz'ab'at heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ay.
Sakb'i yol yib'anhk'inal tik yuj k'ak' tzek' kopnaj yuj, tz'ib'xi lum lum a tz'ek'i.
Tz'ulaxb'at lum niwak witz icha nok' chak'ib' t'a yichanh Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Ha satcha'anh sch'oxanel stojolal, haxo heb' chonhab', syil stzikiki'al heb'.
Ol k'ixwokkan heb' syak'em sb'a t'a juntzanh komon Dios, heb' syik'cha'anh sb'a yet' juntzanh yechel chi', yujto masanil juntzanh Dios chi' ol yak'em sb'a t'a yichanh Jehová.
Mamin Jehová, a yab'ixal tas ix utej ak'an syahelal heb' ajk'o'ol, ol yab' heb' aj Sion yet' juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a yol yik Judá, yuj chi' ol tzalaj heb'.
Mamin Jehová, Yajal ach t'a yib'anh masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik. Ek'al ach t'a yib'anh masanil komon Dios.
Ha ex mach ex tze xajanej Jehová, chakek el chukal. Yujto a heb' sk'anab'ajani, tanhwab'il heb' yuj. Skolji heb' yuj t'a yol sk'ab' heb' sk'ulan chukal.
Tz'ak'ji sakil k'inal t'a heb' anima wach' spensar yuj, syak'an tzalajk'olal t'a heb' tojol sb'eyb'al.
E masanil ex anima to wach' he pensar, tzalajanhek yuj tas wach' ix sk'ulej Jehová. Alek wach' lolonel t'ay.
B'itejek ak' b'it t'a Jehová. Ileknab' tas satub'tak ix sk'ulej. A' ix onh kolan a onh schonhab' onh tik yet' yipalil haxonhej ochi.
Ix sch'oxel skolwal Jehová, ix sch'oxan yil juntzanh niwak nación to tojol syutej spaktzitan t'a heb' ajk'ol yajoch t'ay.
Ix elnhejk'och tas ix yal t'ayonh a onh schonhab' Israel onh tik. Ix yak'kot swach'k'olal t'ayonh. Masanto t'a slajwub' yol yib'anhk'inal tik ix ilchaji to ix onh kolchaj yuj ko Diosal.
Ex kajan ex t'a masanil sat lu'um tik, b'itananhek t'a Jehová t'a tzalajk'olal. Hak'ek eyip he b'itan t'ay t'a tzalajk'olal.
B'itejek b'it t'a Jehová yet' te' arpa yet' te' ay sch'anhal.
B'itananhek t'a Jehová ko Reyal t'a tzalajk'olal. B'itananhek, tze pu'an k'e'en trompeta, tze pu'anpax nok' ch'a'ak.
B'itanokab' ha' mar yet' masanil nok' nok' ay t'a yol ha'. B'itanokab'pax yol yib'anhk'inal tik yet' heb' kajan t'ay.
k'anhokab' ha' niwak ha' yuj tzalajk'olal. Junlajanokab' tz'aj yawaj lum niwak witz t'a tzalajk'olal t'a yichanh Jehová,
yujto ol jawok, ol ul yak'an Yajalil t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik. A' ol ak'an Yajalil, junlajan ol yutok sch'olb'itan juntzanh chonhab' t'a stojolal.
Ha Jehová Rey toni, ha t'a yib'anh heb' querubín ayk'e sk'ojnub'. Tz'ib'xi niwak chonhab' yuj xiwelal, tz'ib'xi pax masanil lum lum.
Niwan ton yelk'och Jehová t'a tzalan Sion. A' ay yopisio t'a yib'anh masanil chonhab'.
Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'ay, yujto niwan ton yelk'ochi, te ay smay, Haxonhej Ochi.

Mamin, a ach tik Rey ach toni, masanil syal u'uj, tza xajanej tojolal. Ha ach a b'onakkani to lajannhej tz'aj sch'olb'itaj junjun anima. Ha t'ayonh yinhtilal onh kan winhaj Jacob tik ix ak' tojolal yet' wach'ilal.
Ex wetchonhab', kik'ekcha'anh sb'i Jehová ko Diosal. Konh emek kuman t'a yichanh yujto Haxonhej Ochi.

Ha winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón, ek'nak heb' winh t'a skal heb' sacerdote Dios chi'. Ha winhaj Samuel ek'nak winh t'a skal heb' lesalwinak t'a Jehová. Ix tak'wi t'a heb' ayik ix sk'anan skolwal heb'.
T'a skal jun topanh asun ix lolon Dios yet' heb'. Ha sk'ayb'ub'al yet' scheknab'il ix yak' t'a heb', ix sk'anab'ajej heb'.
Mamin Jehová ko Diosal, ix ach tak'wi t'a a chonhab'. Ix ak' niwank'olal smul heb', palta ix ak' pax syahelal heb' yuj schukal.
Ex wetchonhab', kik'ekcha'anh sb'i Jehová ko Diosal. Konh emek kuman t'a yichanh t'a tzalan yik ejmelal, yujto a Jehová ko Diosal chi' Haxonhej Ochi.
Ko masanil kajan onh t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, konh b'itanek t'a Jehová t'a tzalajk'olal.
Kak'ekem ko b'a t'ay t'a tzalajk'olal. Kotanhek t'a yichanh yet' aw yik tzalajk'olal.
Cham wal kojtakaneli to a Jehová Dios toni. A' ix onh b'o'ani, yuj chi' yikonh. Ha onh schonhab' onh tik, icha wal skalnel kaji.
Konh ochek t'a puerta yik tzonh och t'a yol yamak'il skajnub' yik skalek wach' lolonel t'ay. Kak'ek yuj diosal t'ay, skalanek wach' lolonel t'ay.
Yujto a Jehová wach' toni. Ha swach'k'olal aynhejek' t'a junelnhej, malaj b'aj max yak'elk'och tas syala'.
Ha wach'ilal yet' tojolal ol in b'itej. Mamin Jehová in gana tzin b'itan t'ayach.
Snib'ej in k'ol tzin b'eyb'alej tojolal. ¿B'ak'inhtax wal ol ach och wet'ok? Malaj mach ol halan jab'ok chukal t'ayin yuj in b'eyb'al t'a in palacio.
Malaj b'ak'inh ol in b'at k'elan t'a chuk pensaril. Ach in Diosal, max yal-laj in k'ol sb'eyb'al heb' tzach patikaneli. Malaj b'ak'inh ol in cha ja heb' t'a in tz'ey.
Najat ol wik'kanel chukal t'a in pensar. Malaj walan wik yet' heb' sk'ulan chukal chi'.
Ol in satel heb' k'ub'eltak tz'alan spekal heb' anima. Ha heb' ak'umtak yet' heb' syik'cha'anh sb'a, manh ol techajlaj heb' wu'uj.
Ol wila' mach heb' k'anab'ajum t'a sat lum lum tik, a heb' ol munlaj wet'ok. Anhej heb' wach' sb'eyb'al ol och in chekab'ok.
Manh ol in cha ajlaj heb' ixtum anima t'a in palacio. Ha heb' na'umcha'anh lolonel, manh ol in cha ajlaj heb' t'a wichanh.
Mamin Jehová, t'a junjun k'u ol in satel heb' chuk kajan t'a sat ko lum tik. Ol in satel masanil heb' sk'ulan chukal t'a yol a chonhab'.
Mamin Jehová, ab' wal jun in lesal tik. In gana to sk'och waw t'ayach.
Manh ach b'at mikan t'ayin ayik ay in och ilk'olal. Elokab' t'a a k'o'ol ab'an in lesal. Komonok elanhchamel tzach tak'wi t'ayin ayik tzach wawtani.
Wan slajwi'em in k 'inal icha wal satem te' tab'. Wan stz'ab'at in b'akil icha te' kuxk'ak' swab'i.
Manhxalaj yip in pixan swab'i, icha wal takinh ank'ultak in tikne'ik. Maxtzak ochlaj in wejel.
Ix och lotzan in tz'umal t'a in b'akil yuj b'aj tzin te ok'i.
Lajan in icha junok nok' kujub' t'a tzinan lu'um, ma icha nok' xoch' b'aj ay te' k'atak pat.
Max ochlaj in wayanh. Lajan in yet' nok' much tzek' sch'okojil t'a chontak pat.
Ha heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, junjun k'u stzuntzej kus in k'o'ol heb'. Tzin yak'anpax b'inaj heb' t'a skatab'.
Ichato tik'ak'il ta'anh in wa'el tzin wa'a. Skalej sb'a yal in sat yet' tas swuk'ej.
Yujnhej a k'ak'alk'olal yet' yowal a k'ol t'ayin, ix in ik'ank'e wa'an, ix lajwi chi' ix in a yumankanb'at t'a najat.
Icha junok enhul wanxo satemi, icha wal chi' in k 'inal. Wan in takji'em icha wal anh ank'ultak swab'i.
Ha hachxo Mamin Jehová, Yajal ach t'a masanil tiempo. Ol ach nachajnhejkot t'a masanil k 'inal.
Kotanh, ok'okab' a k'ol t'a Sion. Toxo ix ja stiempo'al to tzak'xi a wach'k'olal t'ay.
Ha onh a chekab' onh tik xajan Sion ku'uj, wach'chom lanhchajnak emi. Tzonh ok'i yujto ix juji'emi.
Masanil nación yet' heb' winh sreyal yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ol xiw heb' t'a stzikiki'al Jehová te b'inajnak.
Ayik ol b'oxik'e Sion, ol sch'oxan sb'a t'a skal stzikiki'al ta'.
A' ol cha'an slesal heb' malaj mach skolwaj yet'ok. Manh ol spatikejel-laj heb', ayik ol yalan sb'a heb' t'ay.
Tz'ib'chajokab'kan t'a yol ch'anh u'um tas ol sk'ulok Jehová yik wach' a heb' manto aljoklaj, ol yal wach' lolonel heb' t'ay.
Hato t'a sk'ojnub' Jehová t'a satcha'anh ol yilanemta lum lum tik,
yik wach' ol b'o yaj b'aj stewi heb' presowum. Ol skolankanel heb' winh preso yaji, heb' ayoch chamel t'a yib'anh,
yik ol aljokel yab'ixal t'a Sion, yik tz'alchajpax wach' lolonel t'ay t'a Jerusalén.
Yuj chi' ol ja masanil nación ul yak'em sb'a t'a Jehová chi'.
Ix yik'anel wip Jehová ayik ayto in k 'inal, ix tzap in k 'inal yuj.
Ix walan t'ay: Ach in Diosal, manh ak' tzap in k 'inal. Ha wal a k 'inal a ach tik, malaj slajwub'.
Atax t'a yichb'anel a b'onakkanem yich yol yib'anhk'inal tik, a ach pax a b'onakkan satcha'anh.
Ol satel masanil juntzanh tik, a hachxo jun, ayachnhejek'i. Ha juntzanh tik ol ixtaxok, icha sk'ab'ik'och junok k'apak, ol a k'exkaneli, icha wal sk'exanel junok sk'a pichul heb' anima, syumankaneli.
Ha hachxo jun, hanheja' aji, malaj b'ak'inh ol ach satelok.
Ha heb' kuninal a onh a chekab' onh tik, junk'olal ol aj heb' t'a ichanh. Yuj a kolwal, malaj tas ol ik'an heb'.
T'a smasanil in k'o'ol yet' smasanil in pixan, swal wach' lolonel t'a Jehová.
T'a smasanil in k'o'ol swal wach' lolonel t'ay. Manh ol sat in k'ol t'a masanil swach'k'olal.
A' wal sukan sat masanil in mul. A' tz'ak'an b'oxok in k'o'ol t'a masanil ilya.
A' tzin kolanel t'a yol sk'ab' chamel. Syak'nhej swach'k'olal t'ayin, tz'ok' pax sk'o'ol t'ayin.
A' tz'ak'an masanil tas wach' t'ayin yakb'an pitzan hinto, yuj chi' ichato tzin ochxi kelemal icha nok' niwak ch'akb'a.
Ha Jehová sb'o'an yaj t'a stojolal t'a heb' tz'ixtaj yuj heb' ixtum anima.
Ix sch'ox sb'eyb'al yet' tas sk'ulej t'a winhaj Moisés yet' t'ayonh a onh israel onh tik.
Ha Jehová, xajan onh yuj, te k'un yok' sk'ol t'ayonh. Manh k'unok skot yowal, te ay pax swach'k'olal.
Manh kotakok skal tzonh stumani. Max chichonochlaj sk'ol t'ayonh t'a masanil tiempo.
Max yak'laj ko yahelal icha t'a smojal yuj ko chukal. Max spaktzitejlaj t'ayonh icha smojal yuj ko mul chi'.
Te niwan swach'k'olal t'a heb' ay xiwk'olal t'ay. Icha wal scha'anhil satcha'anh t'a yib'anh lum lum tik, icha chi' swach'k'olal chi' t'a heb'.
Najat ix yak'kanb'at ko chukal t'ayonh, icha snajatil skal b'aj sjawi k'u yet' b'aj tz'emxi.
Icha junok mamab'il tz'ok' sk'ol t'a yuninal, icha chi' yok' sk'ol Jehová t'a heb' ay xiwk'olal t'ay,
yujto yojtak tas ix aj ko b'o'i, yojtak sik'lab'il to pokok onh.
Icha yaj sk'inal anh ank'ultak, icha chi' yaj ko k 'inal a onh anima onh tik. Sk'e'ul anh, xumakan anh,
ayik sjawi junok ik' te ow t'a anh, stakji anh yuj. Malaj mach tz'ab'an spekal tas ix aj anh.
Palta haxo swach'k'olal Jehová, malaj slajwub', aytaxonek' t'a heb' ay xiwk'olal t'ay. Tz'elk'och sti' t'a yinhtilal heb' anima sk'anab'ajan strato,
haton heb' max yaktejkan sk'anab'ajan scheknab'il.
Ha t'a satcha'anh ix sb'o sdespacho Jehová. Hata' ayoch Yajalil t'a yib'anh smasanil.
Ex yángel Jehová, ex tek'an ex t'a he poder, alek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová, a ex ton k'anab'ajum ex t'a slolonel.
Masanil ex satchanhil chekab', alekel wach' lolonel t'a Jehová, a ex ton tze k'anab'ajej tas snib'ej tze k'ulej.
Masanil tas b'ob'il yuj Jehová t'a yol smakb'en, yalokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová chi'. T'a smasanil in k'o'ol ol wal wach' lolonel t'a Jehová.
T'a smasanil in k'o'ol swal wach' lolonel t'a Jehová. Ach Jehová in Diosal, yelxo wal te niwan elk'ochi. Ha a tzikiki'al yet' a poder, a ayoch a pichulok.
Ha sakil k'inal tzach pichani. Ha ach ix ak'b'at jenhan satcha'anh icha junok mantiado.
Ha ach ix a b'ok'e a pat t'a yib'anh ha ha'. Ha asun tz'och a carruajeok. Icha sb'ey ik' a b'eyek'i.
Ha ik' tzak' och a chekab'ok, haxo yok k'ak' tzak'och ak'umalok serwil.
Ix a b'okanem lum lum tik t'a yib'anh sb'akhnub'al. Malaj b'ak'inh ol ib'xok lum t'a yet'tal chi'.
Ix a muk sat lum lum tik yet' ha' niwan mar, ichato ha ha' ix och spichulok lu'um. Ha ha ha' ix musan lum niwak witz.
Palta a ach ix a kachoch wa'an ha', yuj chi' ix b'at ha' elelal. Elanhchamel ix b'atkan ha' ayik ix yab'an a jaj ha' icha sk'anh k'u.
Ix k'ib' lum jolomtak witz, ix emkan lum ch'olkixtak, masanto ix k'ochkan ha' b'aj ix a ch'oxkani.
Ix ak'kanem stz'akanhil b'aj sk'ochkan ha', max ek'b'atlaj ha' t'a jun tz'aka'anh chi'. Manhxo ol smuklaj lum lum chi' ha'.
Ha ach ix ak'kot ha ha' ay sjaj yet' ha' niwak ha' tzek' t'a skal lum niwak witz.
Haton ha' chi' syuk' nok' k'ultakil nok'. Ha ha' syuk' pax nok' kaltakte'al b'uru yik tzek' stak'inhal sti' nok'.
T'a sk'ab'tak te te' t'a stitak ha' niwak ha' chi' sb'o so' nok' much, hata' tz'ok' nok'.
Hato t'a a kajnub' t'a satcha'anh tzak'kot nhab' t'a yib'anh lum witz. Tz'ak'anemta niwak nhab' yik satan tastak tz'awchaj t'a sat lum lum.
Tzak' k'ib' anh ank'ultak yik wach' sk'ux anh nok' nok'. Tzak'pax k'ib' juntzanh tas skawej yik skab'lej:
Haton wino tz'ak'an tzalajb'ok ko k'o'ol, aceite tz'ik'an kopopi tz'aj ko sat yet' pax ixim ixim tz'ak'an kip.
Tzak' yaxb'ok masanil te te' yuj nhab' yet' te' k'ute' ix awej t'a yol yik Líbano.
Hata' sb'o so' nok' kotak much. Haxo nok' julumchay, ha t'a skaltak te' taj kajanek' nok'.
Ha t'a lum niwak witz skajnaj nok' k'ultakil chiwa. Haxo t'a yoltak nhak'e'en skajnaj nok' chich.
Ha ach ix a b'o k'e'en uj yik tz'och sb'isulok tiempo'al. Yojtak k'u janik' ol b'atixkanok.
Ha ach tzak' ja k'ik' k'inal, haxo tz'och t'ak'walilal. Haxo t'ak'walil chi' tz'elta nok' k'ultakil nok'.
Tz'ok' nok' choj yuj schib'ej, sk'anan swa'el nok' t'ayach.
Haxo yik sjawi k'u jun, sk'ub'anxikanel sb'a nok'. Haxo t'a snhak'e'en nok' tz'em kutzan swayi.
Ha onhxo anima onh tik, tzonh elta, tzonh b'at munlajel. Tzonh munlaji tzek' k'u.
Mamin Jehová, manhxo b'ischajb'enok jantak tas ix a b'okani. Masanil tas ix a b'okan yet' a jelanil. Majnakel sat lum lum tik yuj tas ix a b'okan chi'.
Ina ha' mar, te niwan sat ha', manh chekeloklaj stitak ha'. Manhxo b'ischajb'enok nok' nok' ay t'a yol ha': Ay nok' niwak, ay pax nok' kotak.
Ha t'a sat ha' tzek' te' barco. Ha t'a yol ha' ay nok' niwan leviatán, ix a b'o nok' yik tzach tzalaj yet' nok' ta'.
Masanil juntzanh nok' nok' chi', aynhejoch sat nok' t'ayach yik tzak' swa'el nok' t'a yora'il.
Ha ach tzak' swa'el nok' chi', haxo nok' sik'ank'e wa'an. Elb'en yel u'uj yik a tastak wach' swa nok'.
Tato tz'el a sat t'a nok', xiwk'e nok'. Tato tzik'ek' yik' nok', scham nok', tz'ochxikan nok' pokokal.
Tato tzak'xi yik' nok' jun, sk'ib' sb'isul nok'. Wach' tz'aj yiljixi sat lum lum tik a b'o'ani.
Mamin Jehová, aynhej ek' a tzikiki'al t'a masanil k 'inal. Tzach tzalaj wal yet' tas ix a b'okani.
Tz'ib'xik'e lum lum tik ayik tzach och k'elan t'a lu'um. Sk'e stab'il lum witz ayik tza yaman lu'um.
Mamin Jehová, ol in b'itan t'ayach yakb'an ayinto ek'i. Yakb'an pitzan hinto, ol in b'itan t'ayach ach in Diosal.
Mamin, komonok wal stzalaj a k'o'ol yet' tas tzin na tik. Anhej t'ayach ay in tzalajk'olal.
Satokab' el heb' chuk sb'eyb'al yet' heb' tzach patikanel t'a sat lum lum tik. Ha in tik yet' smasanil in k'o'ol ol wal wach' lolonel t'a Jehová. Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová chi'.
Kak'ek yuj diosal t'a Jehová. Kalek ko b'a t'ay. Kalek t'a junjun chonhab' yuj tas ix sk'ulej.
Konh b'itanhek t'ay. Kalekel tas satub'tak ix sk'ulej.
Konh tzalajek yuj Jehová. Ayokab' pax stzalajk'olal heb' emnakil t'ay.
Ko k'anek skolwal Jehová. Kak'ekem ko b'a t'ay t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha onh yinhtil onh winhaj Jacob yixchikin winhaj Abraham schekab' Jehová, sik'b'il onh el yuj Jehová. Ko na'ekkot tas satub'tak ix sk'ulej ko Diosal yet' juntzanh sley ix yalkani.
Ha Jehová ko Diosal ayoch Yajalil t'a masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Syak'nhejelk'och strato. Tz'elnhejk'och tas syal t'a jantak smilal makanhil anima tz'ek'i.
Ix elk'och sti' yak'nak t'a winhaj Abraham. Ix elpaxk'och tas yalnakkan t'a winhaj Isaac.
Ix kan tas yalnakkan chi' t'a winhaj Jacob. Aynhejek' jun sti' yak'nak chi' t'ayonh a onh israel onh tik t'a masanil k 'inal.
Ha Jehová chi' alannakkan t'a junjun heb' icha tik: Ol wak' lum Canaán t'ayach, ol ochkan lum ikok, xchi.
Ayik chi' jaywanhanto heb', b'eyum animanhej yajek' heb' t'a sat lum lum chi'.
Tonhej tzek' kajan heb' t'a junjun chonhab' yet' t'a smakb'en heb' rey.
Palta maj yal sk'o'ol Dios ix ixtaj heb', yuj chi' ix kachji heb' rey chi' yuj, ix yalani:
Manh eyixtej heb' wik sik'b'ileli. Manh he tzuntzej heb' in chekab', xchi.
Ix yak'kot jun niwan wejel t'a jun lugar chi', ix yik'kanek' masanil tas swa heb'.
Palta ayik manto jalaj jun wejel chi', ix b'ab'laj chekjib'at winhaj José t'a Egipto yuj Dios, haton winh ix schonhb'at heb' chekab'wumal.
Ixlajwi yok winh yuj k'e'en cadena, ix ochpax k'e'en t'a sjaj winh,
masanto ix elk'och masanil tas yalnak Dios t'a winh, ix sch'oxanel Dios chi' to yelton tas ix yalel winh chi'.
Ha winh rey, yajal yaj winh t'a yib'anh jantak anima ix jakanelta winhaj José chi' t'a preso.
Ix ak'ji'och winh yilumalok spalacio winh rey chi'. Ix ak'jipaxoch winh yajalil t'a yib'anh masanil smakb'en winh rey chi'.
Ix sk'ayb'ej heb' yetyajalil winh. Ix ak'jipax sjelanil heb' ichamtak winak yuj winh.
Haxo t'a stzak'anilxo ix k'och winhaj Israel, haton winhaj Jacob b'aj ayek' winhaj José. Ha t'a Egipto chi' ix kajnaj winh, haton lum slu'um heb' yinhtilal winhaj Cam.
Ha Dios ix ak'an k'ib' sb'isul yinhtilal winhaj Jacob chi', yelxo wal tek'an ix aj heb' t'a yichanh heb' aj Egipto chi'.
Palta ha Dios ix ak'an sk'ulej heb' aj Egipto chi', ix och heb' ajk'olal t'a schonhab' chi', ix ixtaj heb' schekab' yuj heb'.
Ix schekankot winh schekab' Dios chi', haton winhaj Moisés. Ix schekanpaxkot winhaj Aarón, winh sik'b'ilel yuj.
Ha heb' winh ix ch'oxan smilagro Dios t'a heb' aj Egipto chi'. Ha tas satub'tak ix sk'ulej heb' winh t'a yol smakb'en heb' yinhtilal winhaj Cam.
Ix ak'jikot k'ik' k'inal yuj Dios chi' t'a smasanil smakb'en heb'. Maj spitejlaj sb'a heb' winh chawanh schekab' chi' t'a slolonel.
Ix och masanil ha ha' chik'al yuj Dios chi'. Masanil nok' chay ix chami.
Ix yak'an b'ut'jokel masanil chonhab' t'a yol smakb'en Egipto yuj nok' pajtza'. Ix laj k'e nok' t'a sat sch'at winh rey.
Ha Dios ix halani, ix k'ik'b'i k 'inal sk'och nok' kach. Ix pitzwipaxcha'anh nok' kotak us t'a masanil yol smakb'en Egipto chi'.
Ix yak'kot k'e'en niwak sakb'at t'a satcha'anh sk'exulok nhab'. Jantak ix mak'waj k'u t'a yol smakb'en heb' chi'.
Ix lajwi'em te' uwa yet' te' higo, haton yawb'en te' heb'. Ix laj jekchaj sk'ab'tak te te' t'a yol smakb'en heb' chi'.
Ix yalanxi Dios, ix k'och nok' k'ulub'. Manhxo jantakok nok' ix k'ochi.
Ix lajwi'el masanil anh ank'ultak yuj nok'. Masanil tastak sk'ib' chi' ta', ix lajwi'el yuj nok'.
Ix miljicham masanil heb' sb'ab'el unin heb' aj Egipto chi'. Ix laj cham junjun b'ab'el unin t'a junjun pat.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yik'anelta heb' schonhab'. Niwan k'e'en oro yet' k'e'en plata ix skuchkot heb', malaj junok mach tz'ontak t'a skal heb'.
Ix tzalaj heb' aj Egipto chi' ayik ix yilan heb' yelta heb' aj Israel chi' yujto te xiwnak heb' yuj heb'.
Ha Dios ix ak'ankot jun asun yenhulok heb' schonhab' chi'. Haxo t'ak'walil, a jun k'ak' tz'ak'an sakil k'inal t'a yol sb'e heb'.
Ix sk'anan schib'ej heb' t'a Dios, ix yak'kot nok' ub' t'a heb'. Haton wa'el ix kot t'a satcha'anh ix ak'an b'ut'jok heb'.
Ix jat k'e'en niwan k'e'en yuj Dios chi', ix elta seknaj a niwak ha'. Ix b'ey ha' t'a lum takinh lu'um chi' icha sb'ey ha' niwak eluma'.
Ix snakot slolonel niwan yelk'och yalnakkan t'a winhaj Abraham, haton schekab'.
Ichaton chi' ajnak yik'anelta heb' schonhab' Dios sik'b'ilel yuj yet' niwan tzalajk'olal.
Ha slu'um juntzanhxo chonhab' ix yak'kanoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' yet' masanil tas b'ob'il yuj juntzanh chonhab' chi'.
Ichaton chi' ix yutej Dios t'a heb' schonhab' yik k'anab'ajum syutej sb'a heb' t'a scheknab'il yet' t'a sk'ayb'ub'al. Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová.
Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová. Kak'ek yuj diosal t'ay, yujto wach'. Malaj b'ak'inh slajwi swach'k'olal.
¿Mach ol tzak'wan yalanel jantak tas satub'tak ix sk'ulej Jehová? ¿Mach ol yal sb'itan t'ay icha wal t'a smojal?
Te wach' yik heb' k'anab'ajum t'ay, heb' sb'eyb'alan tojolal t'a masanil tiempo.
Mamin Jehová, tzin a nakoti ayik ol ak'an a wach'k'olal t'a heb' a chonhab'. Tzin a nakoti ayik ol ach jawok kolwal,
yik wach' ol wil a wach'k'olal t'a a chonhab' sik'b'ilel u'uj, yik ol in tzalaj yet' heb', ol in k'epaxcha'anh yet' heb'.
Lajan ix aj ko mul yet' heb' ko mam kicham. Ix ko pitej ko b'a, ix ko k'ulej chukal.
Ayik yek'nak heb' ko mam kicham t'a Egipto, malaj ix elk'och smilagro Jehová t'a heb'. Ix b'atkan satk'olal sniwan wach'k'olal yuj heb'. Ix och heb' ajk'olal t'ay t'a sti' ha' Chakchak Mar.
Haxo ix kolanel heb', ix sch'oxanel spoder, yik wach' malaj tas tz'alchaj t'a spatik.
Ix tumaj ha' Chakchak Mar chi' yuj, ix takji'em ha' yik tzek'ta heb' schonhab' t'a snanhal ha' mar chi'. Ichato takinhal lu'um b'aj ix ek'ta heb'.
Icha chi' ix aj skolchajel heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'o'ol, haton heb' schichon sk'ol t'a heb'.
Ha ha' mar ix mukankan heb' ajk'ol yajoch chi' t'a heb', manhxa junok heb' ix eli.
Yuj chi' ix yak'och sk'o'ol heb' t'a tas alb'il yuj Dios. Ix yalan wach' lolonel heb' t'ay t'a b'ital.
Palta elanhchamel ix b'atkan satk'olal tas ix sk'ulej Dios yuj heb'. Maj stanhwejlaj yil heb' tas sna Dios chi' t'a yib'anh heb'.
Haxo t'a tzinan lu'um chi' ix stzuntzejkot yowal sk'o'ol Dios heb'. Yuj spek'al heb' ix yak' prowal Dios chi' heb'.
Ix ton yak' Dios chi' tas snib'ej sk'ol heb', palta ix yak'kot jun niwan yahelal t'a skal heb' yik scham heb'.
Ha t'a yol smantiado heb', chuk tas ix sna heb' t'a spatik winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj Aarón sik'b'ilel yuj Jehová.
Yuj chi, ix sjak sb'a lum lum, ix turjib'at winhaj Datán, winhaj Abiram yet' heb' ajun yet' heb' winh.
Ix b'at jun k'ak' t'a skal heb' smasanil, ix laj tz'ab'at heb' sk'ulan chukal chi'.
Ha t'a tzalan Horeb ix sb'o jun yechel wakax heb' t'a k'e'en oro, ix yak'anem sb'a heb' t'ay.
Ha Dios Niwan Yelk'ochi ix yaktejkan heb', haxo t'a jun yechel wakax k'uxum ank'ultak ix yak'em sb'a heb'.
Ix b'at satk'olal Dios Skolumal heb' yuj, haton ixb'o'an jantak tas satub'tak t'a Egipto.
Ha t'a smakb'en heb' yinhtilal winhaj Cam, satub'tak tas ix sb'o'o. Ch'okxo wal tas ix sk'ulej t'a ha' Chakchak Mar chi'.
Ha Dios ix sna to satel heb', palta haxo winhaj Moisés, winh sik'b'ilel yuj, ix tewi yuj heb', yuj chi' ix ek'kanb'at yowal sk'ol Dios, majxo satel-laj heb'.
Haxo ix ek' janik'xo tiempo, ix spatikanel jun lu'um yax sat heb'. Maj yak'ochlaj heb' t'a sk'o'ol tas ix yal Dios.
Ha t'a yoltak smantiado heb' ix yalub'tanhej t'a spatik Jehová. Ha tas ix yal Dios, maj sk'anab'ajejlaj heb'.
Yuj chi' ix yak' sti' Dios t'a heb', ix yalani to ol cham heb' yuj t'a tzinan lu'um,
to ol saklemkanb'at heb' yinhtilal heb' t'a skal juntzanh ch'ok chonhab'il, haxo ta' ol miljokcham heb'.
Ix yak'anem sb'a heb' t'a Baal-peor. Ix schi'an nok' silab' heb' tz'ak'ji t'a juntzanh Dios manh pitzanok.
Ha yuj chukal sk'ulej heb', ix stzuntzejkot yowal sk'ol Dios heb', yuj chi' ix jawi yab'il t'a skal heb', ix cham heb' yuj.
Haxo ix k'e wa'an winhaj Finees, ix smilancham jun winh ay smul chi' winh, ix och wa'an chamel chi'.
Ix och tas ix sk'ulej winh chi' swach'ilok, to malaj b'ak'inh ol b'at satk'olal yuj Dios.
Hanheja' t'a ha ha' yik Meriba, ix tzuntzajkot yowal sk'o'ol Jehová yuj heb'. Chuk ix elk'och winhaj Moisés yuj tas ix sk'ulej heb' chi'.
Ix tzuntzaj tak sk'ol winh yuj heb', yuj chi' komonnhej ix lolon winh t'a heb'.
Maj satel-laj juntzanh chonhab' heb' icha ix yutej Jehová yalani.
Palta haxo tas ix sk'ulej heb', to ix yik'laj sb'a heb' yet' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il chi', ix sb'eyb'alan sb'eyb'al heb' chi' heb'.
Ix yak'anem sb'a heb' t'a juntzanh sdiosal heb' ch'ok chonhab'il chi'. Ha wal yuj jun chi' ix ixtaxel heb'.
Ix laj snhus yal yuninal heb' t'a heb' demonio silab'il.

Ha schik'il heb' unin malaj smul ix yik'el heb', haton schik'il heb' yuninal heb' yet' heb' yisil heb', haxo t'a sdiosal heb' aj Canaán ix yak' heb' silab'il. Haxo lum lum, ix ixtaxb'at lu'um yuj schamel heb' chi'.
Ix ixtaxb'at heb' yuj chukal ix sk'ulej chi', ix och heb' ajmulal t'a yol sat Jehová.
Ix tzaktzaj Jehová, ix kot yowal t'a heb' schonhab',
yuj chi' ix aktajkan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, ix kan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'o'ol chi'.
Ix ixtaj heb' yuj heb' ajk'o'ol chi', ix kan heb' t'a yalanh smandar heb'.
Tzijtum el ix kolchajel heb' yuj Dios, palta ix och heb' ajk'olal t'a tas nab'il yuj Dios chi'. Yuj chi' ix te juwib'at heb' ste k'ulan chukal chi'.
Palta ayik ix yilan syahelal heb' chi' Jehová, ix yab'anpax stewi heb' t'ay,
ix snakot strato yet' heb', ix sk'exan spensar chi' t'a heb', yujto yel te niwan swach'k'olal.
A' ix ak'an sk'ulej heb' ajk'o'ol chi' yik wach' syutej spensar heb' t'a heb'.
Ach Mamin Jehová ko Diosal, kolonheli. Ik'onhelta t'a skal juntzanh nación yik wach' skal wach' lolonel t'ayach, yik tzach ko b'itej t'a tzalajk'olal.
Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik t'a masanil tiempo. Ujokab'i, xchiokab' masanil heb' chonhab'. Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová.
Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová yujto wach', yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha onh kolb'il onh xo yuj, kalek to toxo ix onh kolchajel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' kajk'o'ol.
A' ix onh molb'ankot t'a juntzanh chonhab', b'aj sjawi k'u yet' b'aj tz'em k'u yet' t'a norte yet' t'a sur.
Ay mach sb'eyek' t'a tzinan lu'um b'aj malaj b'e, max ilchajlaj sb'e'al junok chonhab' yuj heb' b'aj syal skajnaji.
Ay swejel heb', ay stakinhti'al heb', toxo wal scham heb'.
Ha yuj syahelal heb' chi', ix yal sb'a heb' t'a Jehová, haxo ix kolanel heb'.
A' ix ik'anb'at heb' b'aj tojol sb'at sb'e'al jun chonhab' b'aj syal skajnaj heb'.
Yak'okab' yuj diosal heb' t'a Jehová yuj swach'k'olal, yuj pax skolwal satub'tak t'ayonh a onh anima onh tik.
A' tz'ik'anek' stakinhti'al mach stakji sti'. Tzijtum pax tas swaji syak' t'a mach ay swejel.
Ay mach kajanek' t'a skal k'ik' k'inal b'aj ay smay chamel. Ichato ayoch heb' preso yuj skusk'olal, ichato ay paxoch k'e'en cadena t'a heb',
yujto max sk'anab'ajej slolonel Jehová heb'. Ix spatikejkanel heb' tas nab'il yuj Dios Ek'to t'a yib'anh smasanil.
Ix ak'chajoch heb' t'a munlajel ya. Ix telwi heb', manhxalaj mach ix kolwaj t'a heb'.
Ha yuj syahelal heb' chi', ix yal sb'a heb' t'a Jehová, haxo ix kolanel heb' t'a syahelal chi'.
A' ix ilankot heb' t'a skal k'ik' k'inal, ix yik'anel k'e'en cadena ayoch t'a heb'.
Yak'okab' yuj diosal heb' t'a Jehová yuj swach'k'olal, yuj pax skolwal satub'tak t'ayonh a onh anima onh tik.
Ha ix jekchitan k'e'en puerta bronce, ix sk'okchitan k'e'en yipumal spuerta'il chi'.
Ha heb' chuk spensar, ix laj och syahelal heb'. Ayoch heb' t'a ilk'olal yuj schukal.
Ix syajkanel swa'el heb'. Toxo wal scham heb' syutej yab'ani.
Ha yuj syahelal heb' chi', ix yal sb'a heb' t'a Jehová, haxo ix kolanel heb' t'a syahelal chi'.
A' ix halani, ix b'oxi sk'o'ol heb'. Ix kolchaj heb' yuj t'a yol sk'ab' chamel.
Yak'okab' yuj diosal heb' t'a Jehová yuj swach'k'olal, yuj pax skolwal satub'tak t'ayonh a onh anima onh tik.
Yak'okab' silab' heb' t'ay t'a ak'oj yuj diosal. Yalokab' heb' t'a tzalajk'olal tas ix sk'ulej Jehová.
Ay juntzanh heb' chonhwajum ix b'at t'a yib'anh ha' mar, ix ek' heb' yet' sbarco t'a yib'anh ha'.
Hata' ix yil heb' tas satub'tak ix sk'ulej Jehová.
Ha Jehová ix halani, ix te owaj ha', ix k'e chulnaj ha' t'a cha'anh.
Ix ik'jicha'anh heb', ix ik'jixi'em heb' yuj ha', ix somchaj sk'ol heb' yuj smay ha'.
Ix te xiw heb', ix ek' ketkon heb' icha wal uk'um anh, manhxalaj ix aj yelk'och sjelanil heb'.
Ha yuj syahelal heb' chi' ix yal sb'a heb' t'a Jehová, haxo ix kolanel heb' t'a syahelal chi'.
A' ix ik'anel chakxuxum ik', ichato chi' ix och numnaj ha'.
Ix tzalaj heb' ayik ix yilan heb' snumk'aj ha'. Haxo Dios ix ik'anb'at heb' t'a puerto b'aj t'inhan sk'och heb' chi'.
Yak'okab' yuj diosal heb' t'a Jehová yuj swach'k'olal, yuj pax skolwal satub'tak t'ayonh a onh anima onh tik.
Yik'okab' cha'anh Jehová heb' b'aj smolb'ej sb'a heb' chonhab'. Yik'okab' cha'anh Dios heb' b'aj smolb'ej sb'a heb' ichamtak winak.
Ha b'aj tzek' a niwak ha' yet' b'aj sk'e'ul sjaj ha', smeltzajoch takinh lumal yuj Jehová.
A' sk'exan lum lum yax sat yik manhxalaj tas sk'ib' t'a lu'um. Yuj wal smul heb' anima kajanek' ta, yuj chi' icha chi' tz'aji.
Ha t'a lum takinh lu'um, scheklaj ha' kotak nhajab' yuj Jehová. Sk'epaxul sjaj ha ha' t'a lum yuj.
Hata' syak' kajnaj heb' anima ay swejel, sb'o'an niwak chonhab' heb' ta'.
Tz'awwi trigo heb' yet' uwa t'a sat slu'um. Te niwan sat yawb'en heb' chi' syik'a'.
A' Jehová chi' tz'ak'an swach'k'olal t'a heb', yuj chi' sk'ib' sb'isul heb'. Max emta sb'isul nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.
Tato tz'emta sb'isul heb', emnakilal, ilk'olal yet' yahelal sja t'a yib'anh heb' yuj heb' ajk'o'ol.
Palta a heb' niwak winak ajk'o'ol chi', a Jehová tz'ak'an satb'at heb' t'a tzinan lu'um b'aj manhxalaj b'e. Manhxalaj tz'ajkan yelk'och heb'.
Hanheja' tz'ik'anel kusk'olal t'a heb' meb'a', syik'ancha'anh sb'isul yuninal heb' icha wal sk'ib' sb'isul nok' kalnel.
Ayik syilan jun tik heb' anima wach' spensar, stzalaj sk'ol heb', haxo heb' anima chuk spensar jun, manhxalaj tas syal heb'.
Ha heb' jelan, sna'okab' juntzanh tik heb'. Nachajokab'el swach'k'olal Jehová yuj heb'.
Ach in Diosal, te b'ekan in k'o'ol in b'itan t'ayach. T'a smasanil in k'o'ol ol in b'itej wach' lolonel t'ayach yujto niwan elk'ochi.
Ayik sakb'i k'inal tzin b'itan t'ayach yet' te' arpa yet' pax salterio.
Mamin Jehová, ol in b'itej wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a skal anima t'a juntzanhxo nación.
Ha wal a wach'k'olal te niwan, tzek'b'at t'a yib'anh satcha'anh. Malaj b'ak'inh max ak'elk'och tas tzala'.
Ach in Diosal, cheklajokab' a b'inajnakil t'a satcha'anh. Cheklajokab' a poder t'a masanil yol yib'anhk'inal tik.
Kolonhel yet' a poder. Tak'wej onh yik wach' tzonh kolchaj a onh xajanab'il onh tik u'uj.
Ix lolonkot Dios masanto t'a skajnub', ix yalan icha tik: Ol tzalaj in k'o'ol ayik ol in kotak pojanb'at lum Siquem yet' yak'likal lum Sucot.
Haxo lum Galaad yet' lum Manasés wik yaj lu'um. Ha Efraín icha in k'e'en xumpil yaji. Haxo Judá icha sk'okochal wopisio yaji.
Ha Moab, icha yet'tal b'aj tzin b'ik in b'a yaji. Ha t'a yib'anh Edom ol wak'kanb'at in xanhab'. T'a tzalajk'olal ol in awajok yujto ol kan heb' filisteo t'a yalanh wu'uj, xchi Dios.
Ach in Diosal, ¿mach tzin ik'anb'at t'a jun chonhab' ayoch smuro'al t'a spatik yichanh? ¿Mach tzin ik'anb'at t'a Edom?
Ach ko Diosal, ix onh a patikejeli. Maxtzak yal-laj a k'ol tzach b'at yet' heb' ko soldado t'a owal.
Ochanh ket'ok, kolonhel t'a heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayonh. Ha skolwal heb' ketanima'il t'ayonh, malaj yalani.
Ach ko Diosal, a yet' a kolwal ol kak' ganar owal. A' ach ol a tek'kanem heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayonh.
Ach in Diosal, swal wach' lolonel t'ayach, manh ach b'at mikan t'a in lesal.
Yujto a heb' sk'ulan chukal yet' heb' tz'ak'an musansatil anima, chuk syal heb' t'a in patik. Esnhej tas syal heb' chi' t'a in patik.
Ha schichonk'olal heb' ste oymaj t'a in patik. Tz'och chi'an sk'ol heb' t'ayin, palta malaj in mul t'a heb'.
Ha spak in wach'k'olal t'a heb', to tz'och heb' ajk'olal t'ayin. Ha inxo jun, wan in lesalwi yuj heb'.
Ha in wach' pensaril t'a heb', chuk syutej heb' spaktzitan t'ayin. Haxo spak in wach'k'olal t'a heb', to schichon sk'ol heb' t'ayin.
Ha junok winh chuk spensar tzak'och juezal t'a yib'anh winh. A'okab' junok yajk'o'ol winh tz'ak'ankanb'at t'a yib'anh.
Ayik sch'olb'itaj winh, alchajokab'i to ay smul winh. Ochokab' pax slesal winh smulok.
Tzapanokab' tzutej sk'inal winh. Ch'okokab' pax mach tz'ochkan t'a yopisio winh.
Mheb'a' uninokab' tz'ajkan heb' yuninal winh. Haxo ix yetb'eyum winh, kanokab' ix t'a manh etb'eyumal.
Ek'okab' heb' yuninal winh sk'an wa sb'a t'a titak pat. Pechchajokab'el heb' b'aj ek'nak spat.
Ik'chajokab' ek' masanil tastak ay t'a heb' yuj winh tz'ak'an tumin majanil. Ik'chajokab'b'at smunlajel winh yuj heb' ch'ok anima'il.
Malajokab' mach tz'ok' sk'o'ol t'a winh. Malajokab' pax mach tz'ok' sk'ol t'a heb' yuninal winh mheb'axo.
Satokab'el yinhtilal winh, satokab'el sb'i winh t'a junelnhej.
Mamin Jehová, nakot smul heb' smam yicham winh. Mokab' a suk sat smul snun winh.
Na'anokab' smul heb' u'uj. Mokxob' nachajkot heb' t'a sat lu'um tik.
Yujto manh na'anok yak'an wach'k'olal winh. Palta to ix och winh ajk'olal t'a heb' meb'a', t'a heb' anima emnakil yek'i yet' t'a heb' ayoch t'a ilk'olal, masanto smilcham heb' winh.
Skatab'ej anima winh, kotokab' katab' t'a yib'anh winh. Malajokab' b'ak'inh scha wach'k'olal winh yujto maj yak'laj swach'k'olal winh t'a heb' anima chi'.
Haxonhej katab' syal winh, ichato a katab' chi' spichul winh yaji. Ha katab' chi', icha ha' sikil ha' skuk'ej, ma icha aceite sko sukek' t'ayonh, icha chi' yaj t'a winh.
Kotokab' yahelal t'a yib'anh sniwanil winh yuj skatab'an heb' anima chi', icha smuschaj ko niwanil yet' ko pichul. Ochokab'kan sut'an yahelal chi' t'a winh t'a masanil tiempo icha junok tzek'ul.
Mamin Jehová, icha'okab' tik tzutej heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, haton heb' tz'alan in pekal.
Ha hachxo pax ach Jehová Wajalil, ak'kot a wach'k'olal t'a wib'anh yik ol ach ik'jokcha'anh. Yuj a wach'k'olal t'ayin, kolineli.
Te meb'a' in, manhxo anima'ok wet'nak swutej wab'ani, icha wal to lajwinak in swab'i.
Wan in satel icha junok enhul. Wan wik'jib'at yuj ik' ichok nok' k'ulub'.
Wan yib'xi sjolom in penek, manhxalaj wip yujto maxtzak in walaj. Wan in b'akb'i.
Tzheb'ajtak wilji t'a heb' anima. Ayik tzin yilan heb', sb'uchwaj heb' t'ayin.
Mamin Jehová, ochanh wet'ok. Ach in Diosal, kolinel yuj a wach'k'olal.

Ha heb' sb'o'an juntzanh yechel chi' yet' heb' tz'ak'anoch sk'o'ol t'ay, lajan heb' yet'ok.
Ex wetchonhab' Israel, ak'ekoch Jehová yipok he k'o'ol, ha' tz'och ket'ok, ha' tzonh kolani.
Ex sacerdote, ak'ekoch Jehová yipok he k'o'ol, ha' tz'och ket'ok, ha' tzonh kolani.
Mach onh ay yelk'och Jehová t'ayonh, kak'ekoch yipok ko k'o'ol, ha' tz'och ket'ok, ha' tzonh kolani.
Ix onh snakot Jehová, ol yak' swach'k'olal t'a kib'anh. Ol yak' swach'k'olal t'ayonh a onh israel onh tik. Ol yak' swach'k'olal t'a yib'anh heb' sacerdote yinhtilal winhaj Aarón.
Mach onh ay yelk'och Jehová t'ayonh, ol yak' swach'k'olal t'ayonh, wach'chom niwak kopisio, wach'chom malaj kelk'ochi.
A'okab' Jehová tz'ak'an k'ib' sb'isul heb' kuninal yet' heb' ki ko chikin.
Yak'okab' swach'k'olal Jehová ixb'o'an satcha'anh yet' lum lum tik t'ayonh.
Haton Jehová ay yik satcha'anh, haxo lum lum tik, ix yak' lum t'ayonh a onh anima onh tik.
Ha heb' toxo ix k'och b'aj ay heb' chamnak, maxtzak yal-laj yalan wach' lolonel heb' t'a Jehová.
Ha onhxo pitzan onh to tik jun, ol kal wach' lolonel t'ay tikne'ik yet' t'a masanil k 'inal. Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová.
Tzin xajanej Jehová, yujto ix yab' in lesal ayik ix in tewi t'ay.
Yujto ix yab' tas ix in k'an t'ay, yuj chi' ol wal in b'a t'ay yakb'an pitzan hinto.
Ijan wal ix in yamchaj yuj chamel. Ix ja syahelal chamel t'ayin. Ha ilk'olal yet' yahelal ix jawi t'a wib'anh.
Ichato chi' ix walan in b'a t'a Jehová. Ix in tewi t'ay yik syak'an b'oxok in k'o'ol.
Ha Jehová, tojol toni, tz'ok' sk'ol t'ayonh. Ha ko Diosal, yelxo wal te niwan swach'k'olal.
Ha stanhwan heb' emnakil yek'i. Ayik toxo ix el wip, a ix in kolani.
Ayxo in junk'olal tikne'ik swab'i, yujto a Jehová wach' ix yutej sk'ol t'ayin.
Maj in scha chamlaj, ix in skol t'a in kusk'olal, maj in schalaj telwok.
Yakb'an pitzan hinto ol in k'anab'ajej.
Ix wak'och Jehová yipok in k'o'ol, t'a skal in niwan yahelal ix walani: Te ya ayin, xin chi.
Manhxo anima'ok waj swab'i, yuj chi' ix wala' to masanil heb' anima, max yal-laj kak'anoch tas syal heb' yipok ko k'o'ol.
¿Tas ol wutej wak'an spak masanil swach'k'olal Jehová ix yak' t'ayin?
Ol wik'kot wino ofrenda'il t'ay yuj wak'an yuj diosal t'ay, yujto ix in skolo'.
Ha t'a yichanh masanil schonhab' ol wak'elk'och tas ix wal t'ay.
Te niwan yelk'och t'a yichanh Jehová ayik scham junok mach yikxo.
Mamin Jehová, a in ton tik, a chekab' in. Ha ach ix in a koleli, yuj chi' libre in tikne'ik.
Ol wak' in silab' yuj ak'oj yuj diosal t'ayach yuj spakok a wach'k'olal. Ol wal in b'a t'ayach.
Mamin Jehová, ol wak'elk'och in ti' t'ayach t'a yichanh masanil heb' a chonhab',
t'a yamak'il a templo t'a snanhal chonhab' Jerusalén. Skal wach' lolonel t'ayach Jehová.
Ex anima kajan ex t'a masanil nación yet' chonhab', alek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová.
Ha swach'k'olal t'ayonh te niwan. Tz'elnhejk'och tas syal t'a masanil tiempo. Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová.
Kak'ek yuj diosal t'a Jehová yujto wach' spensar. Ha swach'k'olal aynhejek' t'a masanil tiempo.
Kalek a onh israel onh tik to a swach'k'olal Jehová aynhejek' t'a masanil tiempo.
Yalokab' heb' sacerdote to a swach'k'olal Jehová aynhejek' t'a masanil tiempo.
Kalek a onh ay yelk'och Jehová t'ayonh to a swach'k'olal aynhejek' t'a masanil tiempo.
Ay in wal och t'a in yahelal, ix in awaj t'a Jehová, ix yab' in lesal, ix in skolaneli.
Ayek' Jehová wet'ok, manh ol in xiwlaj yuj tas ol in yutok heb' wetanima'il.
Ayek' Jehová wet'ok, yujto a tzin kolani, yuj chi' ol wil yak'ji ganar heb' tzin chakaneli.
Yelxo wal te wach' tato skak'och Jehová yipok ko k'o'ol t'a yichanh to a heb' ketanima'il skak'och yipok ko k'o'ol.
Yelxo wal te wach' tato skak'och Jehová yipok ko k'o'ol t'a yichanh to a heb' yajal skak'och yipok ko k'o'ol.
Ix och hoyan masanil heb' ch'ok chonhab'il t'a in patik wichanh, palta yuj spoder Jehová ix wak' ganar heb'.
Ix och hoyan heb' t'ayin icha wal nok' nok'al chab', haxo yowal heb' chi' ix tupkanel icha stup te' k'ak' t'a junok te' takinh k'i'ix. Yuj spoder Jehová ix wak' ganar heb'.
Tzin yek telwok heb' t'a smasanil yip sna'ani, palta haxo Jehová sjawi in skolo'.
Tzin b'itan t'a Jehová. Ha tz'ak'anoch wip, in Kolumal yaji.
Ha t'a spat heb' anima tojol spensar ay b'it yet' tzalajk'olal, yujto ix yak' ganar owal heb' yuj spoder Jehová te satub'tak.
Yuj spoder Jehová chi' ix ak'ji ganar heb' ajk'o'ol. Satub'tak yoch spoder chi'.
Manto ol in chamlaj, palta ayto in k 'inal yik wach' ol walel tas ix sb'o Jehová wet'ok.
Te niwan in yahelal ix yak'a', palta maj in scha chamlaj.
Jakek spuerta'il stemplo Dios Tojol. In gana tzin ochi yik swak' yuj diosal t'ay ta'.
Haton jun tik spuerta'il b'aj tzonh k'och t'a yichanh Jehová. Hata' ol ochk'och heb' tojol sb'eyb'al.
Swak' yuj diosal t'ayach Jehová yujto ix ach tak'wi t'ayin, in Kolumal ach.
Ha jun k'e'en k'e'en malaj yelk'och t'a yichanh heb' b'o'um pat, haton k'e'en ix ochkan sjolomok schikin te' pat chi'.
Icha chi' ix yutej Jehová. Yuj chi' ayik skilani, ste sat ko k'o'ol yuj.
Haton t'a jun k'u tik ix yak'elk'och Jehová tas nab'ilkan yuj, yuj chi' tzonh tzalaj tikne'ik, tz'el lenaj skila'.
Mamin Jehová, kotanh k'elan t'ayonh, kolonheli, wach'okab' tzonh ajkan u'uj.
Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jun chekb'ilkot yuj Jehová. Skal wach' lolonel t'ayex mach ex molan ex ek' t'a stemplo Jehová.
Ha Jehová Dios toni, a tz'ak'an sakil k'inal t'ayonh. Kak'ekoch k'inh, skik'ankot skab' te te' ay xi'il, tzonh ek'ek oyoyok t'a spatik altar.
Skak' yuj diosal t'ayach Mamin, yujto ko Diosal ach, skal wach' lolonel t'ayach, tzach kik'ancha'anh.

Ha heb' tz'awwi t'a skal ok'el, ol smol sat tas syawej heb' chi' t'a tzalajk'olal.
Wach'chom wan yok' heb' ayik syawanem ixim inhat te nib'ab'il heb'. Palta ayik ol elul ixim trigo chi', haxonhej b'it ol yak' heb' yuj tzalajk'olal ayik mek'b'ilxok'e ixim yuj heb'.
Tato manhok Jehová sb'o'an junok pat, nab'anhej am smunlaj heb' munlajwum. Tato manhok stanhwan junok chonhab', nab'anhej am stanhwaj yuj heb' stanhwumal.

Nab'anhej syixtej sb'a heb' pilan jun k'u syak' smunlaji, ste och heb' t'a ilk'olal yik tz'ilchaj swa'el heb', palta haxo pax heb' xajan yuj Dios, junk'olal sway heb', ha Dios chi' tz'ak'an tas tz'och yuj heb'.
Ha heb' kuninal, silab' Jehová yaj heb'. Ha heb' kuninal yet' ix ketb'eyum, swach'k'olalton Dios yaj heb'.
Ha heb' kuninal tz'alji ayik kelem anima onhto, icha wal juntzanh jul-lab' ay t'a yol sk'ab' junok ak'um owal yaj heb'.
Te wach' yik mach manh jantakok yuninal chi'. Manh ol k'ixwokel-laj yuj heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ay, ayik ol skolan sb'a t'a yichanh heb' yajal.
Te wach' yik junok mach ay xiwk'olal t'a Jehová, sb'eyb'alan pax scheknab'il.
T'a tzalajk'olal ol yab'lej sat tas syawej, te wach'nhej ol elk'ochok.
Icha satan te' uwa t'a spatik schikin spat, manh jantakok sat syak'a', icha wal chi' ol aj ix yetb'eyum. Icha swol te' olivo, icha wal chi' ol ajoch hoyan heb' yuninal t'a spatik smexa.
Icha wal chi' ol aj yak'an swach'k'olal Jehová t'a junok mach ay xiwk'olal t'ay.
Yak'okab'kot swach'k'olal Jehová t'a kib'anh masanto t'a tzalan Sion. Kilokab' swach'k'olal Jehová t'a Jerusalén t'a junjun k'u yakb'an pitzan onhto.
Olto kilek tas ol aj heb' yuninal heb' kuninal. Ayokab' junk'olal t'a kib'anh a onh israel onh tik.
Yiktax yichb'anel, manh jantakok yahelal ix yak'och heb' ajk'ol t'a kib'anh a onh israel onh tik. Yuj chi' a tikne'ik kalek icha tik:
Manhxo jantakok yahelal ix yak'och heb' ajk'ol t'a kib'anh yiktax t'a yichb'anel, palta maj tzak'wanlaj chi' t'ayonh.
Ixlajwi yich ko patik smak'an heb', te niwan chekel ix aj staji schik'il yich ko patik chi' yuj heb'.
Haxo Jehová, tojol toni, ha' ix onh kolan t'a yol sk'ab' heb' sk'ulan chukal chi', xko chiokab'i.
Ha heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'a Sion, k'ixwokab' heb', b'atokab' heb' elelal.
Icha tz'aj anh ank'ultak sk'ib' t'a yib'anh pat, jab'nhej sk'ib' ste'el, elanhchamel stakji'eli, ichokab' ta' tz'aj heb'.
Ha anh ank'ultak chi', max ko jochlaj anh, max ko tzek'paxlaj anh t'a manoja'il.
Manh ol yal-laj heb' anima tzek' t'a stz'ey anh ank'ultak chi': Yak'okab' syaxilal Jehová t'a yib'anh anh. Sko k'an yaxilal t'a yib'anh anh, manh xchiok heb'.
Mamin Jehová, swal in b'a t'ayach yujto ayin och t'a wilk'olal, ichato ay in ek' t'a jun olan te jul yich swab'i.
Mamin, ab' in jaj tikne'ik, ak'kot tz'eyan a chikin ayik tzin awaj in k'anan a kolwal.
Mamin Jehová, k'inalok tato tz'ib'ab'il ko chukal u'uj ¿mach wal ol stek'b'ej sb'a t'a ichanh?
Palta a t'ayach tz'ilchaj niwank'olal ku'uj, yik wach' ay elk'och t'a ko sat.
Mamin Jehová, t'a wal smasanil in k'o'ol tzin tanhwej yik tzach jawi in a kolo'. Swak'och a lolonel yipok in k'o'ol.
Mamin, ek'al in tanhwan a kolwal t'a yichanh heb' winh stanhwumal chonhab' snib'ej spet sakb'i. Ek'alto in maklan a kolwal chi' t'a heb' winh stanhwan heb' chonhab' chi'.
Kak'ekoch Jehová yipok ko k'o'ol a onh israel onh tik, yujto ay yok'elk'olal, b'ekannhej sk'o'ol skolwaji.
A' ol onh kolanel t'a yalanh smasanil ko mul.
Mamin Jehová, manh ak'umtakok swutej in b'a, max wik'lajcha'anh in b'a, max wak'och in b'a t'a tas niwak yelk'ochi, t'a tas max in tzak'wanlaj in b'o'ani.
Palta munil ayin ek'i, malaj tas tzin na'a. Icha wal junok nene' slajwi schuni, chelb'ilk'e yuj snun, icha chi' waji.
Ex wetchonhab', kak'ekoch Jehová yipok ko k'o'ol tikne'ik yet' t'a masanil tiempo.
Mamin Jehová Te ay ip, ko Diosal ach a onh yinhtil onh winhaj Jacob, nakot winhaj David yet' syahelal. Nakot sti' winh ix yak' t'ayach ayik ix yalan winh:
Manh ol in och t'a yol in pat, manh ol in ek'laj jichan t'a sat in ch'at,
manh ol in mutz'laj in sat, manh ol ochlaj numnaj jab'ok in wayanh
ayik manto in b'o junok kajnub' b'aj skajnaj Jehová ko Diosal Te ay yip a onh yinhtil onh winhaj Jacob, xchikan winh.
Ha t'a Efrata ix kab' yab'ixal te' skaxa'il strato Dios, haxo t'a yol lum smakb'en winhaj Jaar ix ilchaj te' ku'uj.
Koyek t'a stemplo Jehová, haxo ta' tzonh emek kuman t'a yichanh.
Mamin Jehová, kotanh t'a a kajnub' aynhej ek'i. Kotanh yet' te' skaxa'il a trato, haton b'aj scheklajel a poder.
A'okab' wach'il sb'eyb'alej heb' a sacerdote. Elokab' yaw heb' ikxo t'a tzalajk'olal.
Yuj tas alnakkan t'a winh a chekab' aj David, manh ik'el a sat t'a winh rey sik'b'ilel u'uj.
Ach Jehová, ix ak'kan a ti' t'a winhaj David t'a sjichanil to manh ol a k'exlaj tas ix ala', ayik ix halan icha tik: Ha junok uninal ol wak'kanoch reyal a k'exulok.
Tato sk'anab'ajej in trato heb' inhtilal yet' tastak ol wal t'a heb', ol ochnhej heb' t'a a despacho t'a masanil tiempo, xa chi t'a winh.
Mamin Jehová, a ach ix a sik'kanel lum tzalan Sion yik tzach kajnaj ta', yujto icha chi' snib'ej a k'o'ol.
Ix halan icha tik: Haton jun tzalan tik b'aj in gana tzin kajnaji. Ol in kajnaj t'a lu'um yujto icha chi' ix aj scha'an in k'o'ol.
Manh jantakok wa'el uk'el ol wak' t'a heb' ayek' kajan ta', ol wak'an b'ut'jok sk'o'ol heb' meb'a'.
Ol in kol heb' sacerdote. Haxo heb' ol in k'anab'ajanok, ol wak' awajk'e heb' yuj tzalajk'olal.
Ha t'a Sion chi', ol wak'och jun yinhtilal winhaj David reyal. Ha winh sik'b'ilel wu'uj, manhxa b'ak'inh ol yaktej heb' yinhtilal winh yak'an reyal.
Ha heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'a winh ol wak'kan k'ixwelal heb'. Haxo yopisio winh, ol wik'cha'anh, xa chikan ach Jehová.
Na'eknab'i, manh jantakok swach'il scha'an sb'a yaj heb' sk'ab' yok sb'a ayik junnhej tz'aj spensar heb'.
Lajan yet' jun perfume manh jantakok swach'il skot jililok t'a sjolom winhaj sacerdote Aarón, tz'emul t'a xil sti' winh, tz'emk'och t'a spayu'al sjaj spichul winh.
Lajan wal icha yal ak'wal tz'em t'a sjolom lum witzal Hermón, tz'empax t'a lum tzalan Sion. Ha b'aj ay junk'olal chi', syak'b'at swach'k'olal Jehová, haton k 'inal t'a junelnhej.
Ex schekab' Jehová, alek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová chi'. Alek wach' lolonel t'ay mach ex tze tanhwej stemplo tzek' ak'wal.
Ik'ekk'e wan he k'ab' t'a stojolal skajnub' Jehová, tzeyalan wach' lolonel t'ay.
Ha Jehová b'o'annak satcha'anh yet' lum lum tik, a'okab' tz'ak'ankot swach'k'olal t'a eyib'anh masanto t'a lum tzalan Sion.
Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová. Ex schekab' ex Jehová, alek wach' lolonel t'ay.
Mach ex ayex ek' t'a yamak'il stemplo Jehová ko Diosal,
alek wach' lolonel t'ay, yujto wach'. B'itananhek t'ay yujto te ay swach'k'olal t'ayonh anima onh tik.
Ix onh sik'kanel a onh israel onh yinhtilal onh winhaj Jacob, yik tzonh och yikok.
Ha in tik wojtak wal sik'lab'il to a Jehová ko Diosal, yelxo wal ek'b'al yelk'och t'a yichanh masanil komon Dios.
Syalnhej sk'ulan masanil tas snib'ej sk'ulej, wach'chom t'a satcha'anh, ma t'a sat lu'um tik, ma t'a ha' mar, ma pax t'a yich ha'.
A' tz'ak'ankot asun b'aj slajwik'och lum lum tik. A' tz'ak'anek' kopnaj lheb'lon ayik syak'an nhab'. A' sjakanelta ik' b'aj molanek' yuj.
A' milannakcham heb' b'ab'el unin t'a junjun patil heb' aj Egipto yet' pax sb'ab'el yune' junjun nok' snok' heb'.
Ha t'a snanhal chonhab' Egipto chi', ay juntzanh tas te satub'tak sk'ulejnak yik syak'an syahelal winh rey yet' pax heb' schekab' winh.
Tzijtum juntzanh chonhab' satnakel yuj, smilannakcham heb' rey te niwak yopisio.
Smilnakcham winhaj Sehón, sreyal heb' amorreo yet' winhaj Og sreyal Basán yet' masanil heb' rey t'a yol yik Canaán.
Haxo lum slu'um heb' rey chi' yak'nak t'ayonh a onh israel onh tik, yik skikejkan lu'um.
Mamin Jehová, a a b'inajnakil malaj b'ak'inh ol satelok. T'a masanil tiempo ol ach nachajkotok.
Ha Jehová sb'o'an yaj owal t'a heb' schonhab', tz'ok' sk'ol t'a heb' schekab'.
Ha sdiosal heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, nab'a oro, nab'a plata, anima sb'o'ani.
Ay sti' sdiosal heb' chi', palta max lolonlaj. Ay sat, palta max yil-laj.
Ay schikin, palta max yab'laj, max yik'laj yik'.
Ha heb' sb'o'an juntzanh yechel chi' yet' heb' tz'ak'anoch t'a sk'o'ol, lajan heb' yet'ok.
Ex wetisraelal, kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová. Ex sacerdote, ex yinhtilal winhaj Aarón, alek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová.
Ex yinhtilal winhaj Leví, alek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová. Mach ex ay yelk'och Jehová t'a he sat, alek wach' lolonel t'ay.
Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová t'a Sion, haton t'a Jerusalén b'aj kajan. Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová.
Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová yujto te wach' spensar, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Dios, haton sDiosal masanil juntzanh Dios, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Dios Yajal heb' yajal, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
Anhej sb'o'an tas te satub'tak, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' b'o'annak satcha'anh yet' sjelanil, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' b'o'annakk'e lum lum t'a yib'anh ha' mar te jul yich, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' b'o'annak k'u yet' k'e'en uj, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' b'o'annak k'u yik ay sakil k'inal t'a k'uhalil, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' b'o'annak k'e'en uj yet' k'e'en k'anal yik ay sakil k'inal t'ak'walil, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' milannakcham heb' b'ab'el unin t'a junjun pat t'a Egipto, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' ik'annakelta heb' israel ko mam kicham t'a Egipto chi', yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
Yet' wal spoder yik'nakelta heb', yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' pojannak em snanhal ha' Chakchak Mar, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' ik'annak ek'ta heb' israel t'a snanhal ha' mar chi', yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
Palta haxo winh sreyal Egipto yet' heb' soldado, b'atnakkan heb' yuj t'a yol ha' mar chi', yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' ik'annak b'ey heb' schonhab' t'a tzinan lu'um, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' milannakcham heb' niwak rey, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' ik'annakel sk'inal heb' rey te b'inajnak, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
Haton winhaj Sehón sreyal heb' amorreo, ik'jinakel sk'inal winh yuj, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
Yet' pax winhaj Og sreyal Basán, ik'jinakel sk'inal winh yuj, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' ik'annak ek' lum slu'um heb' rey chi', yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
Yak'nakkan lu'um kikok a onh israel schekab' onh tik, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' onh na'ankoti ayik ayonhek' t'a skal yahelal, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
Ix onh skolkanel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayonh, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
A' tz'ak'an tas swa heb' anima yet' nok' nok', yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
Kalek wach' lolonel t'a sDiosal satcha'anh, yujto aynhej swach'k'olal t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha t'a sti' ha ha' t'a yol yik Babilonia, onh em k'ojan ayik ix ko na'ankot Sion, ix onh ok' b'i'an.
Ix kak'k'e lokan te' arpa t'a sk'ab' te' tak'u ay t'a sti' ha ha' chi'.
Ha heb' ix onh ik'anb'at icha t'a preso, ix b'uchwaj heb' t'ayonh, ix yalan heb' icha tik: B'itananhek t'a tzalajk'olal, a sb'ital Sion tze b'itej t'ayonh, xchi heb'.
¿Tom ol ko b'itej b'it yik Jehová t'a lum ch'ok chonhab'il? xko chi.
Tato sb'at satk'olal Jerusalén wu'uj, satokab' sjelanil in wach' k'ab' tik in chalan te' warpa.
Tato manhxo na'anok Jerusalén wu'uj, tato manhxa pax in gana t'ay t'a yichanh pax tas snib'ej in k'o'ol, kanokab' lotznaj wak' t'a in jo'om, yik wach' manhxo ol yal-laj in b'itani.
Mamin Jehová, nakot heb' aj Edom, yujto ayik ix yamchaj chonhab' Jerusalén, ix yal heb' icha tik: Pojekemi, pojekemi, masanto scheklaj cimiento'al yich, xchi heb'.
Ex aj Babilonia, ol ex satpaxelok. Te wach' yik mach ol ak'anek' spak chukal tas ix onh eyutej.
Te wach' yik mach ol yaman heb' eyuninal, ol smak'anpoj sjolom heb' t'a spatiktak k'e'en k'e'en.
Mamin Jehová, t'a smasanil in k'o'ol ol wak' yuj diosal t'ayach, ol ach in b'itej t'a yichanh juntzanh Dios.

Ol in em kuman t'ayach t'a stojolal a templo to iknhej yaji, yuj wak'an yuj diosal t'ayach yuj a wach'k'olal, yujto tzak'elk'och tas tzala'. Ix ik'cha'anh a b'i yet' a lolonel t'a yib'anh masanil tastak.
Ix ach tak'wi t'ayin ayik ix in awaj t'ayach, ix ak'an wip.
Masanil heb' rey t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ol yal wach' lolonel heb' t'ayach ayik ol yab'an heb' tas alnakkani.
Ol yal wach' lolonel heb' t'ayach yuj tastak a b'onak, yujto te niwan yelk'och a b'inajnakil.
Wach'chom te niwan elk'ochi, palta tz'ok' a k'ol t'a heb' anima emnakil yek'i, haxo heb' syik'cha'anh sb'a, max ach b'atlaj k'elan t'a heb'.
Ayik ay in ek' t'a skal tas ay smay, pitzan innhej u'uj, tzak'ankot a poder, tzin a kolanel t'a yowal heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin.
Ach Jehová, ol ach och wet'ok yik wach'nhej tzin elk'och t'a tas tza na t'ayin. Ha a wach'k'olal aynhejek' t'a masanil tiempo. Ha tastak ix ik'el yich t'ayin, mokab' kan xepan.
Mamin Jehová, ojtak in sik'lab'il, ix in a b'eyk'olej sik'lab'il.
Ojtak ayik tzin em k'ojan yet' pax yik tzin k'e wa'an. Ayokto tzojtakanel tas tzin na'a.
Ojtakxo b'ajtil tzin ek'i yet' b'ajtil swik' wip. Ojtak pax masanil tas tzin k'ulej.
Ayik mantzak in na tas ol wala' a hachxo pax Mamin, ojtakxo.
Ayachnhejek' t'a in patik wichanh, b'akhanb'at a k'ab' t'a wib'anh.
Satub'tak yoch a jelanil tik, manh jab'ok snachajel wu'uj, te niwan yelk'ochi, ste sat in k'o'ol yuj.
