Tato tzin k'ek'och t'a satcha'anh, hata' ayach ek'i. Tato tzin em t'a yol lu'um, ay ach pax ek'ta.
Tato tzin b'at t'a yichanhb'at b'aj sjawi k'u, ma tzin b'at kajan t'a sk'axepal ha' mar b'aj tz'em k'u,
palta sk'och pax a k'ab' t'ayin ta'. Tzin a ketzcha'anh yet' a wach' k'ab', tzin ik'an b'eyok.
Tato tzin na in k'ub'ejel in b'a t'a skal k'ik' k'inal, mato a sakil k'inal oyanoch t'a in patik tz'och k'ik'alk'inalil,
a t'ak'walil chi' max yal-laj in sk'ub'anel t'a ichanh. Ha k'ik' k'inal, lajan yet' sakil k'inal t'a ichanh. Malaj sk'exanhil t'ak'walil t'a ichanh, yujto sakilk'inalnhej masanil t'ayach.
Ha ach ton ix a b'o masanil tas t'a in niwanil tik. Ha ach ix in a b'o t'a yol sk'o'ol in nun.
Swal wach' lolonel t'ayach, yujto satub'tak tas tza b'o'o. Sat in k'ol in na'ani, palta wojtak sik'lab'il to icha chi' yaji.
Ayik ix k'ib' in niwanil tik t'a yol sk'ol in nun, wach'chom manh chekelok, palta manh k'ub'eltakok yaj t'a yol a sat.
Ha ach ix il in niwanil tik ayik manto in aljilaj. Masanil sb'isul sk'uhal in k 'inal, tz'ib'ab'il t'a yol a libro ayik mantalaj junok k'uhal swila'.
Ach in Diosal, max nachajel-laj wu'uj tas yaj a pensar t'ayin. Manhxo b'ischajb'enok a pensar chi'.
Tato tzin och ijan in b'isani, ek'to sb'isul t'a yichanh k'e'en arena. Ayik tz'el in wayanh, ayinnhej ek' t'a ichanh.
Ach in Diosal, ik'el sk'inal heb' sk'ulan chukal. Najat tzik'kanel heb' mak'umcham anima t'a in tz'ey.
Yujto chuk tas syal heb', tzach yalub'tanhej heb' t'a chukal.
Mamin Jehová, tzin chak heb' tzach chakani, max in nib'ejlaj heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach.
Junelnhej malaj in gana swil heb', aypaxoch heb' ajk'olal t'ayin walani.
Ach in Diosal, b'eytzitej tas waji, il pax in pensar.
Ila' tato wan in b'at t'a chukal b'eyb'al, tzin a kuchb'anb'at t'a sb'e'al k 'inal to aynhej t'a masanil tiempo.
Mamin Jehová, kolinel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' sk'ulan chukal, k'ub'ej in el t'a heb' b'aj malaj yelk'och a k'ayb'ub'al,
yet' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' na'annhej chukal yuj, yujto anhej owal sna heb' t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha sti' heb' icha wal sti' nok' chan, a tas syal heb' icha wal sveneno'al sti' junok nok' chan smilan anima.
Mamin Jehová, k'ub'ej in el t'a heb' sk'ulan chukal, heb' malaj yelk'och a k'ayb'ub'al t'ay, heb' na'annhej yuj tas tz'aj in yak'an telwok.
Ha juntzanh heb' anima syik'cha'anh sb'a chi', ix yak'em ya'al heb' t'a yol in b'e.
Mamin Jehová, a t'ayach ix wala': In Diosal ach, ab' tas swala' ayik tzin awaji swalan in b'a t'ayach.
Mamin Dios, ach Wajalil, in Kolumal to syalnhej u'uj, a ach ton tzin a kol t'a skal owal, xin chi.

Mamin Jehová, manh ak' snib'ej heb' sk'ulan chukal, manh ak' snib'ej spensar heb' yik max yik'cha'anh sb'a heb'. Ha heb' tzoymajoch t'ayin, sna tastak heb', palta a'okab' tas sna heb' chi' skot t'a yib'anh.
Emokab' tzak'ak' chak xilinak t'a yib'anh heb', b'atokab' heb' t'a skal k'ak'. Yumjokab'b'at heb' t'a yol xab' olan, b'aj maxtzak yal-laj sk'eta heb'.
Mokxob' kajnajek' heb' alum chukal lolonel t'a sat lu'um tik. Jawokab' yahelal t'a yib'anh heb' malaj yelk'och a k'ayb'ub'al t'ay, satokab'el heb'.
Wojtak a in tik to a ach tza b'o yaj yowal heb' meb'a', tza kolanel heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' tz'ik'ankanek' junok tas t'a heb'.
Ha heb' anima wach' spensar, ol yal wach' lolonel heb' t'ayach. Ha heb' anima tojol sb'eyb'al, ol ajnhejek' heb' t'a ichanh.
Mamin Jehová, swal in b'a t'ayach, kotanh t'a elanhchamel. Ab' in jaj ayik swalan in b'a t'a ichanh.
Mamin, wach'okab' sk'ek'och in lesal icha wal sk'e stab'il incienso t'a ichanh. Haxo in k'ab' mojank'e t'ayach, lajanokab' wal icha ofrenda t'a yemk'uhalil t'a yol a sat.
Mamin Jehová, tanhwej in ti', yik wach' manh ol wal chukal lolonel.
Najat tzik'kanel chukal t'a in pensar. Manh in a cha b'eyek' t'a chukal b'eyb'al. Manh in a chab'at wa'el b'aj ay sniwak wa'el heb' sk'ulan chukal.

Tato a junok anima wach' tzin mak'ani, wach'ton tzin yutej. Tato tzin stumej, icha wal to syak'och perfume t'ayin, yuj chi' scha in k'o'ol. Palta tzin lesalwinhej yik wach' syamchajoch wa'an tas sk'ulej heb' chuk.
Ha heb' yajalil heb' sk'ulan chukal, ol ekchajb'at heb' t'a sattak tenam, icha chi' ol aj yilan heb' anima to yel ix wala'.
Ha sb'akil heb', sakleminak ol ajkanb'at b'aj smukchaj heb' chamnak, icha tz'ajkanb'at lum lum ayik sb'oji junok olan.
Mamin Jehová in Diosal ach, ay wal och in pensar t'ayach. Ha t'ayach tzin say in kolnab'il, manh in aktejkani.
Kolinel t'a sya'al heb' tz'ak'an chukal t'ayin.
Kanokab' heb' chuk chi' t'a sya'al chi', a inxo jun, ol in ek'nhej.
Mamin Jehová, a t'ayach tzin awaji ayik swalan in b'a. Swak' wal wip in k'anan t'ayach to tz'ok' a k'o'ol t'ayin.
T'a ichanh swal in b'a, a wal t'a ichanh swal wilk'olal.
Mamin Jehová, ayik manhxo anima'ok waj swab'i, ojtak wal in b'e. Ha t'a jun b'e b'aj tzin b'ati, hata' ix yak'em ya'al heb' ajk'ol t'ayin.
Tzin b'at k'elan t'a in wach', malaj junok mach sjawi yik tz'och wet'ok. Malaj mach tzin kolani. Malaj mach tz'och ilk'olal wu'uj, wach'chom tzin chami.
Mamin, a wal t'ayach swal in b'a, swalan icha tik: Ha t'ayach tzin kol in b'a, a achnhej tzach in nib'ej t'a yichanh masanil tas t'a sat lu'um tik.
Kotanh k'elan t'ayin tzin awaj t'ayach, yujto malaj wip. Kolinel t'a heb' tzin pechan b'eyek'ok, yujto te ay yip heb' t'a wichanh.
Ik' in elta t'a skal in yahelal in k'ana', yik wach' ol wal wach' lolonel t'ayach, haxo heb' anima wach' spensar ol och hoyan heb' t'a in patik ayik ol ak'an a wach'k'olal t'ayin, xin chi.
Mamin Jehová, ab' in lesal, cham wal ab'an tas swala'. Tak'wanh t'ayin, ina to te tojol ach, tzak'annhejelk'och tas tzala'.
Manh a k'anb'ej tas waj a in a chekab' in tik, yujto malaj junok mach wach' yaj t'a a sat.
Ix in pechji b'eyek' yuj heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, ix in stek'anem heb' t'a sat lu'um. Ix in yak' kajnaj heb' t'a skal k'ik' k'inal, icha wal yaj heb' chamnakxo.
Manhxo anima'ok waj tikne'ik swab'i, te somchajnak in k'o'ol.
Tzin nakot juntzanh k'uhal ek'nak t'a peka', tzin na'ub'tanhan masanil tas a b'onak t'a yalanhtax chi'.
Ha t'ayach tzin mojb'ejk'e in k'ab', tzach in nib'ej wal, icha wal junok lum takinh lu'um snib'an ha ha'.
Mamin Jehová, tak'wanh t'ayin t'a elanhchamel, toxo wal tz'el in k'ol swab'i. Manh a ya'ej a kolwal t'ayin. Icha wal heb' chamnak smukchajemi, icham chi' ol in ajok tato tza ya'ej a kolwal t'ayin.
Ak' in nakot a wach'k'olal t'a junjun k'inhib'alil, ina to a ach tzach wak'och yipok in k'o'ol. Ch'ox t'ayin tas ol aj in b'eyb'ati, yujto wan in lesalwi t'ayach.
Mamin Jehová, kolinel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ajk'o'ol, yujto a t'ayach tzin say in kolnab'il.
k'ayb'ej in yik tzin b'o icha tas tza nib'ej, yujto in Diosal ach. A'okab' Espíritu wach' tzin ik'an b'ey t'a a wach' b'eyb'al.
Mamin, manh in a cha chamok, yik wach' max alchaj chukal lolonel t'ayach. Ik' in elta t'a skal wilk'olal, yujto wach' ach toni.
Yuj a wach'k'olal t'ayin, yuj chi' tza satkanel masanil heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin, yujto a chekab' in.
Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová, haton tz'ak'an wip. Haton wal tzin k'ayb'ani, syak'anpax in jelanil yik wach' swak' owal.
Haton icha in nhak'e'en, icha wal in cuartel, in Kolumal paxi. A' tzin k'ub'aneli. A' ayoch wenhulok. A' tz'ak'anoch heb' chonhab' t'a yalanh in mandar.
Mamin Jehová ¿tas wal jab'ok kelk'och a onh anima onh tik t'a yol a sat, yuj chi' tzonh a nakoti? ¿Tas wal kelk'ochi yuj chi' tzonh a ya'ilej?
Ha onh anima onh tik, lajan onh icha wal b'aj skik' kik', haxo ko k 'inal icha wal junok enhul tz'ek'i.
Mamin, jak spuerta'il satcha'anh yik tzach emuli. Tzach emul t'a jolomtak witz yik sk'e stab'il lum u'uj.
Julemta junok a jul-lab', haton jun k'ak' tzek' kopnajok, tza pechanb'at heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach t'a skal somk'olal.
Masanto t'a satcha'anh chi' tzak'emta a k'ab' tzin a kolanel t'a jun ha' mar te niwan, syalelk'ochi, haton heb' ch'ok chonhab'il.
Kolinel t'a heb' esalwum chi', haton heb' syik'cha'anh sk'ab' syak'an sti' t'a tastak manh yelok.
Ach in Diosal, ol in b'itej jun ak' b'it t'ayach. Ol in b'itan yet' sb'ital salterio t'ayach.
U'uj wal, syal yuj heb' rey, a ach ton ix in a kol t'a k'e'en espada tzonh milanchamok, a in David a chekab' in tik.
Ha tikne'ik, kolinel t'a yol sk'ab' heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, heb' esalwum syak' sti' t'a tastak manh yelok syala'.
K'ib'okab' heb' kuninal icha wal tas tz'awchaj to ya ilab'il. Ha heb' ix kisil lajanokab' heb' ix icha junok yoyal templo tzeyb'il, te wach' yilji.
Ha ko pat, b'ut'jinakokab'el yuj junjun makan wa'el. Ha nok' ko kalnel, k'ib'okab' sb'isul nok' t'a smilal. Manhxo b'ischajb'enokab' tz'aj sb'isul nok' ko wakax.
Unewi'okab' nok', mokab' tonhejok tzek' sti' nok'. Malajokab' mach tz'el yaw t'a yol scalle'al ko chonhab' yuj yahelal.
Yelxo wal te wach' yik junok chonhab' to icha chi' yaji. Yelxo wal te wach' yik junok chonhab' to a Jehová ayoch sDiosalok.
Ach in Diosal, a ach ton in Reyal ach, ol walkanel a b'inajnakil. T'a masanil tiempo ol wak' yuj diosal t'ayach.
Junjun k'u ol wal wach' lolonel t'ayach. Ol ach wik'ancha'anh t'a masanil tiempo.
Mamin Jehová, te niwan ton elk'ochi, a moj ton wal yalchaj wach' lolonel t'ayach. Ha a b'inajnakil, manhxo b'ischajb'enok.
Ha heb' mamab'il, ol yalel yab'ixal tastak tza k'ulej t'a heb' yuninal. Haxo heb' uninab'il chi', ol yal pax heb' t'a heb' yixchikin.
Ol yalel yab'ixal a tzikiki'al heb', haton te niwan yelk'ochi, a inxo jun, ol in na'ub'tanhej tas satub'tak tza k'ulej.
Ol alchajel yab'ixal tas satub'tak ix a k'ulej, te ay pax smay. Ha inxo tik, ol walel a b'inajnakil.
Ol alchajel yab'ixal jantak a niwan wach'k'olal, te cha'anh ol aljok to te wach' ach toni.
Mamin Jehová, te niwan ton a wach'k'olal, ay pax ok'elk'olal, manh elanhchamelok skot owal, tz'ok'nhej a k'o'ol t'ayonh.
Mamin Jehová, yelxo wal te wach' ach t'a masanil anima. Masanil tas a b'onak, te xajan u'uj.
Mamin Jehová, masanil tastak b'ob'il u'uj, yalokab' wach' lolonel t'ayach. Yak'okab' yuj diosal heb' a chonhab' t'ayach.
Yalokab'el heb' to te wach' ak'an yajalil. Yalokab' wach' lolonel heb' t'a tas ix a k'ulej, a sch'oxanel a niwan poder.
Ha yab'ixal a poder yet' a b'inajnakil t'a opisio, ol yab' heb' anima.
Ha opisio aynhej ek' t'a junelnhej, Yajal ach t'a masanil tiempo. Ha ach tik tzak'nhejelk'och tas tzala'. Te wach' ach yet' masanil tas a b'onak.
Mamin Jehová, tzak' yip heb' toxo wal stelwi, tzik'an k'e wa'an heb' tz'ixtaxi.
Ha masanil heb' anima, stanhwej a kolwal heb', yujto a ach tzak' swa'el heb' t'a stiempo'al.
Elb'ennhej tas u'uj t'a smasanil a k'o'ol, tzak'an swa'el masanil tas pitzan.
Mamin Jehová, tojolton a b'eyb'al, te ay a wach'k'olal t'a tas a b'onakkani.
B'ekannhej a k'ol a kolwaj t'a heb' syal sb'a t'ayach t'a smasanil sk'o'ol.
Mamin Jehová, tzak' tas icha snib'ej heb' ay xiwk'olal t'ayach. Ayik sk'anan heb', tzab'i tza kolan heb'.
Mamin Jehová, tzil heb' tzach xajanani. Haxo heb' sk'ulan chukal jun, tza satel heb'.
Mamin Jehová, swal wach' lolonel t'ayach. Haxo pax masanil tas b'ob'il u'uj, yalokab' wach' lolonel t'ayach tikne'ik yet' t'a masanil tiempo.
Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová. T'a wal smasanil in k'o'ol ol wal wach' lolonel t'a Jehová.
Yakb'an pitzan hinto ol wal wach' lolonel t'ay. Yakb'an ayinto ek'i, ol in b'itan t'a in Diosal.
Manh eyak'och anima niwan yelk'och yipok he k'o'ol, yujto animanhej heb', yuj chi' max yal-laj skolwaj heb'.
Ayik scham heb', tz'ochkan heb' pokokal. Ha t'a jun k'u chi' slajwikanel tastak sna heb' sk'ulej.
Te wach' yik mach scha'an skolwal sDiosal winhaj Jacob. Anhej Jehová Dios chi' ayoch yipok sk'o'ol.
Ha Jehová b'o'annak satcha'anh, lum lum, ha' mar yet' masanil tastak ay t'a junjun makan chi'. Tz'elnhejk'och tas syala'.
A' sb'o'an yaj b'aj tz'ixtaj heb' anima, syak'anpax swa'el heb' ay swejel. A' skolanel heb' ayoch t'a preso.
Ha Jehová sjakan sat heb' max ujilaj yilani, sketzan k'e wa'an heb' stelwi. Xajan heb' anima wach' spensar yuj.
Ha Jehová skolan heb' anima ch'ok chonhab'il. Anhejton pax ha' tz'ilan heb' unin chamnak smam yet' heb' ix ix chamnak yetb'eyum. Palta tz'ak'ji somchaj heb' sk'ulan chukal yuj.
Ex aj Sion, a Jehová ol ak'an Yajalil t'a masanil tiempo. Ha ko Diosal ol och Reyal t'a junelnhej. Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová.
Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová. Manhxo jantakok swach'il ko b'itan b'it t'a ko Diosal. Smojton wal ko b'itan t'ay yet' juntzanh b'it te wach'.
Ha Jehová sb'o'anxi Jerusalén, ol smolb'ejxikot heb' ketisraelal sakleminak yajkanb'ati.
Ha tz'ak'an sniwanil sk'ol heb' pitz'anoch kuselal t'a spixan. A' tz'anhtan syahelal heb' chi'.
A' na'annak jantak sb'isul k'e'en k'anal sb'onak, yak'annakoch sb'i junjun k'e'en.
Yelxo wal te niwan yelk'och ko Diosal tik, niwan spoder, malaj slajwub'al sjelanil.
A' tz'ik'an k'e wa'an heb' anima emnakil yek'i, palta a heb' sk'ulan chukal, tz'ik'chajkanem heb' sik'lab'il yuj.
Ko b'itejek Jehová yik skak'an yuj diosal yet' te' arpa sko b'itejek.
A' tz'ak'anoch asun t'a satcha'anh, slajwi chi' syak'ankot nhab' t'a sat lu'um tik. A' tz'ak'an k'ib' anh ank'ultak t'a tzalkixtak.
Anhejton pax ha' tz'ak'an swa'el nok' nok' yet' nok' yunetak joj ayik tz'el yaw nok' yuj wejel.
Ha Jehová, max tzalajlaj yet' heb' anima tz'ak'anoch yip nok' chej, ma yipal heb' soldado yipok sk'o'ol.
Palta stzalaj yet' heb' ay xiwk'olal t'ay, haton heb' tz'ak'anoch swach'k'olal yipok sk'o'ol.
Ex aj Jerusalén, kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová. Ex aj Sion, ko b'itejek ko Diosal.
A' tz'ak'anoch yip yijchulok spuerta'il chonhab' Jerusalén, syak'anpax swach'k'olal t'a heb' kuninal.
A' tz'ak'an junk'olal t'a yol smakb'en ko chonhab' tik, syak'anpax b'ut'jok yuj ixim trigo te wach'.
A' tz'ak'ankot slolonel t'a sat lu'um tik, elanhchamel tz'elk'ochi.
Ha ko Diosal tz'ak'ankot k'e'en sakb'akom icha yilji sak lana. A' tz'ak'anoch k'e'en che'ew pokokal, icha k'e'en tik'ak'il ta'anh tz'ajkan k'e'en.
A' tz'ak'ankot k'e'en sakb'at icha k'e'en kotak k'e'en. Haxo wal sikal k'e'en, malaj junok mach stechaj yuj.
Syalanpaxi to tz'ulaxb'at k'e'en, syak'ankot ik', yik sb'ey yalil k'e'en chi'.
Ha slolonel yet' sk'ayb'ub'al, ix yak' kojtakejel a onh israel yinhtilal onh winhaj Jacob tik.
Manh ichokta' ix yutej t'a junokxo nación. Maj yojtakejel-laj sk'ayb'ub'al ko Diosal juntzanhxo chonhab' chi'. Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová.
Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová. Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová masanto t'a scha'anhil satcha'anh.
Alek wach' lolonel t'ay masanil ex yángel. Alek wach' lolonel masanil ex soldado'al satcha'anh.
Ik'chajokab' cha'anh Jehová yuj k'u yet' k'e'en uj. Ik'chajokab' cha'anh yuj k'e'en nitk'anal te wach' yilji yok.
Ik'chajokab' cha'anh yuj satcha'anh, to cha'anh ay yet' pax yuj ha ha' ayek' t'a yib'anh satcha'anh chi'.
Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová, yujto tonhej ix yala' ix b'okan smasanil.
A' ix b'o'ankan masanil juntzanh chi' t'a yet'tal yik wach' ayek' ta' t'a masanil tiempo, ix yak'ankanoch t'a sleyal to malaj b'ak'inh ol k'exchajok.
Yalokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová masanil tastak ay t'a sat lu'um tik, nok' niwak nok' ay t'a yol ha' mar yet' pax nok' ay t'a sjulal yich ha',
yet' lheb'lon, k'e'en sakb'at, k'e'en sakb'akom, k'ik'al asun yet' chakxuxum ik', k'anab'ajumokab' syutej sb'a t'a slolonel Jehová chi'.
Yalokab' wach' lolonel lum niwak witz t'a Jehová, lum tzalkixtak, te te' syak' sat, te' k'ute',
yet' nok' k'ultakil nok', nok' molb'etzal nok', nok' snherwi, ma sjachwi yet' pax nok' much.
Ex sreyal yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ex anima t'a junjun chonhab', ex yajal yet' ex tze b'o yaj heb' chonhab',
ex winak, ex ix, ex ichamtak anima yet' pax ex unin, alek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová he masanil.
Alek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová he masanil yujto anhej te b'inajnak. Ha stzikiki'al ay masanto t'a yib'anh satcha'anh yet' t'a yib'anh lum lum tik.
A' ix ak'an kipal a onh schonhab' onh tik. Kalek wach' lolonel t'ay a onh israel onh tik, a onhton te xajanab'il onh yuj. Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová.
Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová. Ko b'itejek ak' b'it t'a Jehová. Ko b'itejek b'it t'ay b'aj molan onh ek' a onh yik onhxo tik.
Ex wetisraelal, konh tzalajek yet' ko Diosal cha'annakel yich ko nación tik. Konh tzalajek yet' ko Reyal a onh aj chonhab' Sion onh tik.
Konh k'e'ek cheneljok skalanek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová, yik skak'an ejmelal t'ay. Konh b'itanek t'ay yet' te' arpa yet' pandereta,
yujto stzalaj ket'ok a onh schonhab' onh tik. Ol yak' ko tzalajk'olal a onh emnakil onh tik, yujto ol yak' ko kolnab'il.
Yuj sniwanil yelk'och Jehová, konh tzalajek a onh yik onhxo tik. Hanhejtona' konh b'itanek t'ay yuj tzalajk'olal ayik tzonh waykan ochi.
K'e'okab' kaw ko b'itan t'a Dios, haxo jun k'e'en espada ay ye t'a schab'il pak'anh yamb'il ku'uj,
yik skak'anek' ko pak t'a heb' ch'ok chonhab'il, skak'anoch yahelal t'a juntzanh nación,
yik wach' tz'och k'e'en cadena t'a sreyal heb' yet' t'a heb' anima ay yopisio t'a skal heb',
yik skotkan yahelal t'a yib'anh heb', haton tz'ib'yajkani. Ha jun niwan opisio tik syak' Dios t'a masanil heb' sk'anab'ajan t'ay. Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová.
Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová. B'itananhek t'a Dios t'a skajnub'. B'itananhek t'ay yujto te niwan sb'inajnakil t'a satcha'anh.
B'itananhek t'a Dios yuj tas satub'tak sb'o'o. B'itananhek t'ay yuj sb'inajnakil, malaj junok mach lajan yet'ok.
B'itananhek t'ay yet' k'e'en trompeta. B'itananhek t'ay yet' te' arpa yet' pax salterio.
B'itananhek t'ay yet' pandereta, tzex k'epax cheneljok yuj tzalajk'olal. B'itananhek t'ay yet' flauta yet' pax juntzanh yamk'ab' yik b'it ay sch'anhal.
B'itananhek t'ay yet' k'e'en platillo tzinhinhi sk'anhi. B'itananhek t'ay yet' k'e'en platillo cha'anh sk'anhi.
Masanil tastak syik' yik', b'itanokab' t'a Jehová. Aljokab' wach' lolonel t'a Jehová.
